import { ObjectType, Field, Int } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import {
  Entity,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  Column,
  OneToMany,
  CreateDateColumn,
  UpdateDateColumn,
} from 'typeorm';
import { Product } from './product.entity';
@ObjectType()
@Entity('brands')
export class Brand {
  @Field(() => Int)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id: number;
  @Field()
  @Column({ unique: true })
  slug: string;
  @Field()
  @Column({ default: 0 })
  sortOrder: number;
  @Field()
  @Column({ default: true })
  isActive: boolean;
  @Field()
  @CreateDateColumn()
  createdAt: Date;
  @Field()
  @UpdateDateColumn()
  updatedAt: Date;
  @OneToMany(() => Product, (product) => product.brand)
  products: Product[];
  // Virtual field - resolved via GraphQL resolver
  @Field()
  name: string;
}

<file path="libs/server/entities/src/lib/cart.entity.ts">
import { Field, ObjectType, ID, Int, Float } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import {
  Entity,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  Column,
  ManyToOne,
  OneToMany,
  CreateDateColumn,
  UpdateDateColumn,
  JoinColumn,
} from 'typeorm';
import { User } from './user.entity';
import { Product } from './product.entity';
@ObjectType()
@Entity('carts')
export class Cart {
  @Field(() => ID)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  userId: string;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2, default: 0 })
  subtotal: number;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2, default: 0 })
  total: number;
  @Field(() => Date)
  @CreateDateColumn()
  createdAt: Date;
  @Field(() => Date)
  @UpdateDateColumn()
  updatedAt: Date;
  @ManyToOne(() => User, { onDelete: 'CASCADE' })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'userId' })
  user: User;
  @OneToMany(() => CartItem, (cartItem) => cartItem.cart, { cascade: true })
  items: CartItem[];
}
@ObjectType()
@Entity('cart_items')
export class CartItem {
  @Field(() => ID)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  cartId: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  productId: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  productName: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  productImage?: string;
  @Field(() => Int)
  @Column()
  quantity: number;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  unitPrice: number;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  totalPrice: number;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  color?: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  size?: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  sellerId: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  sellerName?: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  productInfoId?: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  sellerProductId?: string;
  @Field(() => Int, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  availableStock?: number;
  @ManyToOne(() => Cart, (cart) => cart.items, { onDelete: 'CASCADE' })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'cartId' })
  cart: Cart;
  @ManyToOne(() => Product, { onDelete: 'CASCADE' })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'productId' })
  product: Product;
}

<file path="libs/server/entities/src/lib/product-description.entity.ts">
import {
  Entity,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  Column,
  CreateDateColumn,
  UpdateDateColumn,
  Index,
  ManyToOne,
  JoinColumn,
  Relation,
} from 'typeorm';
import { ObjectType, Field, ID, Int } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { Product } from './product.entity';
import { SiteLanguage } from './site-language.entity';
@ObjectType()
@Entity('product_descriptions')
@Index(['productId', 'languageId'], { unique: true })
@Index(['productId'])
@Index(['languageId'])
export class ProductDescription {
  @Field(() => ID)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id: number;
  @ManyToOne(() => Product, (product) => product.descriptions, {
    onDelete: 'CASCADE',
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'productId' })
  product: Relation<Product>;
  @Field(() => Int)
  @Column()
  productId: number;
  @Field(() => SiteLanguage)
  @ManyToOne(() => SiteLanguage, (lang) => lang.productDescriptions, {
    eager: true,
    onDelete: 'CASCADE',
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'languageId' })
  language: Relation<SiteLanguage>;
  @Field(() => Int)
  @Column()
  languageId: number;
  @Field()
  @Column({ type: 'text' })
  description: string;
  @Field(() => Date)
  @CreateDateColumn()
  createdAt: Date;
  @Field(() => Date)
  @UpdateDateColumn()
  updatedAt: Date;
}
</file>

<file path="libs/server/entities/src/lib/product-info.entity.ts">
import { ObjectType, Field, Int, Float, registerEnumType } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import {
  Entity,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  Column,
  ManyToOne,
  OneToMany,
  Relation,
} from 'typeorm';
import { SizeKind } from '@kickzone-workspace/product-sizes';
import { Product } from './product.entity';
import { Color } from './color.entity';
import { ProductInfoColor } from './product-info-color.entity';
registerEnumType(SizeKind, {
  name: 'SizeKind',
});
@ObjectType()
@Entity()
export class ProductInfo {
  @Field(() => Int)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id: number;
  /** Canonical size code: apparel letter or EU footwear number. */
  @Field()
  @Column()
  size: string;
  @Field(() => SizeKind)
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', default: SizeKind.Apparel })
  sizeKind: SizeKind;
  @OneToMany(() => ProductInfoColor, (link) => link.productInfo, {
    cascade: true,
    eager: true,
  })
  colorLinks: Relation<ProductInfoColor>[];
  /** Ordered colors for this variant (resolved from colorLinks). */
  @Field(() => [Color])
  colors: Color[];
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  weight: number;
  @Field(() => Product)
  @ManyToOne(() => Product, (product) => product.productInfos)
  product: Product;
  @Field(() => [String], { nullable: true })
  @Column('simple-array', { nullable: true, default: '' })
  images: string[];
}
</file>

import { Field, Int, ObjectType } from '@nestjs/graphql';

  Entity,

  ManyToOne,
  OneToMany,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  Relation,
} from 'typeorm';

@ObjectType()
@Entity()
export class Product {
  @Field(() => Int)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id: number;
  @Field()
  @Column({ unique: true })
  name: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ unique: true, nullable: true })
  sku?: string | null;
  @Field(() => [ProductInfo])
  @OneToMany(() => ProductInfo, (productInfo) => productInfo.product, {
    cascade: true,
  })
  productInfos: ProductInfo[];
  @Field(() => [Category])
  @ManyToMany(() => Category, (category) => category.products)
  @JoinTable()
  categories: Category[];
  @Field(() => Brand, { nullable: true })
  @ManyToOne(() => Brand, (brand) => brand.products, {
    nullable: true,
    onDelete: 'SET NULL',
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'brandId' })
  brand?: Brand | null;
  @Field(() => Int, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ type: 'int', nullable: true })
  brandId?: number | null;
  @Field(() => SellerInfo, { nullable: true })
  @ManyToOne(() => SellerInfo, { nullable: true, onDelete: 'SET NULL' })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'sellerId' })
  seller?: SellerInfo | null;
  @Field(() => Int, { nullable: true })
  @Column({ type: 'int', nullable: true })
  sellerId?: number | null;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ type: 'text', nullable: true })
  description?: string | null;
  @Field(() => [ProductDescription], { nullable: true })
  @OneToMany(
    () => ProductDescription,
    (productDescription) => productDescription.product,
    { cascade: true }
  )
  descriptions?: Relation<ProductDescription>[];
  @Field(() => [SellerProduct], { nullable: true })
  @OneToMany(() => SellerProduct, (sellerProduct) => sellerProduct.product)
  sellerProducts: Relation<SellerProduct>[];
  @Field({ defaultValue: false })
  @Column({
    type: 'boolean',
    default: false,
    nullable: false,
    comment: 'For partitioning',
  })
  archived: boolean;
}
@ObjectType()
export class ProductEdge extends EdgeType<Product> {
  @Field(() => Product)
  node: Product;
}
@ObjectType()
export class ProductConnection extends ConnectionType<Product> {
  @Field(() => [ProductEdge])
  edges: ProductEdge[];
}

<file path="libs/server/entities/src/lib/seller-product.entity.ts">
// src/entities/seller-product.entity.ts
import {
  Entity,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  ManyToOne,
  Column,
  Relation,
  BeforeInsert,
  BeforeUpdate,
  Index,
} from 'typeorm';
import { SellerInfo } from './seller-info.entity';
import { Product } from './product.entity';
import { ProductInfo } from './product-info.entity';
import { ObjectType, Field, Int, Float } from '@nestjs/graphql';
@ObjectType()
@Entity()
@Index(['seller', 'productInfoId'], { unique: true })
export class SellerProduct {
  @Field(() => String)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;
  @Field(() => SellerInfo, { nullable: true })
  @ManyToOne(() => SellerInfo, (seller) => seller.sellerProducts)
  seller: SellerInfo;
  @Field(() => Product)
  @ManyToOne(() => Product, (product) => product.sellerProducts)
  product: Relation<Product>;
  @Field(() => ProductInfo)
  @ManyToOne(() => ProductInfo, { nullable: false })
  productInfo: ProductInfo;
  @Field(() => Int)
  @Column({ nullable: false })
  productInfoId: number;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  price: number;
  @Field(() => Float, { nullable: true })
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  costPrice: number;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 5, scale: 2, default: 0 })
  discount: number;
  @Field(() => Int)
  @Column()
  stockQuantity: number;
  @Field(() => Boolean, { defaultValue: false })
  @Column({ type: 'boolean', default: false })
  recommended: boolean;
  @Field(() => Boolean, { defaultValue: false })
  @Column({ type: 'boolean', default: false })
  boxLess: boolean;
  @BeforeInsert()
  @BeforeUpdate()
  setProductInfoId() {
    // If productInfo relation is set but productInfoId is not, set it from the relation
    if (this.productInfo && !this.productInfoId) {
      this.productInfoId = this.productInfo.id;
      console.log(
        '🔧 Setting productInfoId:',
        this.productInfoId,
        'from productInfo:',
        this.productInfo.id
      );
    }
    // If productInfoId is set but productInfo relation is not, this is handled in the service layer
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/entities/src/lib/user.entity.ts">
import { Entity, PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Column, Index } from 'typeorm';
import { ObjectType, Field, ID, registerEnumType, Int } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { Connection, Edge, PageInfo } from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
export enum UserRole {
  ADMIN = 'ADMIN',
  SELLER = 'SELLER',
  CUSTOMER = 'CUSTOMER',
}
registerEnumType(UserRole, {
  name: 'UserRole',
});
@ObjectType()
@Entity()
export class User {
  @Field(() => ID)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;
  @Field()
  @Column()
  @Index()
  name: string;
  @Field()
  @Column()
  @Index()
  lastName: string;
  @Field()
  @Column({ unique: true })
  @Index()
  username: string;
  @Field()
  @Column({ unique: true })
  @Index()
  email: string;
  @Column()
  password: string;
  @Field(() => UserRole)
  @Column({
    type: 'enum',
    enum: UserRole,
    default: UserRole.CUSTOMER,
  })
  role: UserRole;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true, default: 'en' })
  locale?: string;
}
@ObjectType()
export class UserEdge implements Edge<User> {
  @Field(() => User)
  node: User;
  @Field()
  cursor: string;
}
@ObjectType()
export class UserConnection implements Connection<User> {
  @Field(() => [UserEdge])
  edges: UserEdge[];
  @Field(() => PageInfo)
  pageInfo: PageInfo;
  @Field(() => Int)
  totalCount: number;
}
export type UserWithoutPassword = Omit<User, 'password'>;

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/product-info.resolver.spec.ts">
import { ProductInfoResolver } from './product-info.resolver';
import { Color, ProductInfo, ProductInfoColor } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
describe('ProductInfoResolver', () => {
  let resolver: ProductInfoResolver;
  beforeEach(() => {
    resolver = new ProductInfoResolver();
  });
  it('resolves ALL ordered colors for a product info, not just the first one', () => {
    const colorRed = { id: 1, name: 'Red', hexCode: '#ff0000' } as Color;
    const colorBlue = { id: 2, name: 'Blue', hexCode: '#0000ff' } as Color;
    const colorGreen = { id: 3, name: 'Green', hexCode: '#00ff00' } as Color;
    const productInfo = {
      id: 10,
      colorLinks: [
        { id: 102, position: 1, color: colorBlue } as ProductInfoColor,
        { id: 101, position: 0, color: colorRed } as ProductInfoColor,
        { id: 103, position: 2, color: colorGreen } as ProductInfoColor,
      ],
    } as ProductInfo;
    const colors = resolver.colors(productInfo);
    expect(colors).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(colors[0]).toEqual(colorRed);
    expect(colors[1]).toEqual(colorBlue);
    expect(colors[2]).toEqual(colorGreen);
  });
  it('returns empty array when colorLinks is empty or null', () => {
    expect(resolver.colors({} as unknown as ProductInfo)).toEqual([]);
    expect(resolver.colors({ colorLinks: [] } as unknown as ProductInfo)).toEqual([]);
  });
});
</file>

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/product-info.resolver.ts">
import { Parent, ResolveField, Resolver } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { Color, ProductInfo } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { orderedColorsFromLinks } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
@Resolver(() => ProductInfo)
export class ProductInfoResolver {
  @ResolveField(() => [Color])
  colors(@Parent() productInfo: ProductInfo): Color[] {
    return orderedColorsFromLinks(productInfo.colorLinks);
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/translation.resolver.guards.spec.ts">
import { GUARDS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { GraphqlAuthGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { CatalogGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { TranslationResolver } from './translation.resolver';
describe('TranslationResolver guards metadata', () => {
  const getGuards = (methodName: keyof TranslationResolver) =>
    Reflect.getMetadata(GUARDS_METADATA, TranslationResolver.prototype[methodName]) ?? [];
  it('setTranslation has CatalogGuard and does not rely on GraphqlAuthGuard alone', () => {
    const guards = getGuards('setTranslation');
    expect(guards).toContain(CatalogGuard);
    expect(guards).not.toEqual([GraphqlAuthGuard]);
  });
  it('bulkTranslateEntities has CatalogGuard and does not rely on GraphqlAuthGuard alone', () => {
    const guards = getGuards('bulkTranslateEntities');
    expect(guards).toContain(CatalogGuard);
    expect(guards).not.toEqual([GraphqlAuthGuard]);
  });
  it('deleteEntityTranslations has CatalogGuard and does not rely on GraphqlAuthGuard alone', () => {
    const guards = getGuards('deleteEntityTranslations');
    expect(guards).toContain(CatalogGuard);
    expect(guards).not.toEqual([GraphqlAuthGuard]);
  });
  it('getTranslation has no guards (stays public)', () => {
    const guards = getGuards('getTranslation');
    expect(guards).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('getEntityTranslations has no guards (stays public)', () => {
    const guards = getGuards('getEntityTranslations');
    expect(guards).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('getTranslationWithFallback has no guards (stays public)', () => {
    const guards = getGuards('getTranslationWithFallback');
    expect(guards).toEqual([]);
  });
});

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { RefreshToken, User, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { UserService } from './user.service';
import { EmailService } from './email.service';
import { TokenService } from './token.service';
describe('AuthService - Password Policy', () => {
  let service: AuthService;
  let userService: {
    findByEmail: jest.Mock;
    getUserById: jest.Mock;
    createUser: jest.Mock;
    updateUser: jest.Mock;
  };
  let jwtService: { sign: jest.Mock; verify: jest.Mock };
  let refreshTokenRepository: {
    create: jest.Mock;
    save: jest.Mock;
    findOne: jest.Mock;
    update: jest.Mock;
  };
  let tokenService: {
    generateToken: jest.Mock;
    validateToken: jest.Mock;
  };
  const mockUser = {
    id: 'user-1',
    email: 'user@test.com',
    role: UserRole.CUSTOMER,
    name: 'Test',
    lastName: 'User',
    username: 'user@test.com',
    password: 'hashed',
  } as User;
  beforeEach(async () => {
    userService = {
      findByEmail: jest.fn(),
      getUserById: jest.fn(),
      createUser: jest.fn(),
      updateUser: jest.fn(),
    };
    jwtService = {
      sign: jest.fn().mockReturnValue('access.jwt.token'),
      verify: jest.fn(),
    };
    refreshTokenRepository = {
      create: jest.fn((entity) => entity),
      save: jest.fn(async (entity) => ({
        id: 'rt-1',
        ...entity,
      })),
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      update: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ affected: 1 }),
    };
    tokenService = {
      generateToken: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue('reset-token-123'),
      validateToken: jest.fn(),
    };
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        AuthService,
        { provide: UserService, useValue: userService },
        { provide: JwtService, useValue: jwtService },
        { provide: EmailService, useValue: { sendEmail: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) } },
        { provide: TokenService, useValue: tokenService },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(RefreshToken),
          useValue: refreshTokenRepository,
        },
      ],
    }).compile();
    service = module.get(AuthService);
  });
  describe('register', () => {
    it('rejects empty password with BadRequestException', async () => {
      await expect(service.register('Test', 'test@test.com', '')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.createUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects 7-character password with BadRequestException', async () => {
      await expect(service.register('Test', 'test@test.com', 'short7c')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.createUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('accepts 8-character password and creates user', async () => {
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(null);
      userService.createUser.mockResolvedValue({ ...mockUser, password: 'hashed-abcdefgh' });
      const result = await service.register('Test', 'test@test.com', 'abcdefgh');
      expect(userService.findByEmail).toHaveBeenCalledWith('test@test.com');
      expect(userService.createUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          email: 'test@test.com',
          password: expect.any(String),
        })
      );
      expect(result).toEqual({ ...mockUser, password: 'hashed-abcdefgh' });
    });
  });
  describe('adminCreateUser', () => {
    it('rejects 3-character password with BadRequestException', async () => {
      await expect(
        service.adminCreateUser({
          name: 'Admin',
          lastName: 'User',
          username: 'admin',
          email: 'admin@test.com',
          password: 'abc',
          role: UserRole.ADMIN,
        })
      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.createUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    it('accepts 8-character password and creates user', async () => {

      });

      expect(userService.createUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

          password: expect.any(String),
        })
      );
      expect(result.role).toBe(UserRole.ADMIN);
    });
  });
  describe('setupPassword', () => {
    it('rejects 3-character password with BadRequestException before token validation', async () => {
      await expect(service.setupPassword('valid-token', 'abc')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects empty password with BadRequestException before token validation', async () => {
      await expect(service.setupPassword('valid-token', '')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('accepts 8-character password and proceeds with token validation', async () => {
      const tokenData = {
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'user@test.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_setup',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      };
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(tokenData);
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      userService.updateUser.mockResolvedValue({ ...mockUser, password: 'new-hashed' });
      const result = await service.setupPassword('valid-token', 'abcdefgh');
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith('valid-token');
      expect(userService.findByEmail).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user@test.com');
      expect(userService.updateUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user-1', {
        password: expect.any(String),
      });
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        { userId: 'user-1', revokedAt: undefined },
        { revokedAt: expect.any(Date) }
      );
      expect(result.password).toBe('new-hashed');
    });
  });
  describe('resetPassword', () => {
    it('rejects 3-character password with BadRequestException before token validation', async () => {
      await expect(service.resetPassword('valid-token', 'abc')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects empty password with BadRequestException before token validation', async () => {
      await expect(service.resetPassword('valid-token', '')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('accepts 8-character password and proceeds with token validation', async () => {
      const tokenData = {
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'user@test.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_reset',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      };
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(tokenData);
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      userService.updateUser.mockResolvedValue({ ...mockUser, password: 'new-hashed' });
      const result = await service.resetPassword('valid-reset-token', 'abcdefgh');
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith('valid-reset-token');

    });
  });

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/brand.service.ts">
import { Injectable, Logger, OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, IsNull } from 'typeorm';
import { Brand, Product } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { CreateBrandInput, UpdateBrandInput } from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { TranslationService } from './translation.service';
/** Basic catalog brands seeded on startup. */
export const BASIC_BRANDS: Array<{
  slug: string;
  sortOrder: number;
  name: { en: string; fa: string };
  namePrefixes: string[];
}> = [
  {
    slug: 'nike',
    sortOrder: 1,
    name: { en: 'Nike', fa: 'نایک' },
    namePrefixes: ['nike'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'jordan',
    sortOrder: 2,
    name: { en: 'Jordan', fa: 'جردن' },
    namePrefixes: ['jordan', 'air jordan'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'adidas',
    sortOrder: 3,
    name: { en: 'Adidas', fa: 'آدیداس' },
    namePrefixes: ['adidas'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'puma',
    sortOrder: 4,
    name: { en: 'Puma', fa: 'پوما' },
    namePrefixes: ['puma'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'new-balance',
    sortOrder: 5,
    name: { en: 'New Balance', fa: 'نیو بالانس' },
    namePrefixes: ['new balance'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'under-armour',
    sortOrder: 6,
    name: { en: 'Under Armour', fa: 'آندر آرمور' },
    namePrefixes: ['under armour'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'reebok',
    sortOrder: 7,
    name: { en: 'Reebok', fa: 'ریبوک' },
    namePrefixes: ['reebok'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'asics',
    sortOrder: 8,
    name: { en: 'Asics', fa: 'اسیکس' },
    namePrefixes: ['asics'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'converse',
    sortOrder: 9,
    name: { en: 'Converse', fa: 'کانورس' },
    namePrefixes: ['converse'],
  },
  {
    slug: 'vans',
    sortOrder: 10,
    name: { en: 'Vans', fa: 'ونز' },
    namePrefixes: ['vans'],
  },
];
@Injectable()
export class BrandService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(BrandService.name);
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Brand)
    private readonly brandRepository: Repository<Brand>,
    @InjectRepository(Product)
    private readonly productRepository: Repository<Product>,
    private readonly translationService: TranslationService
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit() {
    await this.seedBasicBrands();
    await this.backfillProductBrands();
  }
  async getBrands(options?: { onlyWithProducts?: boolean }): Promise<Brand[]> {
    const qb = this.brandRepository
      .createQueryBuilder('brand')
      .orderBy('brand.sortOrder', 'ASC')
      .addOrderBy('brand.id', 'ASC');
    if (options?.onlyWithProducts) {
      qb.andWhere('brand.isActive = true').andWhere(
        `EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM product p
          INNER JOIN seller_product sp ON sp."productId" = p.id
          WHERE p."brandId" = brand.id
            AND p.archived = false
            AND sp."stockQuantity" > 0
        )`
      );
    }
    return qb.getMany();
  }
  async getBrandById(id: number): Promise<Brand | null> {
    return this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ id });
  }
  async getBrandBySlug(slug: string): Promise<Brand | null> {
    return this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ slug: slug.toLowerCase() });
  }
  async createBrand(input: CreateBrandInput, name?: string): Promise<Brand> {
    const slug = input.slug.trim().toLowerCase();
    const existing = await this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ slug });
    if (existing) {
      throw new Error('A brand with this slug already exists.');
    }
    const brand = this.brandRepository.create({
      slug,
      sortOrder: input.sortOrder ?? 0,
      isActive: true,
    });
    const saved = await this.brandRepository.save(brand);
    if (name?.trim()) {
      await this.translationService.setTranslation({
        entityType: 'brand',
        entityId: saved.id,
        locale: 'en',
        fieldName: 'name',
        value: name.trim(),
        isAutoTranslated: false,
      });
    }
    return saved;
  }
  async updateBrand(
    input: UpdateBrandInput,
    name?: string,
    locale = 'en'
  ): Promise<Brand> {
    const brand = await this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ id: input.id });
    if (!brand) {
      throw new Error(`Brand with ID ${input.id} not found`);
    }
    if (input.slug && input.slug !== brand.slug) {
      const slug = input.slug.trim().toLowerCase();
      const existing = await this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ slug });
      if (existing) {
        throw new Error('A brand with this slug already exists.');
      }
      brand.slug = slug;
    }
    if (input.sortOrder !== undefined) brand.sortOrder = input.sortOrder;
    if (input.isActive !== undefined) brand.isActive = input.isActive;
    const saved = await this.brandRepository.save(brand);
    if (name?.trim()) {
      await this.translationService.setTranslation({
        entityType: 'brand',
        entityId: saved.id,
        locale,
        fieldName: 'name',
        value: name.trim(),
        isAutoTranslated: false,
      });
    }
    return saved;
  }
  async deleteBrand(id: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const brand = await this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ id });
    if (!brand) {
      throw new Error(`Brand with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    const productCount = await this.productRepository.count({
      where: { brandId: id },
    });
    if (productCount > 0) {
      throw new Error('Cannot delete brand that is assigned to products');
    }
    await this.translationService.deleteEntityTranslations('brand', id);
    await this.brandRepository.remove(brand);
    return true;
  }
  private async seedBasicBrands(): Promise<void> {
    let created = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_BRANDS) {
      let brand = await this.brandRepository.findOneBy({ slug: basic.slug });
      if (!brand) {
        brand = await this.brandRepository.save(
          this.brandRepository.create({
            slug: basic.slug,
            sortOrder: basic.sortOrder,
            isActive: true,
          })
        );
        created += 1;
      }
      await this.ensureBrandNameTranslation(brand.id, 'en', basic.name.en);
      await this.ensureBrandNameTranslation(brand.id, 'fa', basic.name.fa);
    }
    if (created > 0) {
      this.logger.log(`Seeded ${created} basic brand(s)`);
    }
  }
  /**
   * Assign brands to products that still lack one, using name prefixes.
   */
  private async backfillProductBrands(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const brands = await this.brandRepository.find();
      if (!brands.length) return;
      const products = await this.productRepository.find({
        where: { brandId: IsNull() },
      });
      if (!products.length) return;
      let updated = 0;
      for (const product of products) {
        const nameLower = (product.name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
        const matched = BASIC_BRANDS.find((b) =>
          b.namePrefixes.some(
            (prefix) =>
              nameLower === prefix || nameLower.startsWith(`${prefix} `)
          )
        );
        if (!matched) continue;
        const brand = brands.find((b) => b.slug === matched.slug);
        if (!brand) continue;
        product.brandId = brand.id;
        await this.productRepository.save(product);
        updated += 1;
      }
      if (updated > 0) {
        this.logger.log(`Backfilled brand on ${updated} product(s)`);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.warn(
        `Skipped brand backfill: ${(error as Error).message}`
      );
    }
  }
  private async ensureBrandNameTranslation(
    brandId: number,
    locale: string,
    value: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.translationService.getTranslation(
      'brand',
      brandId,
      locale,
      'name',
      ''
    );
    if (existing) {
      return;
    }
    await this.translationService.setTranslation({
      entityType: 'brand',
      entityId: brandId,
      locale,
      fieldName: 'name',
      value,
      isAutoTranslated: false,
    });
  }
}
</file>

@Injectable()
export class CategoryService implements OnModuleInit {

    return this.categoryRepository.save(category);
  }
  async updateCategory(id: number, name: string): Promise<Category> {
    const category = await this.categoryRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    if (!category) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Category with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    // Check for duplicate name (excluding current category)
    const existing = await this.categoryRepository.findOne({ where: { name } });
    if (existing && existing.id !== id) {
      throw new Error('A category with this name already exists.');
    }
    category.name = name;
    return this.categoryRepository.save(category);
  }
  async deleteCategory(id: number): Promise<void> {
    const category = await this.categoryRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
    if (!category) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Category with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    // Check if category has any products using a count query
    const productCount = await this.categoryRepository
      .createQueryBuilder('category')
      .leftJoin('category.products', 'product')
      .where('category.id = :id', { id })
      .select('COUNT(product.id)', 'count')
      .getRawOne();
    if (productCount && Number(productCount.count) > 0) {
      throw new Error('Cannot delete category that is assigned to products');
    }
    await this.categoryRepository.remove(category);
  }
  /**
   * Idempotently insert basic categories + EN/FA name translations.
   */
  async seedBasicCategories(): Promise<void> {
    let created = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_CATEGORIES) {
      let category = await this.categoryRepository.findOneBy({
        slug: basic.slug,
      });
      if (!category) {
        category = await this.categoryRepository.save(
          this.categoryRepository.create({
            slug: basic.slug,
            sortOrder: basic.sortOrder,
            isActive: true,
          })
        );
        created += 1;
      }
      await this.ensureCategoryNameTranslation(
        category.id,
        'en',
        basic.name.en
      );
      await this.ensureCategoryNameTranslation(
        category.id,
        'fa',
        basic.name.fa
      );
    }
    if (created > 0) {
      this.logger.log(`Seeded ${created} basic categor(y/ies)`);
    }
  }
  private async ensureCategoryNameTranslation(
    categoryId: number,
    locale: string,
    value: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.translationService.getTranslation(
      'category',
      categoryId,
      locale,
      'name',
      ''
    );
    if (existing) {
      return;
    }
    await this.translationService.setTranslation({
      entityType: 'category',
      entityId: categoryId,
      locale,
      fieldName: 'name',
      value,
      isAutoTranslated: false,
    });
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/color.service.ts">

  { hexCode: '#E6E6FA', sortOrder: 50, name: { en: 'Lilac', fa: 'یاسی' } },
];
@Injectable()
export class ColorService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ColorService.name);
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Color)
    private readonly colorRepository: Repository<Color>,
    private readonly translationService: TranslationService
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit() {
    await this.seedBasicColors();
  }
  async getColors(): Promise<Color[]> {
    return this.colorRepository.find({
      order: { sortOrder: 'ASC', id: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async getColorById(id: number): Promise<Color | null> {
    return this.colorRepository.findOneBy({ id });
  }
  async createColor(input: CreateColorInput, name?: string): Promise<Color> {
    const hexCode = this.normalizeHex(input.hexCode);
    const existing = await this.colorRepository.findOneBy({ hexCode });
    if (existing) {
      throw new Error('A color with this hex code already exists.');
    }
    const color = this.colorRepository.create({
      hexCode,
      sortOrder: input.sortOrder || 0,
    });
    const savedColor = await this.colorRepository.save(color);
    // Create a translation entry for the color name if provided
    if (name) {
      await this.translationService.setTranslation({
        entityType: 'color',
        entityId: savedColor.id,
        locale: 'en', // Default to English
        fieldName: 'name',
        value: name,
        isAutoTranslated: false, // Not auto-translated
      });
    }
    return savedColor;
  }
  async updateColor(
    id: number,
    input: UpdateColorInput,
    name?: string,
    locale = 'en'
  ): Promise<Color> {
    const color = await this.colorRepository.findOneBy({ id });
    if (!color) {
      throw new Error(`Color with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    const hexCode = this.normalizeHex(input.hexCode);
    const existing = await this.colorRepository.findOne({
      where: { hexCode },
    });
    if (existing && existing.id !== id) {
      throw new Error('A color with this hex code already exists.');
    }
    color.hexCode = hexCode;
    if (input.sortOrder !== undefined) {
      color.sortOrder = input.sortOrder;
    }
    if (input.isActive !== undefined) {
      color.isActive = input.isActive;
    }
    const saved = await this.colorRepository.save(color);
    const trimmedName = name?.trim();
    if (trimmedName) {
      await this.translationService.setTranslation({
        entityType: 'color',
        entityId: saved.id,
        locale,
        fieldName: 'name',
        value: trimmedName,
        isAutoTranslated: false,
      });
    }
    return saved;
  }
  async deleteColor(id: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const result = await this.colorRepository.delete(id);
    return (result.affected ?? 0) > 0;
  }
  /**
   * Idempotently insert basic colors + EN/FA name translations.
   */
  async seedBasicColors(): Promise<void> {
    let created = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_COLORS) {
      const hexCode = this.normalizeHex(basic.hexCode);
      let color = await this.colorRepository.findOneBy({ hexCode });
      if (!color) {
        color = await this.colorRepository.save(
          this.colorRepository.create({
            hexCode,
            sortOrder: basic.sortOrder,
            isActive: true,
          })
        );
        created += 1;
      }
      await this.ensureColorNameTranslation(color.id, 'en', basic.name.en);
      await this.ensureColorNameTranslation(color.id, 'fa', basic.name.fa);
    }
    if (created > 0) {
      this.logger.log(`Seeded ${created} basic color(s)`);
    }
  }
  private async ensureColorNameTranslation(
    colorId: number,
    locale: string,
    value: string
  ): Promise<void> {
    const existing = await this.translationService.getTranslation(
      'color',
      colorId,
      locale,
      'name',
      ''
    );
    if (existing) {
      return;
    }
    await this.translationService.setTranslation({
      entityType: 'color',
      entityId: colorId,
      locale,
      fieldName: 'name',
      value,
      isAutoTranslated: false,
    });
  }
  private normalizeHex(hexCode: string): string {
    const trimmed = hexCode.trim();
    return trimmed.startsWith('#')
      ? trimmed.toUpperCase()
      : `#${trimmed.toUpperCase()}`;
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/currency.service.ts">
import {
  Injectable,
  Logger,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  OnModuleInit,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, LessThanOrEqual } from 'typeorm';
import {
  Currency,
  ExchangeRate,
  CurrencyPreference,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
/** Core currencies seeded on startup so the admin currency screen works out of the box. */
export const BASIC_CURRENCIES: Array<{
  code: string;
  name: string;
  symbol: string;
  decimalPlaces: number;
  isBaseCurrency: boolean;
}> = [
  {
    code: 'USD',
    name: 'US Dollar',
    symbol: '$',
    decimalPlaces: 2,
    isBaseCurrency: true,
  },
  {
    code: 'IRR',
    // Code is IRR for legacy reasons; amounts/symbol are Toman (ZarinPal IRT).
    name: 'Iranian Toman',
    symbol: 'تومان',
    decimalPlaces: 0,
    isBaseCurrency: false,
  },
];
/** Locale → currency defaults seeded on startup. */
export const BASIC_CURRENCY_PREFERENCES: Array<{
  locale: string;
  currencyCode: string;
}> = [
  { locale: 'fa', currencyCode: 'IRR' },
  { locale: 'en', currencyCode: 'USD' },
];
@Injectable()
export class CurrencyService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(CurrencyService.name);
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Currency)
    private currencyRepository: Repository<Currency>,
    @InjectRepository(ExchangeRate)
    private exchangeRateRepository: Repository<ExchangeRate>,
    @InjectRepository(CurrencyPreference)
    private currencyPreferenceRepository: Repository<CurrencyPreference>
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit() {
    await this.seedBasicCurrencies();
  }
  /**
   * Idempotently insert USD/IRR and default locale preferences.
   * Does not set an exchange rate — admins configure that in the UI.
   */
  async seedBasicCurrencies(): Promise<void> {
    let createdCurrencies = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_CURRENCIES) {
      let currency = await this.currencyRepository.findOne({
        where: { code: basic.code },
      });
      if (!currency) {
        currency = await this.currencyRepository.save(
          this.currencyRepository.create({
            ...basic,
            isActive: true,
          })
        );
        createdCurrencies += 1;
      }
    }
    let createdPreferences = 0;
    for (const basic of BASIC_CURRENCY_PREFERENCES) {
      const existing = await this.currencyPreferenceRepository.findOne({
        where: { locale: basic.locale },
      });
      if (existing) {
        continue;
      }
      const currency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(basic.currencyCode);
      if (!currency) {
        continue;
      }
      await this.currencyPreferenceRepository.save(
        this.currencyPreferenceRepository.create({
          locale: basic.locale,
          currencyId: currency.id,
          isActive: true,
        })
      );
      createdPreferences += 1;
    }
    if (createdCurrencies > 0 || createdPreferences > 0) {
      this.logger.log(
        `Seeded ${createdCurrencies} currency(ies) and ${createdPreferences} preference(s)`
      );
    }
  }
  // =============== Currency Management ===============
  async findAllCurrencies(): Promise<Currency[]> {
    return this.currencyRepository.find({
      order: { isBaseCurrency: 'DESC', code: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async findCurrencyById(id: number): Promise<Currency | null> {
    return this.currencyRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
  }
  async findCurrencyByCode(code: string): Promise<Currency | null> {
    return this.currencyRepository.findOne({
      where: { code: code.toUpperCase() },
    });
  }
  async createCurrency(data: {
    code: string;
    name: string;
    symbol: string;
    decimalPlaces: number;
    isActive?: boolean;
    isBaseCurrency?: boolean;
  }): Promise<Currency> {
    // If setting as base currency, unset all others
    if (data.isBaseCurrency) {
      await this.currencyRepository.update(
        { isBaseCurrency: true },
        { isBaseCurrency: false }
      );
    }
    const currency = this.currencyRepository.create({
      ...data,
      code: data.code.toUpperCase(),
    });
    return this.currencyRepository.save(currency);
  }
  async updateCurrency(
    id: number,
    data: {
      code?: string;
      name?: string;
      symbol?: string;
      decimalPlaces?: number;
      isActive?: boolean;
      isBaseCurrency?: boolean;
    }
  ): Promise<Currency> {
    const currency = await this.findCurrencyById(id);
    if (!currency) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Currency with ID ${id} not found`);
    }
    // If setting as base currency, unset all others
    if (data.isBaseCurrency && !currency.isBaseCurrency) {
      await this.currencyRepository.update(
        { isBaseCurrency: true },
        { isBaseCurrency: false }
      );
    }
    Object.assign(currency, {
      ...data,
      code: data.code ? data.code.toUpperCase() : currency.code,
    });
    return this.currencyRepository.save(currency);
  }
  async getBaseCurrency(): Promise<Currency> {
    const baseCurrency = await this.currencyRepository.findOne({
      where: { isBaseCurrency: true, isActive: true },
    });
    if (!baseCurrency) {
      throw new NotFoundException('No base currency configured');
    }
    return baseCurrency;
  }
  // =============== Exchange Rate Management ===============
  async setExchangeRate(data: {
    fromCurrencyCode: string;
    toCurrencyCode: string;
    rate: number;
    effectiveDate?: Date;
    notes?: string;
    createdById?: string;
  }): Promise<ExchangeRate> {
    const fromCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(data.fromCurrencyCode);
    const toCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(data.toCurrencyCode);
    if (!fromCurrency) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `Currency ${data.fromCurrencyCode} not found`
      );
    }
    if (!toCurrency) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Currency ${data.toCurrencyCode} not found`);
    }
    if (data.rate <= 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Exchange rate must be greater than 0');
    }
    const exchangeRate = this.exchangeRateRepository.create({
      fromCurrencyId: fromCurrency.id,
      toCurrencyId: toCurrency.id,
      rate: data.rate,
      effectiveDate: data.effectiveDate || new Date(),
      notes: data.notes,
      createdById: data.createdById,
    });
    const saved = await this.exchangeRateRepository.save(exchangeRate);
    // Reload with relations to satisfy GraphQL schema
    return this.exchangeRateRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: saved.id },
      relations: ['fromCurrency', 'toCurrency', 'createdBy'],
    }) as Promise<ExchangeRate>;
  }
  async getCurrentExchangeRate(
    fromCurrencyCode: string,
    toCurrencyCode: string
  ): Promise<ExchangeRate | null> {
    const fromCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(fromCurrencyCode);
    const toCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(toCurrencyCode);
    if (!fromCurrency || !toCurrency) {
      return null;
    }
    // If same currency, return rate of 1
    if (fromCurrency.id === toCurrency.id) {
      return this.exchangeRateRepository.create({
        fromCurrencyId: fromCurrency.id,
        toCurrencyId: toCurrency.id,
        rate: 1,
        effectiveDate: new Date(),
        id: 0,
      });
    }
    const exchangeRate = await this.exchangeRateRepository.findOne({
      where: {
        fromCurrencyId: fromCurrency.id,
        toCurrencyId: toCurrency.id,
        effectiveDate: LessThanOrEqual(new Date()),
      },
      order: { effectiveDate: 'DESC' },
      relations: ['fromCurrency', 'toCurrency', 'createdBy'],
    });
    return exchangeRate;
  }
  async getExchangeRateHistory(
    fromCurrencyCode: string,
    toCurrencyCode: string,
    limit = 10
  ): Promise<ExchangeRate[]> {
    const fromCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(fromCurrencyCode);
    const toCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(toCurrencyCode);
    if (!fromCurrency || !toCurrency) {
      return [];
    }
    return this.exchangeRateRepository.find({
      where: {
        fromCurrencyId: fromCurrency.id,
        toCurrencyId: toCurrency.id,
      },
      order: { effectiveDate: 'DESC' },
      take: limit,
      relations: ['fromCurrency', 'toCurrency', 'createdBy'],
    });
  }
  async convertPrice(
    amount: number,
    fromCurrencyCode: string,
    toCurrencyCode: string
  ): Promise<{ amount: number; rate: number }> {
    const exchangeRate = await this.getCurrentExchangeRate(
      fromCurrencyCode,
      toCurrencyCode
    );
    if (!exchangeRate) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `No exchange rate found from ${fromCurrencyCode} to ${toCurrencyCode}`
      );
    }
    const convertedAmount = amount * exchangeRate.rate;
    const toCurrency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(toCurrencyCode);
    // Round based on decimal places
    const rounded = toCurrency
      ? Number(convertedAmount.toFixed(toCurrency.decimalPlaces))
      : convertedAmount;
    return {
      amount: rounded,
      rate: exchangeRate.rate,
    };
  }
  // =============== Currency Preference Management ===============
  async findAllCurrencyPreferences(): Promise<CurrencyPreference[]> {
    return this.currencyPreferenceRepository.find({
      relations: ['currency'],
      order: { locale: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async findCurrencyPreferenceByLocale(
    locale: string
  ): Promise<CurrencyPreference | null> {
    return this.currencyPreferenceRepository.findOne({
      where: { locale },
      relations: ['currency'],
    });
  }
  async setCurrencyPreference(
    locale: string,
    currencyCode: string
  ): Promise<CurrencyPreference> {
    const currency = await this.findCurrencyByCode(currencyCode);
    if (!currency) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`Currency ${currencyCode} not found`);
    }
    let preference = await this.findCurrencyPreferenceByLocale(locale);
    if (preference) {
      preference.currencyId = currency.id;
      preference.currency = currency;
    } else {
      preference = this.currencyPreferenceRepository.create({
        locale,
        currencyId: currency.id,
        currency,
      });
    }
    return this.currencyPreferenceRepository.save(preference);
  }
  async deleteCurrencyPreference(id: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const result = await this.currencyPreferenceRepository.delete(id);
    return result.affected ? result.affected > 0 : false;
  }
  async getCurrencyForLocale(locale: string): Promise<Currency | null> {
    const preference = await this.findCurrencyPreferenceByLocale(locale);
    return preference ? preference.currency : null;
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/customer-profile.service.ts">
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { CustomerProfile } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
export interface UpdateCustomerProfileInput {
  phone?: string;
  address?: string;
  city?: string;
  state?: string;
  zipCode?: string;
  country?: string;
  clothingSize?: string;
  shoeSize?: string;
  favorites?: string;
}
@Injectable()
export class CustomerProfileService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(CustomerProfile)
    private readonly customerProfileRepository: Repository<CustomerProfile>
  ) {}
  async getOrCreateProfile(userId: string): Promise<CustomerProfile> {
    let profile = await this.customerProfileRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId },
    });
    if (!profile) {
      profile = this.customerProfileRepository.create({ userId });
      profile = await this.customerProfileRepository.save(profile);
    }
    return profile;
  }
  async updateProfile(
    userId: string,
    input: UpdateCustomerProfileInput
  ): Promise<CustomerProfile> {
    const profile = await this.getOrCreateProfile(userId);
    Object.assign(profile, {
      phone: input.phone ?? profile.phone,
      address: input.address ?? profile.address,
      city: input.city ?? profile.city,
      state: input.state ?? profile.state,
      zipCode: input.zipCode ?? profile.zipCode,
      country: input.country ?? profile.country,
      clothingSize: input.clothingSize ?? profile.clothingSize,
      shoeSize: input.shoeSize ?? profile.shoeSize,
      favorites: input.favorites ?? profile.favorites,
    });
    return this.customerProfileRepository.save(profile);
  }
  async getProfile(userId: string): Promise<CustomerProfile | null> {
    return this.customerProfileRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId },
    });
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/image-upload.service.ts">
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { Request } from 'express';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as multer from 'multer';
import * as path from 'path';
@Injectable()
export class ImageUploadService {
  private readonly uploadDir: string;
  constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {
    this.uploadDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads', 'products');
    this.ensureUploadDirectoryExists();
  }
  private ensureUploadDirectoryExists() {
    if (!fs.existsSync(this.uploadDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(this.uploadDir, { recursive: true });
    }
  }
  getMulterConfig() {
    return {
      storage: multer.diskStorage({
        destination: (
          req: Request,
          file: Express.Multer.File,
          cb: (error: Error | null, destination: string) => void
        ) => {
          cb(null, this.uploadDir);
        },
        filename: (
          req: Request,
          file: Express.Multer.File,
          cb: (error: Error | null, filename: string) => void
        ) => {
          const uniqueSuffix =
            Date.now() + '-' + Math.round(Math.random() * 1e9);
          cb(null, uniqueSuffix + path.extname(file.originalname));
        },
      }),
      fileFilter: (
        req: Request,
        file: Express.Multer.File,
        cb: (error: Error | null, acceptFile: boolean) => void
      ) => {
        if (file.mimetype.match(/\/(jpg|jpeg|png|gif)$/)) {
          cb(null, true);
        } else {
          cb(new Error('Only image files are allowed!'), false);
        }
      },
      limits: {
        fileSize: 5 * 1024 * 1024, // 5MB limit
      },
    };
  }
  getImageUrl(filename: string): string {
    return `/uploads/products/${filename}`;
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PinoLogger } from 'nestjs-pino';
@Injectable()
export class PaymentLogger {
  constructor(private readonly logger: PinoLogger) {
    this.logger.setContext(PaymentLogger.name);
  }
  logPaymentInitiated(input: {
    orderId?: string;
    userId?: string;
    amount: number;
    currency: string;
    gateway: string;
  }) {
    this.logger.info(
      {
        event: 'payment_initiated',
        orderId: input.orderId,
        userId: input.userId,
        amount: input.amount,
        currency: input.currency,
        gateway: input.gateway,
      },
      'Payment initiated'
    );
  }
  logGatewayResponse(input: {
    orderId?: string;
    authority?: string;
    code: number;
    message: string;
    gateway: string;
  }) {
    this.logger.info(
      {
        event: 'payment_gateway_response',
        orderId: input.orderId,
        authority: input.authority,
        code: input.code,
        message: input.message,
        gateway: input.gateway,
      },
      'Payment gateway responded'
    );
  }
  logVerificationResult(input: {
    orderId?: string;
    authority: string;
    amount: number;
    code: number;
    message: string;
    refId?: number;
  }) {
    this.logger.info(
      {
        event: 'payment_verification_result',
        orderId: input.orderId,
        authority: input.authority,
        amount: input.amount,
        code: input.code,
        message: input.message,
        refId: input.refId,
      },
      'Payment verification finished'
    );
  }
  logOrderConfirmationFailed(orderId: string, error: unknown) {
    this.logger.error(
      {
        event: 'order_confirmation_failed',
        orderId,
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? { name: error.name, message: error.message }
            : error,
      },
      'Failed to confirm order after successful payment'
    );
  }
  logOrderCancellationFailed(orderId: string, error: unknown) {
    this.logger.error(
      {
        event: 'order_cancellation_failed',
        orderId,
        error:
          error instanceof Error
            ? { name: error.name, message: error.message }
            : error,
      },
      'Failed to cancel order after failed payment'
    );
  }
}

import {
  formatProductInfoColorNames,
  orderedColorsFromLinks,
  serializeProductInfoColorHexes,
} from './product-info-colors.util';
describe('product-info-colors.util', () => {
  const red = { id: 1, name: 'Red', hexCode: '#ff0000' } as never;
  const blue = { id: 2, name: 'Blue', hexCode: '#0000ff' } as never;
  it('orders colors by position', () => {
    const links = [
      { position: 1, color: blue },
      { position: 0, color: red },
    ] as never[];
    expect(orderedColorsFromLinks(links)).toEqual([red, blue]);
  });
  it('serializes hex codes and formats names', () => {
    const links = [
      { position: 0, color: red },
      { position: 1, color: blue },
    ] as never[];
    expect(serializeProductInfoColorHexes(links)).toBe('#ff0000,#0000ff');
    expect(formatProductInfoColorNames(links)).toBe('Red / Blue');
  });
  it('handles empty links', () => {
    expect(orderedColorsFromLinks(null)).toEqual([]);
    expect(serializeProductInfoColorHexes([])).toBeUndefined();
    expect(formatProductInfoColorNames(undefined)).toBe('');
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/product-info-colors.util.ts">
import { Color, ProductInfoColor } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
export function orderedColorsFromLinks(
  colorLinks?: ProductInfoColor[] | null
): Color[] {
  if (!colorLinks?.length) {
    return [];
  }
  return [...colorLinks]
    .sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position)
    .map((link) => link.color)
    .filter((color): color is Color => !!color);
}
export function serializeProductInfoColorHexes(
  colorLinks?: ProductInfoColor[] | null
): string | undefined {
  const hexes = orderedColorsFromLinks(colorLinks).map((c) => c.hexCode);
  return hexes.length ? hexes.join(',') : undefined;
}
export function formatProductInfoColorNames(
  colorLinks?: ProductInfoColor[] | null
): string {
  return orderedColorsFromLinks(colorLinks)
    .map((c) => c.name || c.hexCode)
    .join(' / ');
}

import {
  createConnection,
  parseOffset,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
describe('relay-connection', () => {
  describe('parseOffset', () => {
    it('returns 0 for falsy or empty values', () => {
      expect(parseOffset(undefined)).toBe(0);
      expect(parseOffset(null)).toBe(0);
      expect(parseOffset('')).toBe(0);
    });
    it('returns 0 for UUIDs', () => {
      expect(parseOffset('123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000')).toBe(0);
    });
    it('parses raw integer string', () => {
      expect(parseOffset('12')).toBe(12);
      expect(parseOffset(' 24 ')).toBe(24);
    });
    it('parses cursor:offset string', () => {
      expect(parseOffset('cursor:12')).toBe(12);
    });
    it('parses base64 encoded cursor:offset and numeric strings', () => {
      const b64Cursor = Buffer.from('cursor:36').toString('base64');
      expect(parseOffset(b64Cursor)).toBe(36);
      const b64Num = Buffer.from('48').toString('base64');
      expect(parseOffset(b64Num)).toBe(48);
    });
  });
  describe('createConnection', () => {
    const products = [
      { id: 101, name: 'Product 1' },
      { id: 102, name: 'Product 2' },
      { id: 103, name: 'Product 3' },
    ];
    it('creates offset-based connection for first page', () => {
      const conn = createConnection(products, 10, 3, undefined);
      expect(conn.edges).toHaveLength(3);
      expect(conn.edges[0].cursor).toBe('1');
      expect(conn.edges[2].cursor).toBe('3');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.endCursor).toBe('3');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasNextPage).toBe(true);
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasPreviousPage).toBe(false);
      expect(conn.totalCount).toBe(10);
    });
    it('creates offset-based connection for middle page', () => {
      const conn = createConnection(products, 10, 3, '3');
      expect(conn.edges[0].cursor).toBe('4');
      expect(conn.edges[2].cursor).toBe('6');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.endCursor).toBe('6');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasNextPage).toBe(true);
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasPreviousPage).toBe(true);
    });
    it('creates offset-based connection for final page', () => {
      const lastPageProducts = [{ id: 110, name: 'Product 10' }];
      const conn = createConnection(lastPageProducts, 10, 3, '9');
      expect(conn.edges).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(conn.edges[0].cursor).toBe('10');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.endCursor).toBe('10');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasNextPage).toBe(false);
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasPreviousPage).toBe(true);
    });
    it('handles UUID-based cursor correctly', () => {
      const uuid = '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000';
      const users = [
        { id: '223e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001', name: 'User 1' },
        { id: '323e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174002', name: 'User 2' },
      ];
      const conn = createConnection(users, 5, 2, uuid);
      expect(conn.edges[0].cursor).toBe('223e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174001');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.endCursor).toBe('323e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174002');
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasNextPage).toBe(true);
      expect(conn.pageInfo.hasPreviousPage).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/site-language.service.ts">
import {
  Injectable,
  Logger,
  NotFoundException,
  BadRequestException,
  OnModuleInit,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { SiteLanguage } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import {
  CreateSiteLanguageInput,
  UpdateSiteLanguageInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
export const BASIC_LANGUAGES: Array<{
  code: string;
  name: string;
  nativeName: string;
  isRTL: boolean;
  isActive: boolean;
  isDefault: boolean;
}> = [
  {
    code: 'fa',
    name: 'Persian',
    nativeName: 'فارسی',
    isRTL: true,
    isActive: true,
    isDefault: true,
  },
  {
    code: 'en',
    name: 'English',
    nativeName: 'English',
    isRTL: false,
    isActive: true,
    isDefault: false,
  },
];
@Injectable()
export class SiteLanguageService implements OnModuleInit {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SiteLanguageService.name);
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(SiteLanguage)
    private readonly siteLanguageRepository: Repository<SiteLanguage>
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit() {
    await this.seedBasicLanguages();
  }
  async seedBasicLanguages(): Promise<void> {
    for (const basic of BASIC_LANGUAGES) {
      const existing = await this.siteLanguageRepository.findOne({
        where: { code: basic.code },
      });
      if (!existing) {
        await this.siteLanguageRepository.save(
          this.siteLanguageRepository.create(basic)
        );
        this.logger.log(`Seeded site language: ${basic.name} (${basic.code})`);
      }
    }
  }
  async findAll(activeOnly = false): Promise<SiteLanguage[]> {
    if (activeOnly) {
      return this.siteLanguageRepository.find({
        where: { isActive: true },
        order: { isDefault: 'DESC', id: 'ASC' },
      });
    }
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.find({
      order: { isDefault: 'DESC', id: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async findByCode(code: string): Promise<SiteLanguage | null> {
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.findOne({
      where: { code },
    });
  }
  async findById(id: number): Promise<SiteLanguage | null> {
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.findOne({
      where: { id },
    });
  }
  async getDefaultLanguage(): Promise<SiteLanguage | null> {
    const defaultLang = await this.siteLanguageRepository.findOne({
      where: { isDefault: true, isActive: true },
    });
    if (defaultLang) return defaultLang;
    // Fallback to first active language
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.findOne({
      where: { isActive: true },
      order: { id: 'ASC' },
    });
  }
  async create(input: CreateSiteLanguageInput): Promise<SiteLanguage> {
    const code = input.code.trim().toLowerCase();
    const existing = await this.findByCode(code);
    if (existing) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Language with code "${code}" already exists.`
      );
    }
    if (input.isDefault) {
      // Unset previous default
      await this.siteLanguageRepository.update(
        { isDefault: true },
        { isDefault: false }
      );
    }
    const language = this.siteLanguageRepository.create({
      code,
      name: input.name.trim(),
      nativeName: input.nativeName.trim(),
      isRTL: input.isRTL ?? false,
      isActive: input.isActive ?? true,
      isDefault: input.isDefault ?? false,
    });
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.save(language);
  }
  async update(
    id: number,
    input: UpdateSiteLanguageInput
  ): Promise<SiteLanguage> {
    const language = await this.findById(id);
    if (!language) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`SiteLanguage with ID ${id} not found.`);
    }
    if (input.isDefault) {
      await this.siteLanguageRepository.update(
        { isDefault: true },
        { isDefault: false }
      );
    }
    if (input.name !== undefined) language.name = input.name.trim();
    if (input.nativeName !== undefined)
      language.nativeName = input.nativeName.trim();
    if (input.isRTL !== undefined) language.isRTL = input.isRTL;
    if (input.isActive !== undefined) language.isActive = input.isActive;
    if (input.isDefault !== undefined) language.isDefault = input.isDefault;
    return this.siteLanguageRepository.save(language);
  }
  async delete(id: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const language = await this.findById(id);
    if (!language) {
      throw new NotFoundException(`SiteLanguage with ID ${id} not found.`);
    }
    if (language.isDefault) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Cannot delete default site language.');
    }
    await this.siteLanguageRepository.delete(id);
    return true;
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/token.service.ts">
import { Injectable, Optional, OnModuleInit } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectDataSource } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { DataSource } from 'typeorm';
import { randomBytes, createHash } from 'crypto';
interface TokenData {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  userType: string;
  tokenType: string;
  expiresAt: Date;
}
@Injectable()
export class TokenService implements OnModuleInit {
  private tokens: Map<string, TokenData> = new Map();
  private tableInitialized = false;
  constructor(
    @Optional()
    @InjectDataSource()
    private readonly dataSource?: DataSource
  ) {}
  async onModuleInit(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.dataSource) {
      await this.ensureTableExists();
    }
  }
  private async ensureTableExists(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.tableInitialized) return;
    try {
      await this.dataSource!.query(`
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auth_action_tokens (
          token_hash VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,
          user_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
          email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
          user_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
          token_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
          expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
          created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auth_action_tokens_user_id ON auth_action_tokens(user_id);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auth_action_tokens_expires_at ON auth_action_tokens(expires_at);
      `);
      this.tableInitialized = true;
    } catch (error) {
      // Table creation might fail in tests without a real database
      // Fall back to in-memory storage
      console.warn('Failed to initialize auth_action_tokens table, falling back to in-memory storage:', error);
    }
  }
  private hashToken(token: string): string {
    return createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');
  }
  async generateToken(
    userId: string,
    email: string,
    userType: string,
    tokenType: string,
    expiresInHours = 24
  ): Promise<string> {
    const token = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
    const expiresAt = new Date();
    expiresAt.setHours(expiresAt.getHours() + expiresInHours);
    const tokenData: TokenData = {
      userId,
      email,
      userType,
      tokenType,
      expiresAt,
    };
    if (this.dataSource && this.tableInitialized) {
      const tokenHash = this.hashToken(token);
      try {
        await this.storeInDatabase(tokenHash, tokenData);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to store token in database:', err);
        // Fall back to in-memory
        this.tokens.set(token, tokenData);
      }
    } else {
      // In-memory fallback for tests or when DB is not available
      this.tokens.set(token, tokenData);
    }
    return token;
  }
  private async storeInDatabase(tokenHash: string, tokenData: TokenData): Promise<void> {
    await this.dataSource!.query(
      `INSERT INTO auth_action_tokens (token_hash, user_id, email, user_type, token_type, expires_at)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)`,
      [tokenHash, tokenData.userId, tokenData.email, tokenData.userType, tokenData.tokenType, tokenData.expiresAt]
    );
  }
  async validateToken(token: string): Promise<TokenData | null> {
    const tokenHash = this.hashToken(token);
    if (this.dataSource && this.tableInitialized) {
      return this.validateInDatabase(tokenHash);
    }
    // In-memory fallback
    return this.validateInMemory(token);
  }
  private async validateInDatabase(tokenHash: string): Promise<TokenData | null> {
    try {
      // Atomic consume: DELETE ... RETURNING ensures single-use across instances
      const result = await this.dataSource!.query(
        `DELETE FROM auth_action_tokens
         WHERE token_hash = $1 AND expires_at > NOW()
         RETURNING user_id, email, user_type, token_type, expires_at`,
        [tokenHash]
      );
      if (!result || result.length === 0) {
        return null;
      }
      const row = result[0];
      return {
        userId: row.user_id,
        email: row.email,
        userType: row.user_type,
        tokenType: row.token_type,
        expiresAt: new Date(row.expires_at),
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to validate token in database:', error);
      // Fall back to in-memory
      return this.validateInMemoryByHash(tokenHash);
    }
  }
  private validateInMemory(token: string): TokenData | null {
    const tokenData = this.tokens.get(token);
    if (!tokenData) {
      return null;
    }
    if (new Date() > tokenData.expiresAt) {
      this.tokens.delete(token);
      return null;
    }
    // Remove the token after validation (one-time use)
    this.tokens.delete(token);
    return tokenData;
  }
  private validateInMemoryByHash(tokenHash: string): TokenData | null {
    // For in-memory fallback, we need to find by raw token
    // This is only used when DB fails, so we iterate
    for (const [rawToken, tokenData] of this.tokens.entries()) {
      if (this.hashToken(rawToken) === tokenHash) {
        if (new Date() > tokenData.expiresAt) {
          this.tokens.delete(rawToken);
          return null;
        }
        this.tokens.delete(rawToken);
        return tokenData;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  // Helper method for tests to clear in-memory storage
  clearMemoryStore(): void {
    this.tokens.clear();
  }
  // Helper method for tests to check if using database
  isUsingDatabase(): boolean {
    return !!(this.dataSource && this.tableInitialized);
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/user.service.ts">
import { User, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { CreateUserInput } from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import {
  Connection,
  ConnectionArgs,
  createConnection,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
@Injectable()
export class UserService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(User)
    private userRepository: Repository<User>
  ) {}
  async findAllPaginated({
    first = 10,
    after,
    searchTerm,
    role,
  }: ConnectionArgs & { role?: UserRole }): Promise<Connection<User>> {
    const query = this.userRepository.createQueryBuilder('user');
    if (role) {
      query.andWhere('user.role = :role', { role });
    }
    if (searchTerm) {
      query.andWhere(
        '(LOWER(user.name) LIKE LOWER(:searchTerm) OR LOWER(user.lastName) LIKE LOWER(:searchTerm) OR LOWER(user.email) LIKE LOWER(:searchTerm) OR LOWER(user.username) LIKE LOWER(:searchTerm))',
        { searchTerm: `%${searchTerm}%` }
      );
    }
    if (after) {
      query.andWhere('user.id > :after', { after });
    }
    const [users, totalCount] = await query
      .orderBy('user.id', 'ASC')
      .take(first)
      .getManyAndCount();
    return createConnection(users, totalCount, first, after);
  }
  async findByEmail(email: string): Promise<User | null> {
    return this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { email } });
  }
  async getUserById(id: string): Promise<User | null> {
    return this.userRepository.findOne({ where: { id } });
  }
  async createUser(createUserInput: CreateUserInput): Promise<User> {
    // Note: Password should already be hashed by the caller (auth.service)
    // This service is just for CRUD operations
    const user = this.userRepository.create({
      ...createUserInput,
    });
    return this.userRepository.save(user);
  }
  async updateUser(id: string, updateData: Partial<User>): Promise<User> {
    const user = await this.getUserById(id);
    if (!user) {
      throw new Error('User not found');
    }
    Object.assign(user, updateData);
    return this.userRepository.save(user);
  }
}

import {
  Field,
  Float,
  ID,
  Int,
  ObjectType,
  registerEnumType,
} from '@nestjs/graphql';
import {
  Column,
  CreateDateColumn,
  Entity,
  JoinColumn,
  ManyToOne,
  OneToMany,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  UpdateDateColumn,
} from 'typeorm';
import { Product } from './product.entity';
import { SellerInfo, ShippingPaymentMode } from './seller-info.entity';
export enum OrderStatus {
  PENDING = 'PENDING',
  CONFIRMED = 'CONFIRMED',
  PROCESSING = 'PROCESSING',
  SHIPPED = 'SHIPPED',
  DELIVERED = 'DELIVERED',
  CANCELLED = 'CANCELLED',
  REFUNDED = 'REFUNDED',
}
registerEnumType(OrderStatus, {
  name: 'OrderStatus',
});
export enum OrderShippingMethod {
  VIP = 'vip',
  EXPRESS = 'express',
  PICKUP = 'pickup',
}
registerEnumType(OrderShippingMethod, {
  name: 'OrderShippingMethod',
});
@ObjectType()
@Entity('orders')
export class Order {
  @Field(() => ID)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  orderNumber: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  customerEmail: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  customerPhone: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  customerName: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  shippingAddress: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  city: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  state: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  zipCode: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  @Column()
  country: string;
  @Field(() => OrderStatus)
  @Column({
    type: 'enum',
    enum: OrderStatus,
    default: OrderStatus.PENDING,
  })
  status: OrderStatus;
  @Field(() => Boolean, { defaultValue: false })
  @Column({ type: 'boolean', default: false })
  stockReserved!: boolean;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  subtotal: number;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  shippingCost: number;
  @Field(() => String, { defaultValue: 'vip' })
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', length: 20, default: 'vip' })
  shippingMethod?: string;
  @Field(() => ShippingPaymentMode, {
    defaultValue: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
  })
  @Column({
    type: 'enum',

    default: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
  })
  shippingPaymentMode?: ShippingPaymentMode;
  @Field(() => Float)
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2 })
  total: number;
// Payment metadata for verification
@Field(() => Float, { nullable: true })
@Column('decimal', { precision: 12, scale: 2, nullable: true })
paymentAmount?: number | null;
@Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
@Column({ nullable: true })
paymentCurrency?: string | null;
@Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
@Column({ nullable: true })
paymentAuthority?: string | null;
  // Seller snapshot fields - preserve seller info at order time

  notes?: string;

<file path="libs/server/entities/src/lib/seller-info.entity.ts">
import { ObjectType, Field, Int, Float, registerEnumType } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import {
  Entity,
  Column,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  Relation,
  OneToOne,
  JoinColumn,
  OneToMany,
} from 'typeorm';
import { User } from './user.entity';
import { SellerProduct } from './seller-product.entity';
import { Connection, Edge, PageInfo } from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
export enum ShippingPaymentMode {
  PAY_ON_DELIVERY = 'PAY_ON_DELIVERY',
  PAY_ONLINE = 'PAY_ONLINE',
}
registerEnumType(ShippingPaymentMode, {
  name: 'ShippingPaymentMode',
});
@ObjectType()
@Entity()
export class SellerInfo {
  @Field(() => Int)
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id: number;
  @Field()
  @Column()
  storeName: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  phone?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  address?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  city?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  state?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  zipCode?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  country?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  businessName?: string;
  @Field({ defaultValue: true })
  @Column({ default: true })
  isActive: boolean;
  @Field({ defaultValue: false })
  @Column({ default: false })
  canManageCatalog: boolean;
  @Field(() => Float, { defaultValue: 0 })
  @Column('decimal', { precision: 10, scale: 2, default: 0 })
  shippingFee: number;
  @Field(() => ShippingPaymentMode, {
    defaultValue: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
  })
  @Column({
    type: 'enum',
    enum: ShippingPaymentMode,
    default: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
  })
  shippingPaymentMode?: ShippingPaymentMode;
  @Field(() => User)
  @OneToOne(() => User)
  @JoinColumn()
  user: Relation<User>;
  @OneToMany(() => SellerProduct, (sellerProduct) => sellerProduct.seller)
  sellerProducts: SellerProduct[];
}
@ObjectType()
export class SellerEdge implements Edge<SellerInfo> {
  @Field(() => SellerInfo)
  node: SellerInfo;
  @Field()
  cursor: string;
}
@ObjectType()
export class SellerConnection implements Connection<SellerInfo> {
  @Field(() => [SellerEdge])
  edges: SellerEdge[];
  @Field(() => PageInfo)
  pageInfo: PageInfo;
  @Field(() => Int)
  totalCount: number;
}
