<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/auth.service.spec.ts">
import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { UnauthorizedException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { createHash } from 'crypto';
import {
  AuthService,
  REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
} from './auth.service';
import { RefreshToken, User, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { UserService } from './user.service';
import { EmailService } from './email.service';
import { TokenService } from './token.service';
describe('AuthService', () => {
  let service: AuthService;
  let userService: {
    findByEmail: jest.Mock;
    getUserById: jest.Mock;
    createUser: jest.Mock;
    updateUser: jest.Mock;
  };
  let jwtService: { sign: jest.Mock; verify: jest.Mock };
  let refreshTokenRepository: {
    create: jest.Mock;
    save: jest.Mock;
    findOne: jest.Mock;
    update: jest.Mock;
  };
  let tokenService: {
    generateToken: jest.Mock;
    validateToken: jest.Mock;
  };
  const mockUser = {
    id: 'user-1',
    email: 'user@test.com',
    role: UserRole.CUSTOMER,
    name: 'Test',
    lastName: 'User',
    username: 'user@test.com',
    password: 'hashed',
  } as User;
  beforeEach(async () => {
    userService = {
      findByEmail: jest.fn(),
      getUserById: jest.fn(),
      createUser: jest.fn(),
      updateUser: jest.fn(),
    };
    jwtService = {
      sign: jest.fn().mockReturnValue('access.jwt.token'),
      verify: jest.fn(),
    };
    refreshTokenRepository = {
      create: jest.fn((entity) => entity),
      save: jest.fn(async (entity) => ({
        id: 'rt-1',
        ...entity,
      })),
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      update: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ affected: 1 }),
    };
    tokenService = {
      generateToken: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue('reset-token-123'),
      validateToken: jest.fn(),
    };
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        AuthService,
        { provide: UserService, useValue: userService },
        { provide: JwtService, useValue: jwtService },
        { provide: EmailService, useValue: { sendEmail: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) } },
        { provide: TokenService, useValue: tokenService },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(RefreshToken),
          useValue: refreshTokenRepository,
        },
      ],
    }).compile();
    service = module.get(AuthService);
  });
  describe('login', () => {
    it('issues access JWT and stores hashed refresh token', async () => {
      const tokens = await service.login(mockUser);
      expect(jwtService.sign).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        email: mockUser.email,
        sub: mockUser.id,
        role: mockUser.role,
      });
      expect(tokens.access_token).toBe('access.jwt.token');
      expect(tokens.refresh_token).toEqual(expect.any(String));
      expect(tokens.refresh_token.length).toBeGreaterThan(20);
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          userId: mockUser.id,
          tokenHash: createHash('sha256')
            .update(tokens.refresh_token)
            .digest('hex'),
        })
      );
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalled();
      const saved = refreshTokenRepository.create.mock.calls[0][0];
      const expiresAt = saved.expiresAt as Date;
      const delta = expiresAt.getTime() - Date.now();
      expect(delta).toBeGreaterThan(REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS - 5_000);
      expect(delta).toBeLessThan(REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS + 5_000);
    });
  });
  describe('refresh', () => {
    it('rotates refresh token and returns a new pair', async () => {
      const { refresh_token: raw } = await service.login(mockUser);
      const tokenHash = createHash('sha256').update(raw).digest('hex');
      const stored: RefreshToken = {
        id: 'rt-old',
        userId: mockUser.id,
        tokenHash,
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
        createdAt: new Date(),
        revokedAt: null,
        user: mockUser,
      };
      refreshTokenRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(stored);
      userService.getUserById.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      jwtService.sign.mockReturnValue('new.access.jwt');
      const tokens = await service.refresh(raw);
      expect(tokens.access_token).toBe('new.access.jwt');
      expect(tokens.refresh_token).toEqual(expect.any(String));
      expect(tokens.refresh_token).not.toBe(raw);
      expect(stored.revokedAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(stored);
      // New refresh token persisted after rotation
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.save.mock.calls.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
    });
    it('rejects missing refresh tokens', async () => {
      refreshTokenRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.refresh('unknown')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(
        UnauthorizedException
      );
    });
    it('rejects revoked refresh tokens', async () => {
      refreshTokenRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'rt-1',
        userId: mockUser.id,
        tokenHash: 'hash',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
        createdAt: new Date(),
        revokedAt: new Date(),
      });
      await expect(service.refresh('raw')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(
        UnauthorizedException
      );
    });
    it('rejects and revokes expired refresh tokens', async () => {
      const expired: RefreshToken = {
        id: 'rt-1',
        userId: mockUser.id,
        tokenHash: 'hash',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() - 1_000),
        createdAt: new Date(),
        revokedAt: null,
        user: mockUser,
      };
      refreshTokenRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(expired);
      await expect(service.refresh('raw')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(
        UnauthorizedException
      );
      expect(expired.revokedAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expired);
    });
    it('rejects when user no longer exists and revokes the token', async () => {
      const stored: RefreshToken = {
        id: 'rt-1',
        userId: 'missing',
        tokenHash: 'hash',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
        createdAt: new Date(),
        revokedAt: null,
        user: mockUser,
      };
      refreshTokenRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(stored);
      userService.getUserById.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.refresh('raw')).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(
        UnauthorizedException
      );
      expect(stored.revokedAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
    });
  });
  describe('revokeRefreshTokenByRaw', () => {
    it('no-ops when token is missing', async () => {
      await service.revokeRefreshTokenByRaw(null);
      await service.revokeRefreshTokenByRaw(undefined);
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.findOne).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('revokes an active refresh token', async () => {
      const stored: RefreshToken = {
        id: 'rt-1',
        userId: mockUser.id,
        tokenHash: 'hash',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 60_000),
        createdAt: new Date(),
        revokedAt: null,
        user: mockUser,
      };
      refreshTokenRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(stored);
      await service.revokeRefreshTokenByRaw('raw-token');
      expect(stored.revokedAt).toBeInstanceOf(Date);
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(stored);
    });
    it('does not re-revoke already revoked tokens', async () => {
      refreshTokenRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue({
        id: 'rt-1',
        revokedAt: new Date(),
      });
      await service.revokeRefreshTokenByRaw('raw-token');
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('revokeAllUserRefreshTokens', () => {
    it('revokes all non-revoked refresh tokens for a user', async () => {
      await service.revokeAllUserRefreshTokens('user-1');
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        { userId: 'user-1', revokedAt: undefined },
        { revokedAt: expect.any(Date) }
      );
    });
  });
  describe('verifyToken', () => {
    it('returns user when JWT is valid', async () => {
      jwtService.verify.mockReturnValue({ sub: mockUser.id });
      userService.getUserById.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      await expect(service.verifyToken('good')).resolves.toBe(mockUser);
    });
    it('returns null when JWT is invalid', async () => {
      jwtService.verify.mockImplementation(() => {
        throw new Error('jwt expired');
      });
      await expect(service.verifyToken('bad')).resolves.toBeNull();
    });
  });
  describe('initiatePasswordSetup', () => {
    it('generates token and sends email', async () => {
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      tokenService.generateToken.mockReturnValue('setup-token-abc');
      await service.initiatePasswordSetup('user@test.com', 'https://saintbala.com');
      expect(tokenService.generateToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        mockUser.id,
        mockUser.email,
        mockUser.role,
        'password_setup'
      );
    });
    it('throws when user not found', async () => {
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.initiatePasswordSetup('unknown@test.com', 'https://saintbala.com'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('rejects attacker origin and does not call userService or emailService', async () => {
      const emailService = { sendEmail: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) };
      const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
        providers: [
          AuthService,
          { provide: UserService, useValue: userService },
          { provide: JwtService, useValue: jwtService },
          { provide: EmailService, useValue: emailService },
          { provide: TokenService, useValue: tokenService },
          {
            provide: getRepositoryToken(RefreshToken),
            useValue: refreshTokenRepository,
          },
        ],
      }).compile();
      const svc = module.get(AuthService);
      await expect(svc.initiatePasswordSetup('user@test.com', 'https://evil.com'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(emailService.sendEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('accepts origin from ALLOWED_ORIGINS env', async () => {
      process.env['ALLOWED_ORIGINS'] = 'https://custom.example.com';
      try {
        userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
        tokenService.generateToken.mockReturnValue('setup-token-abc');
        await service.initiatePasswordSetup('user@test.com', 'https://custom.example.com');
        expect(tokenService.generateToken).toHaveBeenCalled();
      } finally {
        delete process.env['ALLOWED_ORIGINS'];
      }
    });
    it('strips path from baseUrl and builds link from origin only', async () => {
      const emailService = { sendEmail: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) };
      const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
        providers: [
          AuthService,
          { provide: UserService, useValue: userService },
          { provide: JwtService, useValue: jwtService },
          { provide: EmailService, useValue: emailService },
          { provide: TokenService, useValue: tokenService },
          {
            provide: getRepositoryToken(RefreshToken),
            useValue: refreshTokenRepository,
          },
        ],

      tokenService.generateToken.mockReturnValue('setup-token-abc');

      expect(html).not.toContain('/some/path');
    });  });
  describe('setupPassword', () => {

      const tokenData = {
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'user@test.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_setup',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      };
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(tokenData);
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      userService.updateUser.mockResolvedValue({ ...mockUser, password: 'new-hashed' });
      const result = await service.setupPassword('valid-token', 'NewPass123!');
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith('valid-token');
      expect(userService.updateUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user-1', {
        password: expect.any(String),
      });
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        { userId: 'user-1', revokedAt: undefined },
        { revokedAt: expect.any(Date) }
      );
      expect(result.password).toBe('new-hashed');
    });
    it('throws BadRequestException for invalid/expired token', async () => {
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.setupPassword('invalid-token', 'NewPass123!'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('throws BadRequestException for wrong token type', async () => {
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue({
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'user@test.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_reset', // Wrong type
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      });
      await expect(service.setupPassword('wrong-type-token', 'NewPass123!'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('throws BadRequestException when user not found', async () => {
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue({
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'user@test.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_setup',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      });
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.setupPassword('valid-token', 'NewPass123!'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('does not revoke tokens or change password when token is invalid', async () => {
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.setupPassword('invalid-token', 'NewPass123!'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('initiateForgotPassword', () => {
    it('generates token and sends email when user exists', async () => {
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      tokenService.generateToken.mockReturnValue('reset-token-xyz');
      await service.initiateForgotPassword('user@test.com', 'https://saintbala.com');
      expect(tokenService.generateToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        mockUser.id,
        mockUser.email,
        mockUser.role,
        'password_reset'
      );
    });
    it('silently returns when user does not exist (security)', async () => {
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.initiateForgotPassword('unknown@test.com', 'https://saintbala.com'))
        .resolves.toBeUndefined();
    });
    it('rejects attacker origin and does not call userService or emailService', async () => {
      const emailService = { sendEmail: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) };
      const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
        providers: [
          AuthService,
          { provide: UserService, useValue: userService },
          { provide: JwtService, useValue: jwtService },
          { provide: EmailService, useValue: emailService },
          { provide: TokenService, useValue: tokenService },
          {
            provide: getRepositoryToken(RefreshToken),
            useValue: refreshTokenRepository,
          },
        ],
      }).compile();
      const svc = module.get(AuthService);
      await expect(svc.initiateForgotPassword('user@test.com', 'https://evil.com'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.findByEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(emailService.sendEmail).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('accepts origin from ALLOWED_ORIGINS env', async () => {
      process.env['ALLOWED_ORIGINS'] = 'https://custom.example.com';
      try {
        userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
        tokenService.generateToken.mockReturnValue('reset-token-xyz');
        await service.initiateForgotPassword('user@test.com', 'https://custom.example.com');
        expect(tokenService.generateToken).toHaveBeenCalled();
      } finally {
        delete process.env['ALLOWED_ORIGINS'];
      }
    });
    it('strips path from baseUrl and builds link from origin only', async () => {
      const emailService = { sendEmail: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined) };
      const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
        providers: [
          AuthService,
          { provide: UserService, useValue: userService },
          { provide: JwtService, useValue: jwtService },
          { provide: EmailService, useValue: emailService },
          { provide: TokenService, useValue: tokenService },
          {
            provide: getRepositoryToken(RefreshToken),
            useValue: refreshTokenRepository,
          },
        ],
      }).compile();
      const svc = module.get(AuthService);
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      tokenService.generateToken.mockReturnValue('reset-token-xyz');
      await svc.initiateForgotPassword('user@test.com', 'https://saintbala.com/some/path');
      expect(emailService.sendEmail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      const html = emailService.sendEmail.mock.calls[0][2] as string;
      expect(html).toContain('https://saintbala.com/reset-password/reset-token-xyz');
      expect(html).not.toContain('/some/path');
    });  });
  describe('resetPassword', () => {
    it('validates token, updates password, revokes all refresh tokens, and consumes token', async () => {
      const tokenData = {
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'user@test.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_reset',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      };
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(tokenData);
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      userService.updateUser.mockResolvedValue({ ...mockUser, password: 'new-hashed' });
      const result = await service.resetPassword('valid-reset-token', 'NewPass123!');
      expect(tokenService.validateToken).toHaveBeenCalledWith('valid-reset-token');
      expect(userService.updateUser).toHaveBeenCalledWith('user-1', {
        password: expect.any(String),
      });
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        { userId: 'user-1', revokedAt: undefined },
        { revokedAt: expect.any(Date) }
      );
      expect(result.password).toBe('new-hashed');
    });
    it('throws BadRequestException for invalid/expired reset token', async () => {
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.resetPassword('invalid-token', 'NewPass123!'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('throws BadRequestException for wrong token type', async () => {
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue({
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'user@test.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_setup', // Wrong type
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      });
      await expect(service.resetPassword('wrong-type-token', 'NewPass123!'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('throws BadRequestException when user not found', async () => {
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue({
        userId: 'user-1',
        email: 'user@test.com',
        userType: 'CUSTOMER',
        tokenType: 'password_reset',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
      });
      userService.findByEmail.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.resetPassword('valid-token', 'NewPass123!'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('does not revoke tokens or change password when reset token is invalid', async () => {
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(service.resetPassword('invalid-token', 'NewPass123!'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('does not revoke tokens or change password when reset token is expired', async () => {
      tokenService.validateToken.mockResolvedValue(null); // Expired tokens return null
      await expect(service.resetPassword('expired-token', 'NewPass123!'))
        .rejects.toBeInstanceOf(BadRequestException);
      expect(userService.updateUser).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(refreshTokenRepository.update).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/auth.service.ts">
import { RefreshToken, User, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { Injectable, UnauthorizedException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import { createHash, randomBytes } from 'crypto';
import { UserService } from './user.service';
import { EmailService } from './email.service';
import { TokenService } from './token.service';
import {
  getPasswordSetupEmailTemplate,
  getPasswordResetEmailTemplate,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
export const ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000; // 15 minutes
export const REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS = 2629800000; // ~30.4 days
export const ALLOWED_ORIGINS = [
  // Development origins (127.0.0.1 preferred; localhost kept for browser redirects)
  'https://127.0.0.1:4300',
  'https://127.0.0.1:4400',
  'https://127.0.0.1:4500',
  'https://localhost:4300',
  'https://localhost:4400',
  'https://localhost:4500',
  // Production origins
  'https://saintbala.com',
  'https://www.saintbala.com',
  'https://admins.saintbala.com',
  'https://seller.saintbala.com',
  'https://masterskey.store',
  'https://www.masterskey.store',
  'https://admins.masterskey.store',
  'https://seller.masterskey.store',
];
export interface AdminCreateUserParams {
  name: string;
  lastName: string;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
  role: UserRole;
}
export interface AuthTokens {
  access_token: string;
  refresh_token: string;
}
@Injectable()
export class AuthService {
  constructor(
    private userService: UserService,
    private jwtService: JwtService,
    private emailService: EmailService,
    private tokenService: TokenService,
    @InjectRepository(RefreshToken)
    private refreshTokenRepository: Repository<RefreshToken>
  ) {}
  private validateBaseUrl(baseUrl: string): string {
    let parsed: URL;
    try {
      parsed = new URL(baseUrl);
    } catch {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid baseUrl');
    }
    const origin = parsed.origin;
    const envOrigins = process.env['ALLOWED_ORIGINS']
      ? process.env['ALLOWED_ORIGINS'].split(',').map((o) => o.trim())
      : [];
    const allowlist = [...ALLOWED_ORIGINS, ...envOrigins];
    if (!allowlist.includes(origin)) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid baseUrl');
    }
    return origin;
  }
  async validateUser(email: string, pass: string): Promise<User | null> {
    const user = await this.userService.findByEmail(email);
    if (user) {
      const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare(pass, user.password);
      if (isPasswordValid) {
        return user;
      }
    }
    return null;
  }
  async login(user: User): Promise<AuthTokens> {
    const access_token = this.signAccessToken(user);
    const refresh_token = await this.createRefreshToken(user.id);
    return { access_token, refresh_token };
  }
  async refresh(rawRefreshToken: string): Promise<AuthTokens> {
    const stored = await this.findValidRefreshToken(rawRefreshToken);
    if (!stored) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid or expired refresh token');
    }
    const user = await this.userService.getUserById(stored.userId);
    if (!user) {
      await this.revokeRefreshToken(stored);
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid or expired refresh token');
    }
    // Rotate: revoke old token before issuing a new pair
    await this.revokeRefreshToken(stored);
    const access_token = this.signAccessToken(user);
    const refresh_token = await this.createRefreshToken(user.id);
    return { access_token, refresh_token };
  }
  async revokeRefreshTokenByRaw(rawRefreshToken?: string | null): Promise<void> {
    if (!rawRefreshToken) {
      return;
    }
    const stored = await this.findRefreshTokenByRaw(rawRefreshToken);
    if (stored && !stored.revokedAt) {
      await this.revokeRefreshToken(stored);
    }
  }
  async revokeAllUserRefreshTokens(userId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.refreshTokenRepository.update(
      { userId, revokedAt: undefined },
      { revokedAt: new Date() }
    );
  }
  async verifyToken(token: string): Promise<User | null> {
    try {
      const decoded = this.jwtService.verify(token);
      // Always get the full user from the database
      return this.userService.getUserById(decoded.sub);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
  async initiatePasswordSetup(email: string, baseUrl: string): Promise<void> {
    const validatedOrigin = this.validateBaseUrl(baseUrl);
    const user = await this.userService.findByEmail(email);
    if (!user) {
      throw new BadRequestException('User not found');
    }
    const token = await this.tokenService.generateToken(
      user.id,
      email,
      user.role,
      'password_setup'
    );
    const setupLink = `${validatedOrigin}/setup-password/${token}`;
    const locale = (user.locale as 'en' | 'fa') || 'en';
    const { subject, html } = getPasswordSetupEmailTemplate(setupLink, locale);
    await this.emailService.sendEmail(email, subject, html);
  }
  private assertPasswordPolicy(password: unknown): void {
    if (typeof password !== 'string' || password.length < 8) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Password must be at least 8 characters');
    }
  }
  async setupPassword(token: string, newPassword: string): Promise<User> {
    this.assertPasswordPolicy(newPassword);
    const tokenData = await this.tokenService.validateToken(token);
    if (!tokenData) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid or expired token');
    }
    if (tokenData.tokenType !== 'password_setup') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid token type');
    }
    const user = await this.userService.findByEmail(tokenData.email);
    if (!user) {
      throw new BadRequestException('User not found');
    }
    const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 10);
    const updatedUser = await this.userService.updateUser(user.id, { password: hashedPassword });
    // Revoke all existing refresh tokens for this user
    await this.revokeAllUserRefreshTokens(user.id);
    return updatedUser;
  }
  async register(name: string, email: string, password: string): Promise<User> {
    this.assertPasswordPolicy(password);
    // Check if user already exists
    const existingUser = await this.userService.findByEmail(email);
    if (existingUser) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Email already exists');
    }
    // Create new customer user
    const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(password, 10);
    const user = await this.userService.createUser({
      name,
      lastName: '', // Optional for customers
      username: email, // Use email as username
      email,
      password: hashedPassword,
      role: UserRole.CUSTOMER,
    });
    return user;
  }
  async adminCreateUser(params: AdminCreateUserParams): Promise<User> {
    this.assertPasswordPolicy(params.password);
    const existingUser = await this.userService.findByEmail(params.email);
    if (existingUser) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Email already exists');
    }
    const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(params.password, 10);
    const user = await this.userService.createUser({
      ...params,
      password: hashedPassword,
    });
    return user;
  }
  async initiateForgotPassword(email: string, baseUrl: string): Promise<void> {
    const validatedOrigin = this.validateBaseUrl(baseUrl);
    const user = await this.userService.findByEmail(email);
    if (!user) {
      // Don't reveal if email exists for security
      return;
    }
    const token = await this.tokenService.generateToken(
      user.id,
      email,
      user.role,
      'password_reset'
    );
    const resetLink = `${validatedOrigin}/reset-password/${token}`;
    const locale = (user.locale as 'en' | 'fa') || 'en';
    const { subject, html } = getPasswordResetEmailTemplate(resetLink, locale);
    await this.emailService.sendEmail(email, subject, html);
  }
  async resetPassword(token: string, newPassword: string): Promise<User> {
    this.assertPasswordPolicy(newPassword);
    const tokenData = await this.tokenService.validateToken(token);
    if (!tokenData) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid or expired token');
    }
    if (tokenData.tokenType !== 'password_reset') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid token type');
    }
    const user = await this.userService.findByEmail(tokenData.email);
    if (!user) {
      throw new BadRequestException('User not found');
    }
    const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, 10);
    const updatedUser = await this.userService.updateUser(user.id, { password: hashedPassword });
    // Revoke all existing refresh tokens for this user
    await this.revokeAllUserRefreshTokens(user.id);
    return updatedUser;
  }
  private signAccessToken(user: User): string {
    const payload = {
      email: user.email,
      sub: user.id,
      role: user.role,
    };
    return this.jwtService.sign(payload);
  }
  private hashRefreshToken(rawToken: string): string {
    return createHash('sha256').update(rawToken).digest('hex');
  }
  private async createRefreshToken(userId: string): Promise<string> {
    const rawToken = randomBytes(48).toString('base64url');
    const tokenHash = this.hashRefreshToken(rawToken);
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS);
    await this.refreshTokenRepository.save(
      this.refreshTokenRepository.create({
        userId,
        tokenHash,
        expiresAt,
      })
    );
    return rawToken;
  }
  private async findRefreshTokenByRaw(
    rawToken: string
  ): Promise<RefreshToken | null> {
    const tokenHash = this.hashRefreshToken(rawToken);
    return this.refreshTokenRepository.findOne({ where: { tokenHash } });
  }
  private async findValidRefreshToken(
    rawToken: string
  ): Promise<RefreshToken | null> {
    const stored = await this.findRefreshTokenByRaw(rawToken);
    if (!stored || stored.revokedAt) {
      return null;
    }
    if (stored.expiresAt.getTime() <= Date.now()) {
      await this.revokeRefreshToken(stored);
      return null;
    }
    return stored;
  }
  private async revokeRefreshToken(stored: RefreshToken): Promise<void> {
    stored.revokedAt = new Date();
    await this.refreshTokenRepository.save(stored);
  }
}

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, DeepPartial, SaveOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { CartService } from './cart.service';
import { Cart, CartItem, SellerProduct } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { NotFoundException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
type PrivateMethods = Record<string, (...args: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>>;
describe('CartService - addToCart quantity validation', () => {
  let service: CartService;
  let cartRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<Cart>>;
  let cartItemRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<CartItem>>;
  let sellerProductRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<SellerProduct>>;
  const mockSellerProduct = (overrides: Partial<SellerProduct> = {}): SellerProduct => ({
    id: 'sp-1',
    price: 99.95,
    discount: 10,
    stockQuantity: 100,
    product: { id: 1, name: 'Test Product' } as never,
    productInfo: {
      id: 'pi-1',
      images: ['image.jpg'],
      colorLinks: [],
      size: 'M',
    } as never,
    seller: { id: 's-1', storeName: 'Test Store' } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'],
    productInfoId: 1,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  const mockCart = (overrides: Partial<Cart> = {}): Cart => ({
    id: 'cart-1',
    userId: 'user-1',
    subtotal: 0,
    total: 0,
    items: [],
    createdAt: new Date(),
    updatedAt: new Date(),
    user: { id: 'user-1' } as never,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  const mockCartItem = (overrides: Partial<CartItem> = {}): CartItem => ({
    id: 'ci-1',
    cartId: 'cart-1',
    productId: '1',
    productName: 'Test Product',
    productImage: 'image.jpg',
    quantity: 2,
    unitPrice: 89.96,
    totalPrice: 179.92,
    color: '#ff0000',
    size: 'M',
    sellerId: 's-1',
    sellerName: 'Test Store',
    productInfoId: 'pi-1',
    sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
    availableStock: 100,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  beforeEach(async () => {
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        CartService,
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(Cart),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
            create: jest.fn(),
            save: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(CartItem),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
            create: jest.fn(),
            save: jest.fn(),
            remove: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
      ],
    }).compile();
    service = module.get<CartService>(CartService);
    cartRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(Cart));
    cartItemRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(CartItem));
    sellerProductRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct));
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });
  describe('addToCart quantity validation', () => {
    it('should reject quantity 0 with BadRequestException and not call repositories', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerProduct());
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 0 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      expect(sellerProductRepository.findOne).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(cartItemRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should reject negative quantity (-5) with BadRequestException and not call repositories', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerProduct());
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: -5 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      expect(sellerProductRepository.findOne).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(cartItemRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should reject fractional quantity (1.5) with BadRequestException and not call repositories', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerProduct());
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1.5 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      expect(sellerProductRepository.findOne).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(cartItemRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should accept quantity 1 for in-stock product and save cart item with quantity 1', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 100 });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/email.service.ts">
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { google } from 'googleapis';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
/** Shape of errors thrown by the googleapis Gmail client that this service inspects. */
interface GmailSendError {
  message?: string;
  code?: number;
  status?: number;
  response?: { data?: { error?: string } };
}
@Injectable()
export class EmailService {
  private gmail;
  constructor(private configService: ConfigService) {
    const oauth2Client = new google.auth.OAuth2(
      this.configService.get('GMAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID'),
      this.configService.get('GMAIL_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET')
    );
    oauth2Client.setCredentials({
      refresh_token: this.configService.get('GMAIL_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN'),
    });
    this.gmail = google.gmail({ version: 'v1', auth: oauth2Client });
  }
  async sendEmail(to: string, subject: string, html: string) {
    const from = this.configService.get('GMAIL_CUSTOM_FROM_ADDRESS');
    const message = [
      'Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8',
      'MIME-Version: 1.0',
      `From: SAINTBALA <${from}>`,
      `To: ${to}`,
      `Subject: ${subject}`,
      '',
      html,
    ].join('\n');
    const encodedMessage = Buffer.from(message)
      .toString('base64')
      .replace(/\+/g, '-')
      .replace(/\//g, '_')
      .replace(/=+$/, '');
    try {
      await this.gmail.users.messages.send({
        userId: 'me',
        requestBody: {
          raw: encodedMessage,
        },
      });
    } catch (caught: unknown) {
      const error = caught as GmailSendError | null | undefined;
      console.error('Error sending email:', error);
      // Check for OAuth errors
      if (error?.response?.data?.error === 'invalid_grant') {
        throw new Error(
          'Gmail OAuth refresh token is invalid or expired. Please regenerate the refresh token. See EMAIL_OAUTH_SETUP.md for instructions.'
        );
      }
      // Check for other OAuth errors
      if (error?.code === 401 || error?.status === 401) {
        throw new Error(
          'Gmail OAuth authentication failed. Please check your OAuth credentials and refresh token.'
        );
      }
      throw new Error(`Failed to send email: ${error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
    }
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/payment.service.ts">
import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
export interface ZarinPalPaymentRequest {
  amount: number; // Amount in unit of currency (Kickzone uses IRT / Toman)
  callback_url: string;
  description: string;
  metadata?: {
    mobile?: string;
    email?: string;
    order_id?: string;
  };
  currency?: 'IRR' | 'IRT';
}
export interface ZarinPalPaymentResponse {
  data: {
    code: number;
    message: string;
    authority: string;
    fee_type?: string;
    fee?: number;
  };
  errors: Array<{
    code: number;
    message: string;
  }>;
}
export interface ZarinPalVerificationRequest {
  amount: number; // Must match request amount / currency unit
  authority: string;
}
export interface ZarinPalVerificationResponse {
  data: {
    code: number;
    message: string;
    ref_id?: number;
    card_pan?: string;
    card_hash?: string;
    fee_type?: string;
    fee?: number;
  };
  errors: Array<{
    code: number;
    message: string;
  }>;
}
/** Error body returned by the ZarinPal REST API on non-2xx responses. */
interface ZarinPalErrorBody {
  errors?: { message?: string; code?: number }[];
  message?: string;
  data?: { message?: string };
}
@Injectable()
export class PaymentService {
  private readonly merchantId: string;
  private readonly isSandbox: boolean;
  private readonly apiBaseUrl: string;
  constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {
    // Use a random UUID for sandbox if not configured (sandbox accepts any UUID)
    // Generate a random UUID: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
    const generateRandomUUID = () => {
      return 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx'.replace(/[xy]/g, (c) => {
        const r = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
        const v = c === 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3) | 0x8;
        return v.toString(16);
      });
    };
    this.merchantId =
      this.configService.get<string>('ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID') ||
      generateRandomUUID();
    // Check sandbox mode - default to true in development
    const nodeEnv = this.configService.get<string>('NODE_ENV', 'development');
    const sandboxEnv = this.configService.get<string>('ZARINPAL_SANDBOX');
    // Default to sandbox in development, require explicit false for production
    this.isSandbox =
      sandboxEnv === undefined ? nodeEnv !== 'production' : sandboxEnv !== 'false';
    this.apiBaseUrl = this.isSandbox
      ? 'https://sandbox.zarinpal.com/pg/v4/payment'
      : 'https://payment.zarinpal.com/pg/v4/payment';
    // Warn if using default merchant ID
    if (this.merchantId === '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') {
      if (!this.isSandbox) {
        console.error(
          '❌ ZarinPal PRODUCTION: Merchant ID not configured! ' +
            'Payment requests will fail. Set ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID environment variable.'
        );
      }
    }
  }
  /**
   * Request payment from ZarinPal
   */
  async requestPayment(
    request: ZarinPalPaymentRequest
  ): Promise<ZarinPalPaymentResponse> {
    const payload = {
      merchant_id: this.merchantId,
      amount: request.amount,
      callback_url: request.callback_url,
      description: request.description,
      currency: request.currency || 'IRT',
      metadata: request.metadata,
    };
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBaseUrl}/request.json`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Accept: 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        // Clone the response so we can read it multiple times
        const responseClone = response.clone();
        // Try to get error details from response body
        let errorDetails = '';
        let fullErrorBody: ZarinPalErrorBody | null = null;
        let responseText = '';
        try {
          // First try to get as text to see what we're dealing with
          responseText = await responseClone.text();
          console.error(
            `[PaymentService] ❌ ZarinPal API raw error response:`,
            responseText.substring(0, 1000) // First 1000 chars
          );
          // Try to parse as JSON
          try {
            const parsedBody: ZarinPalErrorBody = JSON.parse(responseText);
            fullErrorBody = parsedBody;
            console.error(
              `[PaymentService] ❌ ZarinPal API error response body (JSON):`,
              JSON.stringify(fullErrorBody, null, 2)
            );
            if (parsedBody.errors && parsedBody.errors.length > 0) {
              errorDetails = parsedBody.errors
                .map(
                  (e: { message?: string; code?: number }) =>
                    e.message || `Code: ${e.code}`
                )
                .join(', ');
            } else if (parsedBody.message) {
              errorDetails = parsedBody.message;
            } else if (parsedBody.data && parsedBody.data.message) {
              errorDetails = parsedBody.data.message;
            } else {
              errorDetails = JSON.stringify(fullErrorBody);
            }
          } catch (jsonError) {
            // Not JSON, use text as error details
            errorDetails = responseText || response.statusText;
            console.error(
              `[PaymentService] ❌ ZarinPal API error (non-JSON response):`,
              responseText.substring(0, 500)
            );
          }
        } catch (textError) {
          // Can't even read as text
          errorDetails = response.statusText;
          console.error(
            `[PaymentService] ❌ Could not read response body:`,
            textError
          );
        }
        const errorMessage = errorDetails
          ? `ZarinPal API error (${response.status}): ${errorDetails}`
          : `ZarinPal API error: HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`;
        console.error(`[PaymentService] ❌ Payment request failed:`, {
          status: response.status,
          statusText: response.statusText,
          errorDetails,
          fullResponse: fullErrorBody,
          orderId: request.metadata?.order_id,
          amount: request.amount,
          currency: request.currency || 'IRT',
          merchantId: this.merchantId,
          isSandbox: this.isSandbox,
          apiUrl: this.apiBaseUrl,
          payload: {
            merchant_id: this.merchantId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
            amount: request.amount,
            currency: request.currency || 'IRT',
            callback_url: request.callback_url,
          },
        });
        throw new Error(errorMessage);
      }
      const data: ZarinPalPaymentResponse = await response.json();
      if (data.errors && data.errors.length > 0) {
        const errorMessages = data.errors.map((e) => e.message).join(', ');
        throw new Error(`ZarinPal API error: ${errorMessages}`);
      }
      return data;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        throw error;
      }
      throw new Error('Failed to request payment from ZarinPal');
    }
  }
  /**
   * Verify payment with ZarinPal
   */
  async verifyPayment(
    request: ZarinPalVerificationRequest
  ): Promise<ZarinPalVerificationResponse> {
    const payload = {
      merchant_id: this.merchantId,
      amount: request.amount,
      authority: request.authority,
    };
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${this.apiBaseUrl}/verify.json`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Accept: 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      if (!response.ok) {
        // Try to get error details from response body
        let errorDetails = '';
        try {
          const errorBody = await response.json();
          if (errorBody.errors && errorBody.errors.length > 0) {
            errorDetails = errorBody.errors
              .map(
                (e: { message?: string; code?: number }) =>
                  e.message || `Code: ${e.code}`
              )
              .join(', ');
          }
        } catch {
          // If parsing fails, use status text
          errorDetails = response.statusText;
        }
        const errorMessage = errorDetails
          ? `ZarinPal API error (${response.status}): ${errorDetails}`
          : `ZarinPal API error: HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`;
        console.error(`[PaymentService] ❌ Payment verification failed:`, {
          status: response.status,
          statusText: response.statusText,
          errorDetails,
          authority: request.authority,
          amount: request.amount,
          merchantId: this.merchantId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
          isSandbox: this.isSandbox,
        });
        throw new Error(errorMessage);
      }
      const data: ZarinPalVerificationResponse = await response.json();
      if (data.errors && data.errors.length > 0) {
        const errorMessages = data.errors.map((e) => e.message).join(', ');
        throw new Error(`ZarinPal API error: ${errorMessages}`);
      }
      return data;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        throw error;
      }
      throw new Error('Failed to verify payment with ZarinPal');
    }
  }
  /**
   * Get payment gateway URL
   */
  getGatewayUrl(authority: string): string {
    const gatewayBaseUrl = this.isSandbox
      ? 'https://sandbox.zarinpal.com/pg/StartPay'
      : 'https://payment.zarinpal.com/pg/StartPay';
    return `${gatewayBaseUrl}/${authority}`;
  }
}
</file>

  describe('createProduct with Pants variants', () => {
    it('creates a product with a Pants variant and persists canonical WxL size', async () => {
      const sellerUser = {
        id: 10,
        role: UserRole.SELLER,
        username: 'seller_test',
      } as unknown as User;
      const sellerInfo = {
        id: 1,
        user: { id: 10 },
        storeName: 'Test Store',

      const mockProduct: Product = {
        id: 100,
        name: 'Test Pants',
        sku: 'PANTS-001',
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
        sellerId: 1,
        seller: sellerInfo,
      } as unknown as Product;
      sellerInfoRepo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerInfo);
      sellerInfoRepo.findOneBy.mockResolvedValue(sellerInfo);
      colorRepo.findBy.mockResolvedValue([mockColors[0]]);
      const createdVariant: ProductInfo = {
        id: 501,
        size: '32x34',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
        weight: 500,
        images: [],
        product: mockProduct,
        colorLinks: [
          {
            id: 1,
            position: 0,
            color: mockColors[0],
            productInfo: null as unknown as ProductInfo,
          } as ProductInfoColor,
        ],
        colors: [mockColors[0]],
      };
      productInfoRepo.create.mockReturnValue(createdVariant);
      productInfoRepo.save.mockResolvedValue(createdVariant);
      productRepo.save.mockResolvedValue(mockProduct);
      const refreshedProduct: Product = {
        ...mockProduct,
        productInfos: [createdVariant],
      };
      productRepo.findOne.mockImplementation(
        async (options?: FindOneOptions<Product>) => {
          const relations = options?.relations as string[] | undefined;
          const where = options?.where as { id?: number } | undefined;
          if (relations?.includes('descriptions')) {
            return refreshedProduct;
          }
          if (where?.id === 100) {
            return mockProduct;
          }
          return null;
        }
      );
      const createInput: CreateProductInput = {
        name: 'Test Pants',
        sku: 'PANTS-001',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            size: 'W32/L34',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
            colorIds: [1],
            weight: 500,
          },
        ],
      };
      await service.createProduct(createInput, sellerUser);
      expect(productInfoRepo.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          size: '32x34',
          sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
        })
      );
    });

          sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,

  describe('updateProduct with Pants variants', () => {
    it('updates an existing Pants variant and persists canonical WxL size', async () => {
      const adminUser = {
        id: 1,
        role: UserRole.ADMIN,
        username: 'admin',
      } as unknown as User;
      const existingVariant: ProductInfo = {
        id: 60,
        size: '30x32',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
        weight: 400,
        colorLinks: [],
        colors: [],
        images: [],
        product: { id: 100 } as Product,
      };
      const targetProduct: Product = {
        id: 100,
        name: 'Test Pants',
        sku: 'PANTS-001',
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [existingVariant],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
      } as unknown as Product;
      productRepo.findOne.mockImplementation(
        async (options?: FindOneOptions<Product>) => {
          const where = options?.where as { id?: number } | undefined;
          if (where?.id === 100) {
            return targetProduct;
          }
          return null;
        }
      );
      colorRepo.findBy.mockResolvedValue([mockColors[0]]);
      productInfoRepo.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...existingVariant,
        size: '34x32',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
      });
      const updateInput: UpdateProductInput = {
        id: 100,
        name: 'Test Pants',
        sku: 'PANTS-001',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            id: 60,
            size: '34/32',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
            colorIds: [1],
            weight: 450,
          },

      await service.updateProduct(updateInput, adminUser);
      expect(productInfoRepo.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          id: 60,
          size: '34x32',
          sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
        })
      );
    });
  });
  describe('createProduct with invalid Pants sizes', () => {
    const invalidPantsSizes = [
      '0x34',
      '32x100',
      '32.5x34',
      'M',
      '-32x34',
    ];
    for (const invalidSize of invalidPantsSizes) {
      it(`rejects "${invalidSize}" with correct pants error message and does not persist`, async () => {
        const adminUser = {
          id: 1,
          role: UserRole.ADMIN,
          username: 'admin',
        } as unknown as User;
        const targetProduct: Product = {
          id: 400,
          name: 'Test Pants',
          sku: 'PANTS-001',
          categories: [],
          productInfos: [],
          sellerProducts: [],
          archived: false,
        } as unknown as Product;
        productRepo.findOne.mockImplementation(
          async (options?: FindOneOptions<Product>) => {
            const where = options?.where as { id?: number } | undefined;
            if (where?.id === 400) {
              return targetProduct;
            }
            return null;
          }
        );
        const createInput: CreateProductInput = {
          name: 'Test Pants',
          sku: 'PANTS-001',
          categoryIds: [],
          variants: [
            {
              size: invalidSize,
              sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
              colorIds: [1],
              weight: 500,
            },
          ],
        };
        await expect(service.createProduct(createInput, adminUser)).rejects.toThrow(
          'Invalid pants size. Use waist and inseam between 1 and 99 (e.g. 32x34).'
        );
        expect(productInfoRepo.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
    }
  });
  describe('createProductInfo with invalid Pants size', () => {
    it('rejects 999x34 with correct pants error message', async () => {
      const mockProduct: Product = {
        id: 100,
        name: 'Test Pants',
        sku: 'PANTS-001',
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
      };
      const input: CreateProductInfoInput = {
        productId: 100,
        size: '999x34',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants,
        colorIds: [1],
        weight: 500,
      };
      productRepo.findOneBy.mockResolvedValue(mockProduct);
      await expect(service.createProductInfo(input)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Invalid pants size. Use waist and inseam between 1 and 99 (e.g. 32x34).'
      );
    });
  });
  describe('Apparel and Footwear invalid sizes unchanged', () => {
    it('rejects invalid Apparel size with existing apparel message', async () => {
      const adminUser = {
        id: 1,
        role: UserRole.ADMIN,
        username: 'admin',
      } as unknown as User;
      const targetProduct: Product = {
        id: 400,
        name: 'Test Shirt',
        sku: 'SHIRT-001',
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
      } as unknown as Product;
      productRepo.findOne.mockImplementation(
        async (options?: FindOneOptions<Product>) => {
          const where = options?.where as { id?: number } | undefined;
          if (where?.id === 400) {
            return targetProduct;
          }
          return null;
        }
      );
      const createInput: CreateProductInput = {
        name: 'Test Shirt',
        sku: 'SHIRT-001',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            size: 'ZZZ',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
            colorIds: [1],
            weight: 200,
          },
        ],
      };
      await expect(service.createProduct(createInput, adminUser)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Invalid apparel size. Use XS–4XL.'
      );
    });
    it('rejects invalid Footwear size with existing footwear message', async () => {
      const adminUser = {
        id: 1,
        role: UserRole.ADMIN,
        username: 'admin',
      } as unknown as User;
      const targetProduct: Product = {
        id: 400,
        name: 'Test Shoes',
        sku: 'SHOES-001',
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
      } as unknown as Product;
      productRepo.findOne.mockImplementation(
        async (options?: FindOneOptions<Product>) => {
          const where = options?.where as { id?: number } | undefined;
          if (where?.id === 400) {
            return targetProduct;
          }
          return null;
        }
      );
      const createInput: CreateProductInput = {
        name: 'Test Shoes',
        sku: 'SHOES-001',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            size: '99',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Footwear,
            colorIds: [1],
            weight: 350,
          },
        ],
      };
      await expect(service.createProduct(createInput, adminUser)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Invalid footwear size. Use an EU size from 35 to 50 (including .5).'
      );
    });
  });
  describe('getDistinctProductSizes with Pants sizeKind', () => {
    it('adds where clause for Pants sizeKind', async () => {
      const mockQb = {
        select: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),
        where: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),
        andWhere: jest.fn().mockReturnThis(),
        getRawMany: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue([
          { size: '32x34' },
          { size: '34x32' },
        ]),
      } as unknown as ReturnType<Repository<ProductInfo>['createQueryBuilder']>;
      productInfoRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(mockQb);
      const result = await service.getDistinctProductSizes(SizeKind.Pants);
      expect(mockQb.andWhere).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'productInfo.sizeKind = :sizeKind',
        { sizeKind: SizeKind.Pants }
      );
      expect(result).toEqual(['32x34', '34x32']);
    });
  });
});

describe('ProductService - Color Handling', () => {
  let service: ProductService;

  let productInfoColorRepo: jest.Mocked<Repository<ProductInfoColor>>;

  const mockColors: Color[] = [

    { id: 2, name: 'Blue', hexCode: '#0000ff', translations: [] } as unknown as Color,
    { id: 3, name: 'Green', hexCode: '#00ff00', translations: [] } as unknown as Color,
  ];
  beforeEach(async () => {

    const mockColorRepo = {

      findOneBy: jest.fn(),

      findOneBy: jest.fn(),
      create: jest.fn(),
      save: jest.fn(),

    const mockSellerProductRepo = {
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      find: jest.fn(),
      count: jest.fn(),
      create: jest.fn().mockImplementation((dto) => dto),
      save: jest.fn().mockImplementation((dto) => Promise.resolve(dto)),
      delete: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ affected: 1 }),
    };
    const mockBrandRepo = {
      findOneBy: jest.fn(),
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      findBy: jest.fn(),
      create: jest.fn().mockImplementation((dto) => dto),
      save: jest.fn().mockImplementation((dto) => Promise.resolve(dto)),

      findOneBy: jest.fn(),
      create: jest.fn().mockImplementation((dto) => dto),

    colorRepo = module.get(getRepositoryToken(Color));
    sellerProductRepo = module.get(getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct));
    sellerInfoRepo = module.get(getRepositoryToken(SellerInfo));
  });
  describe('createProductInfo with multiple colors', () => {
    it('sets ALL chosen colors from input to the product variant, not just the first one', async () => {
      const mockProduct: Product = {
        id: 100,
        name: 'Running Shoes',
        sku: 'RUN-001',
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
      };
      const input: CreateProductInfoInput = {
        productId: 100,
        size: '42',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Footwear,
        colorIds: [1, 2, 3], // 3 colors chosen from input
        weight: 350,
      };
      productRepo.findOneBy.mockResolvedValue(mockProduct);
      colorRepo.findBy.mockResolvedValue(mockColors);
      const createdProductInfo: ProductInfo = {
        id: 50,
        product: mockProduct,
        size: '42',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Footwear,
        weight: 350,
        colorLinks: [],
        colors: [],
        images: [],
      };
      productInfoRepo.create.mockReturnValue(createdProductInfo);
      productInfoRepo.save.mockResolvedValue(createdProductInfo);
      const expectedLinks: Partial<ProductInfoColor>[] = [
        { productInfo: createdProductInfo, color: mockColors[0], position: 0 },
        { productInfo: createdProductInfo, color: mockColors[1], position: 1 },
        { productInfo: createdProductInfo, color: mockColors[2], position: 2 },
      ];
      // getProductById mock after creating variant
      const fullProduct: Product = {
        ...mockProduct,
        productInfos: [
          {
            ...createdProductInfo,
            colorLinks: expectedLinks as ProductInfoColor[],
          },
        ],
      };
      productRepo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(fullProduct);
      const result = await service.createProductInfo(input);
      // Verify all colors were queried via repository
      expect(colorRepo.findBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        id: In([1, 2, 3]),
      });
      // Verify productInfoColor was deleted for old links
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.delete).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        productInfo: { id: 50 },
      });
      // Verify create was called for EACH color in order
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.create).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, {
        productInfo: createdProductInfo,
        color: mockColors[0],
        position: 0,
      });
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.create).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, {
        productInfo: createdProductInfo,
        color: mockColors[1],
        position: 1,
      });
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.create).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(3, {
        productInfo: createdProductInfo,
        color: mockColors[2],
        position: 2,
      });
      // Verify save was called with all 3 links, NOT just the first one
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.arrayContaining([
          expect.objectContaining({ position: 0, color: mockColors[0] }),
          expect.objectContaining({ position: 1, color: mockColors[1] }),
          expect.objectContaining({ position: 2, color: mockColors[2] }),
        ])
      );
      const savedLinksArg = productInfoColorRepo.save.mock.calls[0][0] as ProductInfoColor[];
      expect(savedLinksArg).toHaveLength(3);
      // Verify result has the variant with all color links
      expect(result.productInfos[0].colorLinks).toHaveLength(3);
    });
    it('preserves the exact submitted order of chosen colors', async () => {
      const mockProduct: Product = {
        id: 100,
        name: 'Running Shoes',
        sku: 'RUN-002',
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
      };
      // Submitted in reverse order: [3, 1]
      const input: CreateProductInfoInput = {
        productId: 100,
        size: 'L',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
        colorIds: [3, 1],
        weight: 200,
      };
      productRepo.findOneBy.mockResolvedValue(mockProduct);
      colorRepo.findBy.mockResolvedValue([mockColors[0], mockColors[2]]);
      const createdProductInfo: ProductInfo = {
        id: 51,
        product: mockProduct,
        size: 'L',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
        weight: 200,
        colorLinks: [],
        colors: [],
        images: [],
      };
      productInfoRepo.create.mockReturnValue(createdProductInfo);
      productInfoRepo.save.mockResolvedValue(createdProductInfo);
      productRepo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockProduct);
      await service.createProductInfo(input);
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.create).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, {
        productInfo: createdProductInfo,
        color: mockColors[2], // ID 3 is first
        position: 0,
      });
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.create).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, {
        productInfo: createdProductInfo,
        color: mockColors[0], // ID 1 is second
        position: 1,
      });
    });
    it('deduplicates duplicate chosen colors from input while keeping order', async () => {
      const mockProduct: Product = {
        id: 100,
        name: 'T-Shirt',
        sku: 'TSHIRT-001',
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
      };
      const input: CreateProductInfoInput = {
        productId: 100,
        size: 'M',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
        colorIds: [1, 2, 1], // duplicate 1
        weight: 150,
      };
      productRepo.findOneBy.mockResolvedValue(mockProduct);
      colorRepo.findBy.mockResolvedValue([mockColors[0], mockColors[1]]);
      const createdProductInfo: ProductInfo = {
        id: 52,
        product: mockProduct,
        size: 'M',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
        weight: 150,
        colorLinks: [],
        colors: [],
        images: [],
      };
      productInfoRepo.create.mockReturnValue(createdProductInfo);
      productInfoRepo.save.mockResolvedValue(createdProductInfo);
      productRepo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockProduct);
      await service.createProductInfo(input);
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.create).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, {
        productInfo: createdProductInfo,
        color: mockColors[0],
        position: 0,
      });
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.create).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, {
        productInfo: createdProductInfo,
        color: mockColors[1],
        position: 1,
      });
    });
    it('throws error when colorIds is empty', async () => {
      productRepo.findOneBy.mockResolvedValue({ id: 100 } as Product);
      const input: CreateProductInfoInput = {
        productId: 100,
        size: 'M',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
        colorIds: [],
        weight: 150,
      };
      await expect(service.createProductInfo(input)).rejects.toThrow(
        'At least one color is required.'
      );
    });
    it('throws error when one or more chosen color IDs do not exist in database', async () => {
      productRepo.findOneBy.mockResolvedValue({ id: 100 } as Product);
      colorRepo.findBy.mockResolvedValue([mockColors[0]]); // only found 1 of 2
      const input: CreateProductInfoInput = {
        productId: 100,
        size: 'M',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
        colorIds: [1, 999],
        weight: 150,
      };
      await expect(service.createProductInfo(input)).rejects.toThrow(
        'One or more colors were not found.'
      );
    });
  });
  describe('updateProductInfo with multiple colors', () => {
    it('updates and sets ALL chosen colors for an existing variant', async () => {
      const existingProductInfo: ProductInfo = {
        id: 60,
        size: 'S',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
        weight: 100,
        colorLinks: [],
        colors: [],
        images: [],
        product: { id: 100 } as Product,
      };
      productInfoRepo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(existingProductInfo);
      colorRepo.findBy.mockResolvedValue([mockColors[0], mockColors[1]]);
      productInfoRepo.save.mockResolvedValue(existingProductInfo);
      await service.updateProductInfo(60, 'M', [1, 2], 200);
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.delete).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        productInfo: { id: 60 },
      });
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      expect(productInfoColorRepo.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.arrayContaining([
          expect.objectContaining({ color: mockColors[0], position: 0 }),
          expect.objectContaining({ color: mockColors[1], position: 1 }),
        ])
      );
    });
  });
  describe('updateProduct with variants (Seller and Admin persistence & security)', () => {
    it('allows a SELLER to add a new variant to their owned product and persists it with a generated ID', async () => {
      const sellerUser = {
        id: 10,
        role: UserRole.SELLER,
        username: 'seller_saintbala',
      } as unknown as User;
      const sellerInfo = {
        id: 1,
        user: { id: 10 },
        storeName: 'SAINTBALA Flagship',
      } as unknown as SellerInfo;
      const initialProduct: Product = {
        id: 100,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Heavyweight Hoodie',
        sku: 'SB-HOOD-01',
        sellerId: 1,
        seller: sellerInfo,
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
      } as unknown as Product;
      sellerInfoRepo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerInfo);
      sellerInfoRepo.findOneBy.mockResolvedValue(sellerInfo);
      colorRepo.findBy.mockResolvedValue([mockColors[0]]);
      const createdVariant: ProductInfo = {
        id: 501,
        size: 'L',
        sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
        weight: 650,
        images: ['https://cdn.saintbala.com/hoodie-l.jpg'],
        product: initialProduct,
        colorLinks: [
          {
            id: 1,
            position: 0,
            color: mockColors[0],
            productInfo: null as unknown as ProductInfo,
          } as ProductInfoColor,
        ],
        colors: [mockColors[0]],
      };
      productInfoRepo.create.mockReturnValue(createdVariant);
      productInfoRepo.save.mockResolvedValue(createdVariant);
      productRepo.save.mockResolvedValue(initialProduct);
      // getProductById mock after update
      const refreshedProduct: Product = {
        ...initialProduct,
        productInfos: [createdVariant],
      };
      productRepo.findOne.mockImplementation(
        async (options?: FindOneOptions<Product>) => {
          const relations = options?.relations as string[] | undefined;
          const where = options?.where as { id?: number } | undefined;
          if (relations?.includes('descriptions')) {
            return refreshedProduct;
          }
          if (where?.id === 100) {
            return initialProduct;
          }
          return null;
        }
      );
      const updateInput: UpdateProductInput = {
        id: 100,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Heavyweight Hoodie',
        sku: 'SB-HOOD-01',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            size: 'L',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
            colorIds: [1],
            weight: 650,
            images: ['https://cdn.saintbala.com/hoodie-l.jpg'],
            stockQuantity: 20,
            price: 280,
            costPrice: 100,
            discount: 0,
          },
        ],
      };
      const result = await service.updateProduct(updateInput, sellerUser);
      // Assert variant has been generated with server ID
      expect(result.productInfos).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(result.productInfos[0].id).toBe(501);
      expect(result.productInfos[0].size).toBe('L');
      expect(result.productInfos[0].colors).toContainEqual(mockColors[0]);
      // Assert database persistence
      expect(productInfoRepo.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          size: 'L',
          sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
          weight: 650,
        })
      );
      expect(productInfoRepo.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(createdVariant);
      expect(sellerProductRepo.create).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          seller: sellerInfo,
          price: 280,
          stockQuantity: 20,
        })
      );
      expect(sellerProductRepo.save).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects with 403 Forbidden when a SELLER attempts to add a variant to a product owned by another seller', async () => {
      const unauthorizedSellerUser = {
        id: 20,
        role: UserRole.SELLER,
        username: 'intruder_seller',
      } as unknown as User;
      const unauthorizedSellerInfo = {
        id: 2,
        user: { id: 20 },
        storeName: 'Other Store',
      } as unknown as SellerInfo;
      const productOwnedByOtherSeller: Product = {
        id: 200,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Leather Jacket',
        sku: 'SB-JKT-01',
        sellerId: 1, // Owned by seller ID 1!
        seller: { id: 1 } as SellerInfo,
        categories: [],
        productInfos: [],
        sellerProducts: [],
        archived: false,
      } as unknown as Product;
      sellerInfoRepo.findOne.mockResolvedValue(unauthorizedSellerInfo);
      productRepo.findOne.mockImplementation(
        async (options?: FindOneOptions<Product>) => {
          const where = options?.where as { id?: number } | undefined;
          if (where?.id === 200) {
            return productOwnedByOtherSeller;
          }
          return null;
        }
      );
      const updateInput: UpdateProductInput = {
        id: 200,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Leather Jacket',
        sku: 'SB-JKT-01',
        categoryIds: [],
        variants: [
          {
            size: 'M',
            sizeKind: SizeKind.Apparel,
            colorIds: [1],
            weight: 800,
          },
        ],
      };
      await expect(
        service.updateProduct(updateInput, unauthorizedSellerUser)
      ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
      // Verify ZERO database modifications occurred
      expect(productRepo.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(productInfoRepo.create).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(productInfoRepo.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(sellerProductRepo.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('allows an ADMIN to add a new variant to any product and persists relational data cleanly', async () => {
      const adminUser = {
        id: 1,
        role: UserRole.ADMIN,
        username: 'admin',
      } as unknown as User;
      const productOwnedBySeller: Product = {
        id: 300,
        name: 'SAINTBALA Oversized Tee',
        sku: 'SB-TEE-01',

        seller: { id: 99 } as SellerInfo,

            position: 0,
