<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/errors.spec.ts">
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { toValidationIssues } from './errors';
describe('errors', () => {
  describe('toValidationIssues', () => {
    it('returns path, code, message for nested object failure', () => {
      const schema = z.object({
        a: z.object({
          b: z.string(),
        }),
      });
      const result = schema.safeParse({ a: { b: 1 } });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
      if (!result.success) {
        const issues = toValidationIssues(result.error);
        expect(issues).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(issues[0].path).toBe('a.b');
        expect(issues[0].code).toBe('invalid_type');
        expect(typeof issues[0].message).toBe('string');
        expect(issues[0].message.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      }
    });
    it('returns empty path for root level failure', () => {
      const schema = z.string();
      const result = schema.safeParse(123);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
      if (!result.success) {
        const issues = toValidationIssues(result.error);
        expect(issues).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(issues[0].path).toBe('');
        expect(issues[0].code).toBe('invalid_type');
      }
    });
    it('returns multiple issues for multiple failures', () => {
      const schema = z.object({
        x: z.string(),
        y: z.number(),
      });
      const result = schema.safeParse({ x: 1, y: 'two' });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
      if (!result.success) {
        const issues = toValidationIssues(result.error);
        expect(issues).toHaveLength(2);
        const paths = issues.map((i) => i.path).sort();
        expect(paths).toEqual(['x', 'y']);
      }
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/errors.ts">
import { z } from 'zod';
export interface ValidationIssue {
  path: string;
  message: string;
  code: string;
}
export function toValidationIssues(error: z.ZodError): ValidationIssue[] {
  return error.issues.map((issue) => ({
    path: issue.path.join('.'),
    message: issue.message,
    code: issue.code,
  }));
}

  });

    ['shippingAddress', 'ab'],
    ['city', 'T1'],

    ['zipCode', '12'],

    expect(shippingAddressSchema.safeParse({ ...shipping, [field]: value }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it('trims surrounding whitespace', () => {
    const r = shippingAddressSchema.parse({ ...shipping, city: '  Tehran  ' });
    expect(r.city).toBe('Tehran');
  });

  it('accepts a valid order, including a guest-token note', () => {
    const r = createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, notes: '[GuestToken: abc]' });
    expect(r.success).toBe(true);
  });
  it('rejects an order without items', () => {
    expect(createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, items: [] }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  it('rejects sellerId 0, negative shipping cost and negative prices', () => {
    expect(createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, sellerId: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, shippingCost: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(

    ).toBe(false);

    expect(createOrderSchema.safeParse({ ...order, items: [{ ...item, quantity: 1000 }] }).success).toBe(false);

import { z } from 'zod';

export const PROFILE_LIMITS = {
  clothingSize: { max: 20 },
  shoeSize: { max: 20 },
  favorites: { max: 20000 },
} as const;
/** Profile fields may be cleared: accept an empty string or a valid value. */
const clearable = <T extends z.ZodType<string>>(schema: T) =>
  z.union([z.literal(''), schema]).nullish();
const shape = shippingAddressSchema.shape;
export const updateCustomerProfileSchema = z.object({
  phone: clearable(shippingPhoneSchema),
  address: clearable(shape.shippingAddress),
  city: clearable(shape.city),
  state: clearable(shape.state),
  zipCode: clearable(shape.zipCode),
  country: clearable(shape.country),
  clothingSize: z.string().trim().max(PROFILE_LIMITS.clothingSize.max).nullish(),
  shoeSize: z.string().trim().max(PROFILE_LIMITS.shoeSize.max).nullish(),
  favorites: z.string().max(PROFILE_LIMITS.favorites.max).nullish(),
});
/** Profile screen: address modal. */
export const profileAddressFormSchema = z.object({
  state: clearable(shape.state),
  city: clearable(shape.city),
  address: clearable(shape.shippingAddress),
  zipCode: clearable(shape.zipCode),
  phone: clearable(shippingPhoneSchema),
  country: clearable(shape.country),
});
/** Profile screen: personal info modal (only the phone is editable). */
export const profilePhoneFormSchema = z.object({
  phone: clearable(shippingPhoneSchema),
});
export type UpdateCustomerProfileData = z.output<typeof updateCustomerProfileSchema>;

export type ProfilePhoneFormInput = z.input<typeof profilePhoneFormSchema>;

describe('query argument schemas', () => {
  it('bounds page sizes and cursors', () => {
    for (const n of [1, 10, 100, 200]) expect(ok(paginationFirstSchema, n)).toBe(true);
    for (const n of [0, -1, 201, 2.5]) expect(ok(paginationFirstSchema, n)).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(cursorSchema, undefined)).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(cursorSchema, 'x'.repeat(501))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(optionalIdSchema, null)).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(optionalIdSchema, ' ')).toBe(false);
  });

        onlyInStock: true,
        onlyWithSellers: true,
        archivedStatus: 'ACTIVE',
        categorySlugs: ['t-shirts', 'sneakers'],
        brands: ['nike'],
        sortOrder: 'desc',
        productInfoFilter: { size: ['42'], colorId: [1, 2] },
      })
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(sellerFilterSchema, { ids: [1, 2], first: 100 })).toBe(true);
  });
  it('rejects oversized filter arrays and bad sort orders', () => {
    const many = Array.from({ length: 101 }, (_, i) => i);
    expect(ok(productFilterSchema, { ids: many })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(productFilterSchema, { productInfoFilter: { colorId: many } })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(productFilterSchema, { sortOrder: 'sideways' })).toBe(false);

import { idSchema } from './primitives';
/** Query argument limits (largest client page size today is 200). */
export const QUERY_LIMITS = {
  first: { min: 1, max: 200 },
  cursor: { max: 500 },
  filterArray: { max: 100 },
  text: { max: 200 },
  sort: { max: 50 },
} as const;
export const paginationFirstSchema = z
  .number()
  .int()
  .min(QUERY_LIMITS.first.min)
  .max(QUERY_LIMITS.first.max);
export const cursorSchema = z.string().max(QUERY_LIMITS.cursor.max).nullish();
export const optionalIdSchema = idSchema.nullish();
const text = z.string().max(QUERY_LIMITS.text.max);
const list = <T extends z.ZodType>(item: T) => z.array(item).max(QUERY_LIMITS.filterArray.max).nullish();
const flag = z.boolean().nullish();
export const productInfoFilterSchema = z.object({
  size: list(text),
  sizeKind: z.string().nullish(),
  price: list(z.number()),
  costPrice: list(z.number()),
  colorId: list(z.number().int()),
  weight: list(z.number()),
  discount: list(z.number()),
  stockQuantity: list(z.number().int()),
});
export const productFilterSchema = z
  .object({
    category: text.nullish(),
    categorySlugs: list(text),
    brand: text.nullish(),
    brands: list(text),
    ids: list(z.number().int()),
    searchTerm: text.nullish(),
    productInfoFilter: productInfoFilterSchema.nullish(),
    categoryIds: list(z.number().int()),
    first: paginationFirstSchema.nullish(),
    after: cursorSchema,
    categoryId: z.number().int().nullish(),
    sort: z.string().max(QUERY_LIMITS.sort.max).nullish(),
    sortOrder: z.enum(['asc', 'desc']).nullish(),
    archivedStatus: z.string().nullish(),
    sellerId: z.number().int().nullish(),
    onlyWithSellers: flag,
    onlyInStock: flag,
    onlyDiscounted: flag,
  })
  .nullish();
export const sellerFilterSchema = z
  .object({
    searchTerm: text.nullish(),
    isActive: flag,
    ids: list(z.number().int()),
    first: paginationFirstSchema.nullish(),
    after: cursorSchema,
  })
  .nullish();

<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/taxonomy.spec.ts">
import {
  categoryFormSchema,
  colorFormSchema,
  createBrandSchema,
  createColorSchema,
  createSiteLanguageSchema,
  optionalDisplayNameSchema,
  updateBrandSchema,
  updateColorSchema,
  updateSiteLanguageSchema,
} from './taxonomy';
const ok = (s: { safeParse: (v: unknown) => { success: boolean } }, v: unknown) => s.safeParse(v).success;
describe('taxonomy schemas', () => {
  it('accepts slugs built from names, including Persian ones', () => {
    expect(ok(createBrandSchema, { slug: 't-shirts', sortOrder: 0 })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(createBrandSchema, { slug: 'کفش-ورزشی' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(updateBrandSchema, { id: 1, slug: null, isActive: false })).toBe(true);
  });
  it('rejects blank or spaced slugs', () => {
    expect(ok(createBrandSchema, { slug: '  ' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(createBrandSchema, { slug: 'a b' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(updateBrandSchema, { slug: 'x' })).toBe(false);
  });
  it('validates hex colors', () => {
    for (const hex of ['#fff', '#00FF00', '#1A1A1A80']) expect(ok(createColorSchema, { hexCode: hex })).toBe(true);
    for (const hex of ['red', '#12345', '00ff00']) expect(ok(updateColorSchema, { hexCode: hex })).toBe(false);
  });
  it('validates site languages', () => {
    expect(ok(createSiteLanguageSchema, { code: 'fa', name: 'Farsi', nativeName: 'فارسی', isRTL: true })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(createSiteLanguageSchema, { code: 'pt-BR', name: 'Portuguese', nativeName: 'Português' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(createSiteLanguageSchema, { code: 'f', name: 'x', nativeName: 'x' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(updateSiteLanguageSchema, { name: '' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(updateSiteLanguageSchema, { isActive: false })).toBe(true);
  });
  it('validates the optional name argument and the admin modals', () => {
    expect(ok(optionalDisplayNameSchema, null)).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(optionalDisplayNameSchema, 'x'.repeat(101))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(categoryFormSchema, { name: ' ' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(colorFormSchema, { name: 'Green', hexCode: '#00ff00' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(colorFormSchema, { name: 'Green', hexCode: 'green' })).toBe(false);
  });
});
</file>

<file path="libs/shared/validation/src/lib/taxonomy.ts">
import { z } from 'zod';
export const TAXONOMY_LIMITS = {
  slug: { max: 100 },
  name: { max: 100 },
  languageCode: { max: 10 },
} as const;
/** `#rgb`, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa`. */
export const HEX_COLOR_PATTERN = /^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3}|[0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{8})$/;
/** Slugs are built from names (lowercase, spaces to hyphens), so only blanks and whitespace are rejected. */
export const slugSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(TAXONOMY_LIMITS.slug.max).regex(/^\S+$/);
export const displayNameSchema = z.string().trim().min(1).max(TAXONOMY_LIMITS.name.max);
/** Optional translated name argument (`name`) on brand/category/color mutations. */
export const optionalDisplayNameSchema = z.string().trim().max(TAXONOMY_LIMITS.name.max).nullish();
export const hexColorSchema = z.string().trim().regex(HEX_COLOR_PATTERN);
const sortOrder = z.number().int().nullish();
const flag = z.boolean().nullish();
export const createBrandSchema = z.object({ slug: slugSchema, sortOrder });
export const updateBrandSchema = z.object({
  id: z.number().int(),
  slug: slugSchema.nullish(),
  sortOrder,
  isActive: flag,
});
export const createCategorySchema = createBrandSchema;
export const updateCategorySchema = updateBrandSchema;
export const createColorSchema = z.object({ hexCode: hexColorSchema, sortOrder });
export const updateColorSchema = z.object({ hexCode: hexColorSchema, sortOrder, isActive: flag });
export const languageCodeSchema = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(2)
  .max(TAXONOMY_LIMITS.languageCode.max)
  .regex(/^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(?:[-_][A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})*$/);
export const createSiteLanguageSchema = z.object({
  code: languageCodeSchema,
  name: displayNameSchema,
  nativeName: displayNameSchema,
  isRTL: flag,
  isActive: flag,
  isDefault: flag,
});
export const updateSiteLanguageSchema = z.object({
  name: displayNameSchema.nullish(),
  nativeName: displayNameSchema.nullish(),
  isRTL: flag,
  isActive: flag,
  isDefault: flag,
});
/** Admin category modal. */
export const categoryFormSchema = z.object({ name: displayNameSchema });
/** Admin color modal. */
export const colorFormSchema = z.object({ name: displayNameSchema, hexCode: hexColorSchema });
export type CategoryFormInput = z.input<typeof categoryFormSchema>;
export type ColorFormInput = z.input<typeof colorFormSchema>;
</file>

describe('CustomerOrderConfirmation pants size formatting', () => {
  it('T1: formats canonical pants size 32x34 as W32/L34', () => {
    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Black', size: '32x34' },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getByText(/Black.*W32\/L34/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('32x34')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('T2: leaves footwear size 42 unchanged', () => {
    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Blue', size: '42' },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getByText(/Blue.*42/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('W42')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('T3: leaves apparel size XL unchanged', () => {
    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Green', size: 'XL' },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getByText(/Green.*XL/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText(/W\d+\/L\d+/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('T4: leaves lookalike 32/34 untouched', () => {
    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Gray', size: '32/34' },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    expect(screen.getByText(/Gray.*32\/34/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('W32/L34')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
  it('T5: renders color only when size is null, no dangling separator', () => {
    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Red', size: null },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // The text node should equal 'Red' exactly (no trailing ' • ')
    const redText = screen.getByText('Red');
    expect(redText.textContent).toBe('Red');
  });
  // T6: 4XL apparel size displays correctly
  it('T6: renders 4XL apparel size immediately after 3XL', () => {
    const testOrderData = {
      ...orderData,
      items: [
        { ...baseItem, color: 'Black', size: '3XL' },
        { ...baseItem, color: 'White', size: '4XL' },
      ],
    };
    render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[{ pathname: '/', state: { orderData: testOrderData } }]}>
        <CustomerOrderConfirmation />
      </MemoryRouter>
    );
    // Both 3XL and 4XL should be displayed
    expect(screen.getByText(/Black.*3XL/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/White.*4XL/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    // 4XL should appear after 3XL in the document
    const bodyText = document.body.textContent || '';
    const xxxlIndex = bodyText.indexOf('3XL');
    const fourXLIndex = bodyText.indexOf('4XL');
    expect(xxxlIndex).toBeLessThan(fourXLIndex);
  });
});

const CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE = /^[1-9]\d?x[1-9]\d?$/;
const displayOrderItemSize = (size?: string | null): string => {
  if (!size) return '';
  const trimmed = size.trim();
  return CANONICAL_PANTS_SIZE_RE.test(trimmed)
    ? formatSizeLabel(SizeKind.Pants, trimmed) || size
    : size;
};

<file path="libs/server/entities/src/lib/seller-order.entity.ts">
import { ObjectType, Field, ID, Float, Int } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { Order, OrderItem, OrderStatus } from './order.entity';
import { ShippingPaymentMode } from './seller-info.entity';
const GUEST_TOKEN_TAG_RE = /\s*\[GuestToken:\s*[^\]]+\]/g;
export function stripGuestTokenFromNotes(notes?: string | null): string | undefined {
  if (notes === undefined || notes === null) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const cleaned = notes.replace(GUEST_TOKEN_TAG_RE, '').trim();
  return cleaned;
}
@ObjectType()
export class SellerOrder {
  @Field(() => ID)
  id: string;
  @Field(() => String)
  orderNumber: string;
  @Field(() => OrderStatus)
  status: OrderStatus;
  @Field(() => Float)
  subtotal: number;
  @Field(() => Float)
  shippingCost: number;
  @Field(() => String, { defaultValue: 'vip' })
  shippingMethod?: string;
  @Field(() => ShippingPaymentMode, {
    defaultValue: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
  })
  shippingPaymentMode?: ShippingPaymentMode;
  @Field(() => Float)
  total: number;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  notes?: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  trackingNumber?: string;
  @Field(() => Date)
  createdAt: Date;
  @Field(() => Date)
  updatedAt: Date;
  @Field(() => Int)
  sellerId: number;
  // Seller snapshot fields
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  sellerStoreName?: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  sellerPhone?: string;
  @Field(() => String, { nullable: true })
  sellerAddress?: string;
  @Field(() => [OrderItem])
  items: OrderItem[];
}
// Helper function to convert Order to SellerOrder (removes customer PII)
export function toSellerOrder(order: Order): SellerOrder {
  return {
    id: order.id,
    orderNumber: order.orderNumber,
    status: order.status,
    subtotal: order.subtotal,
    shippingCost: order.shippingCost,
    shippingMethod: order.shippingMethod || 'vip',
    shippingPaymentMode:
      order.shippingPaymentMode || ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
    total: order.total,
    notes: stripGuestTokenFromNotes(order.notes),
    trackingNumber: order.trackingNumber,
    createdAt: order.createdAt,
    updatedAt: order.updatedAt,
    sellerId: order.sellerId,
    sellerStoreName: order.sellerStoreName,
    sellerPhone: order.sellerPhone,
    sellerAddress: order.sellerAddress,
    items: order.items || [],
  };
}

@InputType()
export class AddToCartInput {
  @Field(() => String)
  sellerProductId: string;

import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { AuthResolver } from './auth.resolver';
import { UserResolver } from './user.resolver';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import { UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';

import type { ZodType } from 'zod';
type ParamMetadata = { index: number; pipes?: unknown[] };
describe('Auth/User resolver argument validation pipes', () => {
  function getParamMetadata(target: object, methodName: string) {
    const args = Reflect.getMetadata(ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA, target.constructor, methodName) ?? {};
    return Object.values(args) as ParamMetadata[];
  }
  function findPipeForArg(paramMetadata: ParamMetadata[], argIndex: number): ZodValidationPipe<ZodType> | undefined {
    const param = paramMetadata.find((p) => p.index === argIndex);
    return param?.pipes?.find((pipe): pipe is ZodValidationPipe<ZodType> => pipe instanceof ZodValidationPipe);
  }
  describe('AuthResolver', () => {
    describe('login', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for email (arg 0)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for password (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('email pipe validates correctly', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ email: string }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('  TEST@EXAMPLE.COM  ')).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform('  TEST@EXAMPLE.COM  ');
        expect(result).toBe('TEST@EXAMPLE.COM');
      });
      it('email pipe rejects invalid email', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('not-an-email')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('password pipe accepts short legacy password', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('abc')).not.toThrow();
      });
      it('password pipe rejects empty', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'login');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
    });
    describe('register', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for name (arg 0)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 0);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for email (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for password (arg 2)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 2);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('password pipe rejects 7 chars (register uses newPasswordSchema)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 2) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('short7')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('password pipe accepts 8 chars', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(AuthResolver.prototype, 'register');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 2) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('validPass')).not.toThrow();
      });
    });
    describe('forgotPassword', () => {

import { UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Response, Request } from 'express';
import { AuthResolver } from './auth.resolver';
import {
  ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
  REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { User, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { GraphqlAuthGuard, RolesGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
describe('AuthResolver', () => {
  let resolver: AuthResolver;
  let authService: {
    validateUser: jest.Mock;
    login: jest.Mock;
    refresh: jest.Mock;
    revokeRefreshTokenByRaw: jest.Mock;
    verifyToken: jest.Mock;
    register: jest.Mock;
  };
  let res: {
    cookie: jest.Mock;
    clearCookie: jest.Mock;
  };
  const mockUser = {
    id: 'user-1',
    email: 'user@test.com',
    role: UserRole.CUSTOMER,
    name: 'Test',
  } as User;
  beforeEach(() => {
    authService = {
      validateUser: jest.fn(),
      login: jest.fn(),
      refresh: jest.fn(),
      revokeRefreshTokenByRaw: jest.fn(),
      verifyToken: jest.fn(),
      register: jest.fn(),
    };
    res = {
      cookie: jest.fn(),
      clearCookie: jest.fn(),
    };
    resolver = new AuthResolver(authService as never);
  });
  const expectAuthCookies = (access: string, refresh: string) => {
    expect(res.cookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'access_token',
      access,
      expect.objectContaining({
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: true,
        sameSite: 'none',
        path: '/',
        maxAge: ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
      })
    );
    expect(res.cookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      'refresh_token',
      refresh,
      expect.objectContaining({
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: true,
        sameSite: 'none',
        path: '/',
        maxAge: REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
      })
    );
  };
  describe('login', () => {
    it('sets access and refresh cookies on successful login', async () => {
      authService.validateUser.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      authService.login.mockResolvedValue({
        access_token: 'access-1',
        refresh_token: 'refresh-1',
      });
      const result = await resolver.login('user@test.com', 'secret', {
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBe(mockUser);
      expectAuthCookies('access-1', 'refresh-1');
    });
    it('throws when credentials are invalid', async () => {
      authService.validateUser.mockResolvedValue(null);
      await expect(
        resolver.login('bad@test.com', 'wrong', {
          res: res as unknown as Response,
        })
      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnauthorizedException);
      expect(res.cookie).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('register', () => {
    it('auto-logs in and sets both cookies', async () => {
      authService.register.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      authService.login.mockResolvedValue({
        access_token: 'access-2',
        refresh_token: 'refresh-2',
      });
      const result = await resolver.register(
        'Test',
        'user@test.com',
        'secret',
        { res: res as unknown as Response }
      );
      expect(result).toBe(mockUser);
      expectAuthCookies('access-2', 'refresh-2');
    });
  });
  describe('refresh', () => {
    it('rotates tokens and sets new cookies', async () => {
      authService.refresh.mockResolvedValue({
        access_token: 'access-new',
        refresh_token: 'refresh-new',
      });
      const result = await resolver.refresh({
        req: {
          cookies: { refresh_token: 'refresh-old' },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBe(true);
      expect(authService.refresh).toHaveBeenCalledWith('refresh-old');
      expectAuthCookies('access-new', 'refresh-new');
    });
    it('clears cookies and throws when refresh cookie is missing', async () => {
      await expect(
        resolver.refresh({
          req: { cookies: {} } as unknown as Request,
          res: res as unknown as Response,
        })
      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnauthorizedException);
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'access_token',
        expect.objectContaining({ httpOnly: true, path: '/' })
      );
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'refresh_token',
        expect.objectContaining({ httpOnly: true, path: '/' })
      );
    });
    it('clears cookies when refresh fails', async () => {
      authService.refresh.mockRejectedValue(
        new UnauthorizedException('Invalid or expired refresh token')
      );
      await expect(
        resolver.refresh({
          req: {
            cookies: { refresh_token: 'bad' },
          } as unknown as Request,
          res: res as unknown as Response,
        })
      ).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(UnauthorizedException);
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('logout', () => {
    it('revokes refresh token and clears both cookies', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.logout({
        req: {
          cookies: { refresh_token: 'refresh-1' },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBe(true);
      expect(authService.revokeRefreshTokenByRaw).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'refresh-1'
      );
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'access_token',
        expect.any(Object)
      );
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'refresh_token',
        expect.any(Object)
      );
    });
  });
  describe('me', () => {
    it('returns user when access token is valid', async () => {
      authService.verifyToken.mockResolvedValue(mockUser);
      const result = await resolver.me({
        req: {
          cookies: { access_token: 'access-ok' },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBe(mockUser);
      expect(authService.refresh).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('silently refreshes when access token is expired but refresh is valid', async () => {
      authService.verifyToken
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(null)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockUser);
      authService.refresh.mockResolvedValue({
        access_token: 'access-new',
        refresh_token: 'refresh-new',
      });
      const result = await resolver.me({
        req: {
          cookies: {
            access_token: 'access-expired',
            refresh_token: 'refresh-ok',
          },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(authService.refresh).toHaveBeenCalledWith('refresh-ok');
      expectAuthCookies('access-new', 'refresh-new');
      expect(result).toBe(mockUser);
    });
    it('returns null when both tokens are missing', async () => {
      const result = await resolver.me({
        req: { cookies: {} } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBeNull();
    });
    it('clears cookies and returns null when refresh fails', async () => {
      authService.verifyToken.mockResolvedValue(null);
      authService.refresh.mockRejectedValue(new UnauthorizedException());
      const result = await resolver.me({
        req: {
          cookies: { refresh_token: 'bad' },
        } as unknown as Request,
        res: res as unknown as Response,
      });
      expect(result).toBeNull();
      expect(res.clearCookie).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('initiatePasswordSetup guards', () => {
    it('has GraphqlAuthGuard and RolesGuard in correct order with ADMIN role', () => {
      const guards = Reflect.getMetadata('__guards__', AuthResolver.prototype.initiatePasswordSetup);
      expect(guards).toEqual([GraphqlAuthGuard, RolesGuard]);
      const roles = Reflect.getMetadata('roles', AuthResolver.prototype.initiatePasswordSetup);
      expect(roles).toEqual([UserRole.ADMIN]);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/auth.resolver.ts">
import { Resolver, Mutation, Args, Context, Query } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import {
  ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
  AuthService,
  REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { User, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { Response, Request } from 'express';
import { UnauthorizedException, UseGuards, SetMetadata } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import {
  emailSchema,
  loginPasswordSchema,
  newPasswordSchema,
  personNameSchema,
  baseUrlSchema,
  tokenSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { GraphqlAuthGuard, RolesGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
const COOKIE_BASE = {
  httpOnly: true,
  secure: true,
  sameSite: 'none' as const,
  path: '/',
};
function setAuthCookies(
  res: Response,
  accessToken: string,
  refreshToken: string
): void {
  res.cookie('access_token', accessToken, {
    ...COOKIE_BASE,
    maxAge: ACCESS_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
  });
  res.cookie('refresh_token', refreshToken, {
    ...COOKIE_BASE,
    maxAge: REFRESH_TOKEN_MAX_AGE_MS,
  });
}
function clearAuthCookies(res: Response): void {
  res.clearCookie('access_token', COOKIE_BASE);
  res.clearCookie('refresh_token', COOKIE_BASE);
}
@Resolver()
export class AuthResolver {
  constructor(private authService: AuthService) {}
  @Mutation(() => User)
  async login(
    @Args('email', new ZodValidationPipe(emailSchema)) email: string,
    @Args('password', new ZodValidationPipe(loginPasswordSchema)) password: string,
    @Context() context: { res: Response }
  ): Promise<User> {
    const user = await this.authService.validateUser(email, password);
    if (!user) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException();
    }
    const { access_token, refresh_token } = await this.authService.login(user);
    setAuthCookies(context.res, access_token, refresh_token);
    return user;
  }
  @Query(() => User, { nullable: true })
  async me(
    @Context() context: { req: Request; res: Response }
  ): Promise<User | null> {
    const accessToken = context.req.cookies?.['access_token'];
    if (accessToken) {
      const user = await this.authService.verifyToken(accessToken);
      if (user) {
        return user;
      }
    }
    // Access JWT missing/expired — try refresh cookie so page reloads keep the session
    const rawRefreshToken = context.req.cookies?.['refresh_token'];
    if (!rawRefreshToken) {
      return null;
    }
    try {
      const { access_token, refresh_token } =
        await this.authService.refresh(rawRefreshToken);
      setAuthCookies(context.res, access_token, refresh_token);
      return this.authService.verifyToken(access_token);
    } catch {
      clearAuthCookies(context.res);
      return null;
    }
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  async refresh(
    @Context() context: { req: Request; res: Response }
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const rawRefreshToken = context.req.cookies?.['refresh_token'];
    if (!rawRefreshToken) {
      clearAuthCookies(context.res);
      throw new UnauthorizedException('No refresh token');
    }
    try {
      const { access_token, refresh_token } =
        await this.authService.refresh(rawRefreshToken);
      setAuthCookies(context.res, access_token, refresh_token);
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      clearAuthCookies(context.res);
      throw error;
    }
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  async logout(
    @Context() context: { req: Request; res: Response }
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const rawRefreshToken = context.req.cookies?.['refresh_token'];
    await this.authService.revokeRefreshTokenByRaw(rawRefreshToken);
    clearAuthCookies(context.res);
    return true;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  async initiatePasswordSetup(
    @Args('email', new ZodValidationPipe(emailSchema)) email: string,
    @Args('baseUrl', new ZodValidationPipe(baseUrlSchema)) baseUrl: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    await this.authService.initiatePasswordSetup(email, baseUrl);
    return true;
  }
  @Mutation(() => User)
  async setupPassword(
    @Args('token', new ZodValidationPipe(tokenSchema)) token: string,
    @Args('newPassword', new ZodValidationPipe(newPasswordSchema)) newPassword: string
  ): Promise<User> {
    return this.authService.setupPassword(token, newPassword);
  }
  @Mutation(() => User)
  async register(
    @Args('name', new ZodValidationPipe(personNameSchema)) name: string,
    @Args('email', new ZodValidationPipe(emailSchema)) email: string,
    @Args('password', new ZodValidationPipe(newPasswordSchema)) password: string,
    @Context() context: { res: Response }
  ): Promise<User> {
    const user = await this.authService.register(name, email, password);
    // Auto-login after registration
    const { access_token, refresh_token } = await this.authService.login(user);
    setAuthCookies(context.res, access_token, refresh_token);
    return user;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  async forgotPassword(
    @Args('email', new ZodValidationPipe(emailSchema)) email: string,
    @Args('baseUrl', new ZodValidationPipe(baseUrlSchema)) baseUrl: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    await this.authService.initiateForgotPassword(email, baseUrl);
    return true;
  }
  @Mutation(() => User)
  async resetPassword(
    @Args('token', new ZodValidationPipe(tokenSchema)) token: string,
    @Args('newPassword', new ZodValidationPipe(newPasswordSchema)) newPassword: string
  ): Promise<User> {
    return this.authService.resetPassword(token, newPassword);
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/cart-validation.spec.ts">
import { BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA } from '@nestjs/common/constants';
import { CartResolver } from './cart.resolver';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import { idSchema, addToCartSchema } from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import type { ZodType } from 'zod';
type ParamMetadata = { index: number; pipes?: unknown[] };
describe('Cart resolver argument validation pipes', () => {
  function getParamMetadata(target: object, methodName: string) {
    const args = Reflect.getMetadata(ROUTE_ARGS_METADATA, target.constructor, methodName) ?? {};
    return Object.values(args) as ParamMetadata[];
  }
  function findPipeForArg(paramMetadata: ParamMetadata[], argIndex: number): ZodValidationPipe<ZodType> | undefined {
    const param = paramMetadata.find((p) => p.index === argIndex);
    return param?.pipes?.find((pipe): pipe is ZodValidationPipe<ZodType> => pipe instanceof ZodValidationPipe);
  }
  describe('CartResolver', () => {
    describe('addToCart', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for addToCartInput (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'addToCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('addToCart pipe rejects quantity 0 with BadRequestException', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'addToCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 0 })).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('addToCart pipe accepts valid input', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'addToCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        const validInput = { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 };
        expect(() => pipe.transform(validInput)).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform(validInput);
        expect(result.sellerProductId).toBe('sp-1');
        expect(result.quantity).toBe(1);
      });
    });
    describe('updateCartItem', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for itemId (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'updateCartItem');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for updateInput (arg 2)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'updateCartItem');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 2);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('updateInput pipe accepts all-null', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'updateCartItem');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 2) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        const allNullInput = { quantity: null, color: null, size: null };
        expect(() => pipe.transform(allNullInput)).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform(allNullInput);
        expect(result).toEqual({ quantity: null, color: null, size: null });
      });
      it('itemId pipe rejects whitespace only', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'updateCartItem');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('  ')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('itemId pipe accepts valid id', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'updateCartItem');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('item-123')).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform('item-123');
        expect(result).toBe('item-123');
      });
    });
    describe('removeFromCart', () => {
      it('has ZodValidationPipe for itemId (arg 1)', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'removeFromCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1);
        expect(pipe).toBeInstanceOf(ZodValidationPipe);
      });
      it('itemId pipe rejects whitespace only', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'removeFromCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('  ')).toThrow(BadRequestException);
      });
      it('itemId pipe accepts valid id', () => {
        const metadata = getParamMetadata(CartResolver.prototype, 'removeFromCart');
        const pipe = findPipeForArg(metadata, 1) as ZodValidationPipe<ZodType<{ sellerProductId: string; quantity: number }>>;
        expect(() => pipe.transform('item-123')).not.toThrow();
        const result = pipe.transform('item-123');
        expect(result).toBe('item-123');
      });
    });
  });
  describe('schema imports sync with primitives', () => {
    it('addToCartSchema uses idSchema for sellerProductId', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: '  sp-1  ', quantity: 1 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.sellerProductId).toBe('sp-1');
      }
    });
    it('updateCartItemSchema uses idSchema for itemId validation', () => {
      const result = idSchema.safeParse('  item-123  ');
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toBe('item-123');
      }
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/cart.resolver.ts">
import {
  Resolver,
  Query,
  Mutation,
  Args,
  ResolveField,
  Parent,
} from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Cart, CartItem } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import {
  AddToCartInput,
  UpdateCartItemInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { CartService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { GraphqlAuthGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { CurrentUser, type AuthenticatedUser } from '@kickzone-workspace/decorators';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import {
  addToCartSchema,
  updateCartItemSchema,
  idSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
@Resolver(() => Cart)
export class CartResolver {
  constructor(private readonly cartService: CartService) {}
  @Query(() => Cart)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async myCart(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    return this.cartService.getCart(user.id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Cart)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async addToCart(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('addToCartInput', new ZodValidationPipe(addToCartSchema)) addToCartInput: AddToCartInput
  ) {
    return this.cartService.addToCart(user.id, addToCartInput);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Cart)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async updateCartItem(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('itemId', { type: () => String }, new ZodValidationPipe(idSchema)) itemId: string,
    @Args('updateInput', new ZodValidationPipe(updateCartItemSchema)) updateInput: UpdateCartItemInput
  ) {
    return this.cartService.updateCartItem(user.id, itemId, updateInput);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Cart)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async removeFromCart(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('itemId', { type: () => String }, new ZodValidationPipe(idSchema)) itemId: string
  ) {
    return this.cartService.removeFromCart(user.id, itemId);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Cart)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async clearCart(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    return this.cartService.clearCart(user.id);
  }
  @ResolveField(() => [CartItem])
  async items(@Parent() cart: Cart) {
    return cart.items;
  }
}

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/order.resolver.status-transitions.spec.ts">
import { OrderResolver } from './order.resolver';
import {
  Order,
  OrderItem,
  OrderStatus,
  User,
  UserRole,
  toSellerOrder,
  SellerOrder,
  SellerInfo,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { ForbiddenException, BadRequestException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
describe('OrderResolver - Seller Status Transitions', () => {
  let resolver: OrderResolver;
  let mockOrderService: {
    findOne: jest.Mock;
    updateOrderStatus: jest.Mock;
  };
  let mockSellerService: {
    findOneByUserId: jest.Mock;
  };
  // Test data factories (re-declared locally per spec)
  const createMockSellerInfo = (overrides: Partial<SellerInfo> = {}): SellerInfo => ({
    id: 1,
    storeName: 'Test Store',
    phone: '09123456789',
    address: 'Seller Address',
    city: 'Tehran',

  });
  const createMockOrder = (overrides: Partial<Order> = {}): Order => ({

    orderNumber: 'ORD-123',
    customerEmail: 'customer@example.com',
    customerPhone: '1234567890',
    customerName: 'John Doe',
    shippingAddress: '123 Main St',
    city: 'Tehran',
    state: 'Tehran',
    zipCode: '12345',
    country: 'Iran',
    status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
    subtotal: 100,
    shippingCost: 10,
    total: 110,
    sellerId: 1,
    sellerStoreName: 'Test Store',
    sellerPhone: '09123456789',

        productId: 'prod-1',
        productName: 'Product 1',
        quantity: 2,
        unitPrice: 50,
        totalPrice: 100,
        sellerProductId: 'seller-prod-1',
      } as OrderItem,
    ],
    seller: createMockSellerInfo(),
    ...overrides,

  const createMockSellerUser = (overrides: Partial<User> = {}): User =>
    createMockUser({
      id: 'seller-user-1',
      email: 'seller@example.com',
      username: 'seller',
      role: UserRole.SELLER,
      ...overrides,
    });
  const createMockAdminUser = (overrides: Partial<User> = {}): User =>
    createMockUser({
      id: 'admin-user-1',
      email: 'admin@example.com',
      username: 'admin',
      role: UserRole.ADMIN,
      ...overrides,
    });
  const createMockUser = (overrides: Partial<User> = {}): User => ({
    id: 'user-1',
    name: 'John',
    lastName: 'Doe',
    username: 'johndoe',
    email: 'john@example.com',
    password: 'hashed',
    role: UserRole.CUSTOMER,
    locale: 'en',
    ...overrides,
  });
  const createMockSellerOrder = (overrides: Partial<SellerOrder> = {}): SellerOrder => ({
    id: 'order-1',
    orderNumber: 'ORD-123',
    status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
    subtotal: 100,
    shippingCost: 10,
    total: 110,
    notes: 'Test order',
    trackingNumber: 'TRACK-123',
    createdAt: new Date('2024-01-01'),
    updatedAt: new Date('2024-01-01'),
    sellerId: 1,
    sellerStoreName: 'Test Store',
    sellerPhone: '09123456789',
    sellerAddress: 'Seller Address',
    items: [
      {
        id: 'item-1',
        orderId: 'order-1',
        productId: 'prod-1',
        productName: 'Product 1',
        quantity: 2,
        unitPrice: 50,
        totalPrice: 100,
        sellerProductId: 'seller-prod-1',
      } as OrderItem,
    ],
    ...overrides,
  });
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockOrderService = {
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      updateOrderStatus: jest.fn(),
    };
    mockSellerService = {
      findOneByUserId: jest.fn(),
    };
    resolver = new OrderResolver(
      mockOrderService as never,
      mockSellerService as never
    );
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus - Seller allowed transitions', () => {
    const mockSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 1, user: { id: 'seller-user-1' } as never });
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerInfo);
    });
    // Valid forward transitions: CONFIRMED->PROCESSING, PROCESSING->SHIPPED, SHIPPED->DELIVERED
    it.each([
      ['CONFIRMED -> PROCESSING', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.PROCESSING],
      ['PROCESSING -> SHIPPED', OrderStatus.PROCESSING, OrderStatus.SHIPPED],
      ['SHIPPED -> DELIVERED', OrderStatus.SHIPPED, OrderStatus.DELIVERED],
    ])('allows owning SELLER to move %s', async (_, fromStatus, toStatus) => {
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: fromStatus });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: toStatus });
      // SellerOrder should not have customerEmail
      const updatedSellerOrder = toSellerOrder(updatedOrder);
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const user = createMockSellerUser({ id: 'seller-user-1' });
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: toStatus });
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('seller-user-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', toStatus);
      // Result should be redacted SellerOrder (no customerEmail)
      expect(result).toEqual(updatedSellerOrder);
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerEmail']).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus - Seller rejected transitions', () => {
    const mockSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 1, user: { id: 'seller-user-1' } as never });
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerInfo);
    });
    // Rejected transitions for owning SELLER
    it.each([
      ['PENDING -> CONFIRMED', OrderStatus.PENDING, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED],
      ['PENDING -> CANCELLED', OrderStatus.PENDING, OrderStatus.CANCELLED],
      ['CONFIRMED -> CANCELLED', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.CANCELLED],
      ['CONFIRMED -> REFUNDED', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.REFUNDED],
      ['SHIPPED -> REFUNDED', OrderStatus.SHIPPED, OrderStatus.REFUNDED],
      ['DELIVERED -> REFUNDED', OrderStatus.DELIVERED, OrderStatus.REFUNDED],
      ['CONFIRMED -> SHIPPED (skip)', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.SHIPPED],
      ['PROCESSING -> CONFIRMED (backwards)', OrderStatus.PROCESSING, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED],
      ['CONFIRMED -> CONFIRMED (no-op)', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED],
      ['DELIVERED -> PROCESSING (backwards)', OrderStatus.DELIVERED, OrderStatus.PROCESSING],
    ])('rejects owning SELLER %s with BadRequestException and does not call service', async (_, fromStatus, toStatus) => {
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: fromStatus });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      const user = createMockSellerUser({ id: 'seller-user-1' });
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: toStatus })
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: toStatus })
      ).rejects.toThrow(`Sellers can only move orders through fulfilment steps (CONFIRMED->PROCESSING->SHIPPED->DELIVERED); ${fromStatus} -> ${toStatus} is not allowed`);
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('seller-user-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus - Non-owning seller rejected', () => {
    it('rejects non-owning SELLER on CONFIRMED->PROCESSING with ForbiddenException', async () => {
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, sellerId: 1 });
      const otherSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 999, user: { id: 'other-seller-user' } as never });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(otherSellerInfo);
      const user = createMockSellerUser({ id: 'other-seller-user' });
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING })
      ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING })
      ).rejects.toThrow('You can only update status for your own seller orders');
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('other-seller-user');
      expect(mockOrderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus - JWT shape { sub, userType: "seller" }', () => {
    const mockSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 1, user: { id: 's-user' } as never });
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerInfo);
    });
    it('allows owning SELLER with { sub, userType: "seller" } CONFIRMED->PROCESSING', async () => {
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, sellerId: 1 });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING });
      const updatedSellerOrder = toSellerOrder(updatedOrder);
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const user = { sub: 's-user', userType: 'seller' } as never;
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING });
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('s-user');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', OrderStatus.PROCESSING);
      expect(result).toEqual(updatedSellerOrder);
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerEmail']).toBeUndefined();
    });
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus - ADMIN unchanged', () => {
    const mockOrder = createMockOrder({ sellerId: 1 });
    const mockSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 1, user: { id: 'seller-user-1' } as never });
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockOrder);
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerInfo);
    });
    it.each([
      ['PENDING -> CONFIRMED', OrderStatus.PENDING, OrderStatus.CONFIRMED],
      ['CONFIRMED -> REFUNDED', OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.REFUNDED],
      ['PENDING -> CANCELLED', OrderStatus.PENDING, OrderStatus.CANCELLED],
      ['DELIVERED -> REFUNDED', OrderStatus.DELIVERED, OrderStatus.REFUNDED],
    ])('allows ADMIN %s (service called, full Order returned)', async (_, fromStatus, toStatus) => {
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: fromStatus });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: toStatus });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderStatus(user, { id: 'order-1', status: toStatus });
      expect(mockOrderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', toStatus);
      expect(result).toEqual(updatedOrder);
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerEmail']).toBeDefined(); // Full Order returned for ADMIN
    });
  });
});

  const createMockSellerOrder = (overrides: Partial<SellerOrder> = {}): SellerOrder => ({
    id: 'order-1',
    orderNumber: 'ORD-123',
    status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
    subtotal: 100,
    shippingCost: 10,
    total: 110,
    notes: 'Test order',
    trackingNumber: 'TRACK-123',
    createdAt: new Date('2024-01-01'),
    updatedAt: new Date('2024-01-01'),
    sellerId: 1,
    sellerStoreName: 'Test Store',
    sellerPhone: '09123456789',
    sellerAddress: 'Seller Address',
    items: [
      {
        id: 'item-1',
        orderId: 'order-1',
        productId: 'prod-1',
        productName: 'Product 1',
        quantity: 2,
        unitPrice: 50,
        totalPrice: 100,
        sellerProductId: 'seller-prod-1',
      } as OrderItem,
    ],
    ...overrides,
  });
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockOrderService = {
      findAll: jest.fn(),
      findOne: jest.fn(),
      updateOrder: jest.fn(),
      updateOrderStatus: jest.fn(),
      deleteOrder: jest.fn(),
      cancelPendingOrder: jest.fn(),
      getOrdersBySeller: jest.fn(),
      getOrdersByCustomerEmail: jest.fn(),
      updateTrackingNumber: jest.fn(),
    };
    mockSellerService = {
      findOneByUserId: jest.fn(),
    };
    resolver = new OrderResolver(
      mockOrderService as never,
      mockSellerService as never
    );
  });
  describe('updateOrderTracking mutation', () => {
    const mockSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 1, user: { id: 'seller-user-1' } as never });
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerInfo);
    });
    it('rejects CUSTOMER with ForbiddenException', async () => {
      const user = createMockUser({ role: UserRole.CUSTOMER });
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow('Customers are not allowed to update tracking');
      expect(mockOrderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects SELLER not owning order with ForbiddenException and does not call updateTrackingNumber', async () => {
      const user = createMockSellerUser({ id: 'other-seller-user' });
      const otherSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 999, user: { id: 'other-seller-user' } as never });
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(otherSellerInfo);
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, sellerId: 1 });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow('You can only update tracking for your own seller orders');
      expect(mockOrderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('other-seller-user');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects SELLER with no profile with ForbiddenException', async () => {
      const user = createMockSellerUser({ id: 'seller-user-1' });
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(null);
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, sellerId: 1 });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow('You can only update tracking for your own seller orders');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('allows SELLER owning a CONFIRMED order, calls updateTrackingNumber with trimmed value, returns redacted SellerOrder', async () => {
      const user = createMockSellerUser({ id: 'seller-user-1' });
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, sellerId: 1, trackingNumber: '' });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, sellerId: 1, trackingNumber: 'TRK123' });
      const updatedSellerOrder = toSellerOrder(updatedOrder);
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', '  TRK123  ');
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('seller-user-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', 'TRK123');
      expect(result).toEqual(updatedSellerOrder);
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerEmail']).toBeUndefined();
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerPhone']).toBeUndefined();
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerName']).toBeUndefined();
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['shippingAddress']).toBeUndefined();
    });
    it('allows ADMIN on SHIPPED order, returns full Order', async () => {
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.SHIPPED, sellerId: 1, trackingNumber: '' });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.SHIPPED, sellerId: 1, trackingNumber: 'TRK123' });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123');
      expect(mockOrderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', 'TRK123');
      expect(result).toEqual(updatedOrder);
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerEmail']).toBeDefined();
    });
    it('rejects PENDING order with BadRequestException and does not call updateTrackingNumber', async () => {
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.PENDING });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow('Tracking can only be set on confirmed, processing or shipped orders');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects DELIVERED order with BadRequestException and does not call updateTrackingNumber', async () => {
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.DELIVERED });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow('Tracking can only be set on confirmed, processing or shipped orders');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects CANCELLED order with BadRequestException and does not call updateTrackingNumber', async () => {
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects REFUNDED order with BadRequestException and does not call updateTrackingNumber', async () => {
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.REFUNDED });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects empty tracking number with BadRequestException', async () => {
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', '')
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', '')
      ).rejects.toThrow('Tracking number must be 1-100 characters');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects whitespace-only tracking number with BadRequestException', async () => {
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', '   ')
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', '   ')
      ).rejects.toThrow('Tracking number must be 1-100 characters');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects 101-character tracking number with BadRequestException', async () => {
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      const longTracking = 'A'.repeat(101);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', longTracking)
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', longTracking)
      ).rejects.toThrow('Tracking number must be 1-100 characters');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('accepts 100-character tracking number', async () => {
      const user = createMockAdminUser();
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, trackingNumber: 'A'.repeat(100) });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'A'.repeat(100));
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', 'A'.repeat(100));
      expect(result.trackingNumber).toBe('A'.repeat(100));
    });
    it('allows SELLER with JWT shape { sub, userType: "seller" } owning order', async () => {
      const user = { sub: 'seller-user-1', userType: 'seller' } as never;
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING, sellerId: 1 });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING, sellerId: 1, trackingNumber: 'TRK123' });
      const updatedSellerOrder = toSellerOrder(updatedOrder);
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', '  TRK123  ');
      expect(mockSellerService.findOneByUserId).toHaveBeenCalledWith('seller-user-1');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', 'TRK123');
      expect(result).toEqual(updatedSellerOrder);
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerEmail']).toBeUndefined();
    });
    it('rejects UNKNOWN role with ForbiddenException', async () => {
      const user = { id: 'user-1', userType: 'INVALID' } as never;
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow('Customers are not allowed to update tracking');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects SELLER with JWT shape { sub, userType: "seller" } not owning order', async () => {
      const user = { sub: 'other-s-user', userType: 'seller' } as never;
      const otherSellerInfo = createMockSellerInfo({ id: 999, user: { id: 'other-s-user' } as never });
      mockSellerService.findOneByUserId.mockResolvedValue(otherSellerInfo);
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, sellerId: 1 });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow('You can only update tracking for your own seller orders');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('rejects CUSTOMER with JWT shape { sub, userType: "customer" }', async () => {
      const user = { sub: 'c-user', userType: 'customer', email: 'customer@example.com' } as never;
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
      await expect(
        resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123')
      ).rejects.toThrow('Customers are not allowed to update tracking');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('allows ADMIN with JWT shape { sub, userType: "admin" } on CONFIRMED order', async () => {
      const user = { sub: 'a-user', userType: 'admin' } as never;
      const order = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED });
      const updatedOrder = createMockOrder({ status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, trackingNumber: 'TRK123' });
      mockOrderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber.mockResolvedValue(updatedOrder);
      const result = await resolver.updateOrderTracking(user, 'order-1', 'TRK123');
      expect(mockOrderService.updateTrackingNumber).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', 'TRK123');
      expect(result).toEqual(updatedOrder);
      expect((result as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['customerEmail']).toBeDefined();
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/seller-info.resolver.spec.ts">
import { Reflector } from '@nestjs/core';
import { ExecutionContext } from '@nestjs/common';
import { RolesGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { SellerResolver } from './seller-info.resolver';
import { SellerService, ProductService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { ShippingPaymentMode, UserRole } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
jest.mock('@nestjs/graphql', () => {
  const actual = jest.requireActual('@nestjs/graphql');
  return {
    ...actual,
    GqlExecutionContext: {
      create: jest.fn((ctx: ExecutionContext) => ({
        getContext: () => ctx.switchToHttp().getRequest(),
      })),
    },
  };
});
describe('SellerResolver - Admin-Only shippingPaymentMode Guard & Mutation', () => {
  const reflector = new Reflector();
  const guard = new RolesGuard(reflector);
  function mockGqlContext(user?: { id: string; role: UserRole }) {
    return {
      getHandler: () => SellerResolver.prototype.updateSeller,
      switchToHttp: () => ({
        getRequest: () => ({ req: { user } }),
      }),
    } as unknown as ExecutionContext;
  }
  it('allows only ADMIN role to invoke updateSeller (which toggles shippingPaymentMode)', () => {
    expect(
      guard.canActivate(mockGqlContext({ id: '1', role: UserRole.ADMIN })),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      guard.canActivate(mockGqlContext({ id: '2', role: UserRole.SELLER })),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      guard.canActivate(mockGqlContext({ id: '3', role: UserRole.CUSTOMER })),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(guard.canActivate(mockGqlContext(undefined))).toBe(false);
  });
  it('forwards shippingPaymentMode update to SellerService.update', async () => {
    const sellerService = {
      update: jest.fn(async (input) => ({
        id: input.id,
        storeName: 'Selected Seller',
        shippingFee: 12,
        shippingPaymentMode: input.shippingPaymentMode,
      })),
    };
    const resolver = new SellerResolver(
      sellerService as unknown as SellerService,
      {} as unknown as ProductService
    );
    const updated = await resolver.updateSeller({
      id: 7,
      shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE,
    });
    expect(sellerService.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      id: 7,
      shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE,
    });
    expect(updated?.shippingPaymentMode).toBe(ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE);
  });
});
