import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, DeepPartial, SaveOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { CartService } from './cart.service';
import { Cart, CartItem, SellerProduct } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
type PrivateMethods = Record<string, (...args: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>>;
describe('CartService - null relation guards', () => {
  let service: CartService;
  let cartRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<Cart>>;
  let cartItemRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<CartItem>>;
  let sellerProductRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<SellerProduct>>;
  const mockSellerProduct = (overrides: Partial<SellerProduct> = {}): SellerProduct => ({
    id: 'sp-1',
    price: 99.95,
    discount: 10,
    stockQuantity: 100,
    product: { id: 1, name: 'Test Product' } as never,
    productInfo: {
      id: 'pi-1',
      images: ['image.jpg'],
      colorLinks: [],
      size: 'M',
    } as never,
    seller: { id: 's-1', storeName: 'Test Store' } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'],
    productInfoId: 1,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  const mockCart = (overrides: Partial<Cart> = {}): Cart => ({
    id: 'cart-1',
    userId: 'user-1',
    subtotal: 0,
    total: 0,
    items: [],
    createdAt: new Date(),
    updatedAt: new Date(),
    user: { id: 'user-1' } as never,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  const mockCartItem = (overrides: Partial<CartItem> = {}): CartItem => ({
    id: 'ci-1',
    cartId: 'cart-1',
    productId: '1',
    productName: 'Test Product',
    productImage: 'image.jpg',
    quantity: 2,
    unitPrice: 89.96,
    totalPrice: 179.92,
    color: '#ff0000',
    size: 'M',
    sellerId: 's-1',
    sellerName: 'Test Store',
    productInfoId: 'pi-1',
    sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
    availableStock: 100,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  beforeEach(async () => {
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        CartService,
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(Cart),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
            create: jest.fn(),
            save: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(CartItem),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
            create: jest.fn(),
            save: jest.fn(),
            remove: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
      ],
    }).compile();
    service = module.get<CartService>(CartService);
    cartRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(Cart));
    cartItemRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(CartItem));
    sellerProductRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct));
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });
  describe('addToCart with missing product relation', () => {
    it('should reject with NotFoundException when sellerProduct.product is null', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ product: null as never });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 })
      ).rejects.toThrow('Product for SellerProduct sp-1 not found');
      // Verify it's not a TypeError
      try {
        await service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 });
      } catch (e) {
        expect(e).not.toBeInstanceOf(TypeError);
        expect(e).toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);
      }
      // cartItemRepository.save should NOT be called
      expect(cartItemRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('addToCart with missing seller relation', () => {
    it('should reject with NotFoundException when sellerProduct.seller is null', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ seller: null as never });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(NotFoundException);
      await expect(
        service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 })
      ).rejects.toThrow('Seller for SellerProduct sp-1 not found');
      // Verify it's not a TypeError
      try {
        await service.addToCart('user-1', { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 });
      } catch (e) {
        expect(e).not.toBeInstanceOf(TypeError);
        expect(e).toBeInstanceOf(NotFoundException);
      }
      // cartItemRepository.save should NOT be called
      expect(cartItemRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('addToCart with valid product and seller', () => {
    it('should add item successfully when both product and seller are present', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 100 });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      const result = await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 1,
      });
      // cartItemRepository.save should be called
      expect(cartItemRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalled();
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.quantity).toBe(1);
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(89.96); // 99.95 - (99.95 * 10 / 100) = 89.955 -> 89.96
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(89.96); // 1 * 89.96
      expect(savedItem.productId).toBe('1');
      expect(savedItem.productName).toBe('Test Product');
      expect(savedItem.sellerId).toBe('s-1');
      expect(savedItem.sellerName).toBe('Test Store');
    });
  });
});

import { Test, TestingModule } from '@nestjs/testing';
import { getRepositoryToken } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, DeepPartial, SaveOptions } from 'typeorm';
import { CartService } from './cart.service';
import { Cart, CartItem, SellerProduct } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { NotFoundException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
type PrivateMethods = Record<string, (...args: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown>>;
describe('CartService', () => {
  let service: CartService;
  let cartRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<Cart>>;
  let cartItemRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<CartItem>>;
  let sellerProductRepository: jest.Mocked<Repository<SellerProduct>>;
  const mockSellerProduct = (overrides: Partial<SellerProduct> = {}): SellerProduct => ({
    id: 'sp-1',
    price: 99.95,
    discount: 10,
    stockQuantity: 100,
    product: { id: 1, name: 'Test Product' } as never,
    productInfo: {
      id: 'pi-1',
      images: ['image.jpg'],
      colorLinks: [],
      size: 'M',
    } as never,
    seller: { id: 's-1', storeName: 'Test Store' } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'],
    productInfoId: 1,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  const mockCart = (overrides: Partial<Cart> = {}): Cart => ({
    id: 'cart-1',
    userId: 'user-1',
    subtotal: 0,
    total: 0,
    items: [],
    createdAt: new Date(),
    updatedAt: new Date(),
    user: { id: 'user-1' } as never,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  const mockCartItem = (overrides: Partial<CartItem> = {}): CartItem => ({
    id: 'ci-1',
    cartId: 'cart-1',
    productId: '1',
    productName: 'Test Product',
    productImage: 'image.jpg',
    quantity: 2,
    unitPrice: 89.96,
    totalPrice: 179.92,
    color: '#ff0000',
    size: 'M',
    sellerId: 's-1',
    sellerName: 'Test Store',
    productInfoId: 'pi-1',
    sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
    availableStock: 100,
    ...overrides,
  }) as never;
  beforeEach(async () => {
    const module: TestingModule = await Test.createTestingModule({
      providers: [
        CartService,
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(Cart),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
            create: jest.fn(),
            save: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(CartItem),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
            create: jest.fn(),
            save: jest.fn(),
            remove: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
        {
          provide: getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct),
          useValue: {
            findOne: jest.fn(),
          },
        },
      ],
    }).compile();
    service = module.get<CartService>(CartService);
    cartRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(Cart));
    cartItemRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(CartItem));
    sellerProductRepository = module.get(getRepositoryToken(SellerProduct));
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });
  describe('toDecimalNumber (private helper via public behavior)', () => {
    it('should coerce numeric strings to numbers', async () => {
      // This tests the private toDecimalNumber via recalculateCartTotals
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: [
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '10.00' as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '20.00' as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '15.55' as never }),
        ],
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      // Access private method via public recalculateCartTotals
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(45.55);
      expect(typeof cart.subtotal).toBe('number');
      expect(cart.total).toBe(45.55);
    });
    it('should handle empty cart', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(0);
      expect(cart.total).toBe(0);
      expect(typeof cart.subtotal).toBe('number');
    });
    it('should handle non-finite values gracefully', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: [
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '10.00' as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: NaN as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: Infinity as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: null as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: undefined as never }),
        ],
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(10.00);
      expect(typeof cart.subtotal).toBe('number');
    });
    it('should correctly sum quantities as integers', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: [
          mockCartItem({ quantity: 2, totalPrice: '10.00' as never }),
          mockCartItem({ quantity: '3' as never, totalPrice: '20.00' as never }), // quantity as string
          mockCartItem({ quantity: 1.9, totalPrice: '15.55' as never }), // quantity as float
        ],
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      // totalItems should be 2 + 3 + 1 = 6 (truncated)
      // We can't directly test totalItems since it's not stored, but we verify no crash
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(45.55);
    });
  });
  describe('addToCart', () => {
    it('should calculate finalPrice correctly with string price and discount from Postgres', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '99.95' as never, // string from Postgres
        discount: '10' as never, // string from Postgres
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      // Spy on recalculateCartTotals to avoid double mocking
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      const result = await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 2,
      });
      // finalPrice = 99.95 - (99.95 * 10 / 100) = 89.955 -> rounded to 89.96
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(89.96);
      expect(typeof savedItem.unitPrice).toBe('number');
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(179.92); // 2 * 89.96
      expect(typeof savedItem.totalPrice).toBe('number');
    });
    it('should handle zero discount', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '50.00' as never,
        discount: '0' as never,
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 1,
      });
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(50.00);
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(50.00);
    });
    it('should handle missing discount (null/undefined)', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '50.00' as never,
        discount: null as never,
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [] });

      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await service.addToCart('user-1', {

        quantity: 1,
      });

      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(50.00);
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(50.00);
    });
    it('should update existing item quantity and recalculate totalPrice with coercion', async () => {
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '100.00' as never,
        discount: '20' as never,
      });
      const existingItem = mockCartItem({
        id: 'ci-existing',
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: 80.00,
        totalPrice: '80.00' as never, // string from Postgres
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [existingItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 2, // Adding 2 more
      });
      // Should update existing item: quantity = 1 + 2 = 3
      // unitPrice = 100 - (100 * 20 / 100) = 80
      // totalPrice = 3 * 80 = 240
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0];
      expect(savedItem.quantity).toBe(3);
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(80.00);
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(240.00);
    });
    it('should throw NotFoundException when sellerProduct not found', async () => {

    });
    it('should refresh unitPrice and totalPrice when sellerProduct price/discount changed on existing item', async () => {
      // Initial state: product price 100, discount 20 -> unitPrice 80
      const sellerProductInitial = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '100.00' as never,
        discount: '20' as never,
        stockQuantity: 100,
      });
      const existingItem = mockCartItem({
        id: 'ci-existing',
        quantity: 1,
        unitPrice: 80.00,
        totalPrice: '80.00' as never,
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        availableStock: 100,
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [existingItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProductInitial);
      cartItemRepository.save.mockImplementation((item: DeepPartial<CartItem>, _options?: SaveOptions) => Promise.resolve(item as DeepPartial<CartItem> & CartItem));
      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      // First addToCart - adds 1 more to existing item (qty becomes 2)
      await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 1,
      });
      // Now sellerProduct price changed to 150, discount 10 -> new unitPrice = 135
      const sellerProductChanged = mockSellerProduct({
        price: '150.00' as never,
        discount: '10' as never,
        stockQuantity: 100,
      });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProductChanged);
      // Add more quantity - should refresh price (adds 2 more, qty becomes 4)
      await service.addToCart('user-1', {
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        quantity: 2,
      });
      const savedItem = cartItemRepository.save.mock.calls[1][0];
      // quantity = 1 (existing) + 1 (first add) + 2 (second add) = 4
      // new unitPrice = 150 - (150 * 10 / 100) = 135
      // totalPrice = 4 * 135 = 540
      expect(savedItem.quantity).toBe(4);
      expect(savedItem.unitPrice).toBe(135.00);
      expect(savedItem.totalPrice).toBe(540.00);
      expect(savedItem.availableStock).toBe(100);
    });
  });
  describe('updateCartItem', () => {
    it('should coerce quantity and recalculate totalPrice with string unitPrice from Postgres', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({
        id: 'ci-1',
        quantity: 2,

        totalPrice: '179.92' as never,

    it('should handle string quantity input', async () => {

      jest.spyOn(service as unknown as PrivateMethods, 'recalculateCartTotals').mockResolvedValue(undefined);

    it('should throw NotFoundException when cart item not found', async () => {

        id: 'ci-1',
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
      });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 5 });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      await expect(

    it('should throw BadRequestException when quantity is negative (legacy test updated)', async () => {

        service.updateCartItem('user-1', 'ci-1', { quantity: -5 })
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should refresh unitPrice from sellerProduct when sellerProduct exists', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({
        id: 'ci-1',

    it('should throw BadRequestException when quantity is negative', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-1', sellerProductId: 'sp-1' });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 100 });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);

    it('should throw BadRequestException when quantity is a float (1.5)', async () => {
      const cartItem = mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-1', sellerProductId: 'sp-1' });
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [cartItem] });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const sellerProduct = mockSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 100 });
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);

    it('should clear all items and reset totals to 0', async () => {
      const cartItems = [mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-1' }), mockCartItem({ id: 'ci-2' })];
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: cartItems,
        subtotal: 100,
        total: 100,
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartItemRepository.remove.mockResolvedValue({} as never);
      // Mock the second findOne call for the fresh cart
      const freshCart = mockCart({ items: [], subtotal: 0, total: 0 });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce(cart).mockResolvedValueOnce(freshCart);
      const result = await service.clearCart('user-1');
      expect(cartItemRepository.remove).toHaveBeenCalledWith(cartItems);
      expect(result.subtotal).toBe(0);
      expect(result.total).toBe(0);
      expect(result.items).toEqual([]);

    it('should handle already empty cart', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ items: [], subtotal: 0, total: 0 });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const freshCart = mockCart({ items: [], subtotal: 0, total: 0 });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce(cart).mockResolvedValueOnce(freshCart);
      const result = await service.clearCart('user-1');
      expect(result.subtotal).toBe(0);
      expect(result.total).toBe(0);
    });
  });
  describe('getCart', () => {
    it('should return cart from getOrCreateCart', async () => {
      const cart = mockCart({ id: 'cart-1' });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      const result = await service.getCart('user-1');
      expect(result).toBe(cart);
    });
  });
  describe('roundMoney (private helper via public behavior)', () => {
    it('should round to 2 decimal places correctly', async () => {
      // Test various floating point edge cases
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: [
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '10.005' as never }), // Should round to 10.01
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '20.004' as never }), // Should round to 20.00
        ],
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      // 10.005 + 20.004 = 30.009 -> rounded to 30.01
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(30.01);
    });
    it('should handle floating point drift', async () => {
      // 0.1 + 0.2 = 0.30000000000000004 in JS
      const cart = mockCart({
        items: [
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '0.1' as never }),
          mockCartItem({ totalPrice: '0.2' as never }),
        ],
      });
      cartRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      cartRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(cart);
      await service['recalculateCartTotals']('cart-1');
      expect(cart.subtotal).toBe(0.3);
    });
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/services/src/lib/cart.service.ts">
import { Injectable, NotFoundException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Cart, CartItem, SellerProduct } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import {
  AddToCartInput,
  UpdateCartItemInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { serializeProductInfoColorHexes } from './product-info-colors.util';
@Injectable()
export class CartService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Cart)
    private cartRepository: Repository<Cart>,
    @InjectRepository(CartItem)
    private cartItemRepository: Repository<CartItem>,
    @InjectRepository(SellerProduct)
    private sellerProductRepository: Repository<SellerProduct>
  ) {}
  /**
   * Safely coerces any value (including Postgres numeric strings) to a finite number.
   * Returns 0 for non-finite values (NaN, Infinity, null, undefined, non-numeric strings).
   */
  private toDecimalNumber(value: unknown): number {
    const parsed = Number(value);
    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
  }
  /**
   * Rounds a monetary value to 2 decimal places to avoid floating-point drift.
   * Uses the standard "round half up" with Number.EPSILON correction.
   */
  private roundMoney(value: number): number {
    return Math.round((value + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100;
  }
  async getOrCreateCart(userId: string): Promise<Cart> {
    let cart = await this.cartRepository.findOne({
      where: { userId },
      relations: ['items', 'items.product'],
    });
    if (!cart) {
      cart = this.cartRepository.create({
        userId,
        subtotal: 0,
        total: 0,
      });
      await this.cartRepository.save(cart);
    }
    return cart;
  }
  async addToCart(
    userId: string,
    addToCartInput: AddToCartInput
  ): Promise<Cart> {
    // Validate quantity: must be a positive integer
    const quantity = Number(addToCartInput.quantity);
    if (!Number.isInteger(quantity) || quantity <= 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Quantity must be a positive integer');
    }
    // Fetch the SellerProduct from database to get all product info
    const sellerProduct = await this.sellerProductRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: addToCartInput.sellerProductId },
      relations: [
        'product',
        'productInfo',
        'productInfo.colorLinks',
        'productInfo.colorLinks.color',
        'seller',
      ],
    });
    if (!sellerProduct) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `SellerProduct with ID ${addToCartInput.sellerProductId} not found`
      );
    }
    if (!sellerProduct.product) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `Product for SellerProduct ${addToCartInput.sellerProductId} not found`
      );
    }
    if (!sellerProduct.seller) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `Seller for SellerProduct ${addToCartInput.sellerProductId} not found`
      );
    }
    const cart = await this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
    // Check if item already exists in cart
    const existingItem = cart.items.find(
      (item) => item.sellerProductId === addToCartInput.sellerProductId
    );
    const currentQty = existingItem?.quantity || 0;
    const requestedTotal = currentQty + addToCartInput.quantity;
    // Check stock availability including what is already in the cart
    if (sellerProduct.stockQuantity < requestedTotal) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        `Insufficient stock. Available: ${sellerProduct.stockQuantity}, Already in cart: ${currentQty}, Requested: ${addToCartInput.quantity}`
      );
    }
    // Calculate final price after discount - coerce Postgres numeric strings to numbers
    const price = this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.price);
    const discount = this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.discount);
    const finalPrice = this.roundMoney(
      discount > 0 ? price - (price * discount) / 100 : price
    );
    if (existingItem) {
      // Update quantity and refresh catalog price/stock
      existingItem.quantity = Math.max(
        0,
        Math.trunc(this.toDecimalNumber(existingItem.quantity)) +
          Math.max(0, Math.trunc(this.toDecimalNumber(addToCartInput.quantity)))
      );
      existingItem.unitPrice = finalPrice;
      existingItem.availableStock = sellerProduct.stockQuantity;
      existingItem.totalPrice = this.roundMoney(
        this.toDecimalNumber(existingItem.quantity) * finalPrice
      );
      await this.cartItemRepository.save(existingItem);
    } else {
      // Add new item with data from database
      const cartItem = new CartItem();
      cartItem.cartId = cart.id;
      cartItem.productId = sellerProduct.product.id.toString();
      cartItem.productName = sellerProduct.product.name;
      cartItem.productImage = sellerProduct.productInfo?.images?.[0];
      cartItem.quantity = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(this.toDecimalNumber(addToCartInput.quantity)));
      cartItem.unitPrice = finalPrice;
      cartItem.totalPrice = this.roundMoney(
        this.toDecimalNumber(cartItem.quantity) * finalPrice
      );
      cartItem.color = serializeProductInfoColorHexes(
        sellerProduct.productInfo?.colorLinks
      );
      cartItem.size = sellerProduct.productInfo?.size;
      cartItem.sellerId = sellerProduct.seller.id.toString();
      cartItem.sellerName = sellerProduct.seller.storeName;
      cartItem.productInfoId = sellerProduct.productInfo?.id.toString();
      cartItem.sellerProductId = sellerProduct.id;
      cartItem.availableStock = sellerProduct.stockQuantity;
      await this.cartItemRepository.save(cartItem);
    }
    // Recalculate cart totals
    await this.recalculateCartTotals(cart.id);
    return this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
  }
  async updateCartItem(
    userId: string,
    itemId: string,
    updateInput: UpdateCartItemInput
  ): Promise<Cart> {
    const cart = await this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
    const cartItem = cart.items.find((item) => item.id === itemId);
    if (!cartItem) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Cart item not found');
    }
    if (updateInput.quantity !== undefined && updateInput.quantity !== null) {
      const requestedQuantity = Number(updateInput.quantity);
      if (!Number.isInteger(requestedQuantity) || requestedQuantity <= 0) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Quantity must be a positive integer');
      }
      if (cartItem.sellerProductId) {
        const sellerProduct = await this.sellerProductRepository.findOne({
          where: { id: cartItem.sellerProductId },
        });
        if (sellerProduct) {
          if (requestedQuantity > this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.stockQuantity)) {
            throw new NotFoundException(
              `Insufficient stock. Available: ${this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.stockQuantity)}, Requested: ${requestedQuantity}`
            );
          }
          const price = this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.price);
          const discount = this.toDecimalNumber(sellerProduct.discount);
          cartItem.unitPrice = this.roundMoney(
            discount > 0 ? price - (price * discount) / 100 : price
          );
          cartItem.availableStock = sellerProduct.stockQuantity;
        }
      }
      cartItem.quantity = requestedQuantity;
      cartItem.unitPrice = this.roundMoney(this.toDecimalNumber(cartItem.unitPrice));
      cartItem.totalPrice = this.roundMoney(
        this.toDecimalNumber(cartItem.quantity) *
          this.toDecimalNumber(cartItem.unitPrice)
      );
    }
    await this.cartItemRepository.save(cartItem);
    // Recalculate cart totals
    await this.recalculateCartTotals(cart.id);
    return this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
  }
  async removeFromCart(userId: string, itemId: string): Promise<Cart> {
    const cart = await this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
    const cartItem = cart.items.find((item) => item.id === itemId);
    if (!cartItem) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Cart item not found');
    }
    await this.cartItemRepository.remove(cartItem);
    // Recalculate cart totals
    await this.recalculateCartTotals(cart.id);
    return this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
  }
  async clearCart(userId: string): Promise<Cart> {
    const cart = await this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
    // Remove all items using the entities (more reliable than delete query)
    if (cart.items && cart.items.length > 0) {
      await this.cartItemRepository.remove(cart.items);
    }
    // Reset cart totals
    cart.subtotal = 0;
    cart.total = 0;
    cart.items = []; // Clear items array
    await this.cartRepository.save(cart);
    // Verify it's actually cleared
    const freshCart = await this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
    return freshCart;
  }
  async getCart(userId: string): Promise<Cart> {
    return this.getOrCreateCart(userId);
  }
  private async recalculateCartTotals(cartId: string): Promise<void> {
    const cart = await this.cartRepository.findOne({
      where: { id: cartId },
      relations: ['items'],
    });
    if (!cart) return;
    const totalAmount = this.roundMoney(
      cart.items.reduce(
        (sum, item) => sum + this.toDecimalNumber(item.totalPrice),
        0
      )
    );
    const totalItems = cart.items.reduce(
      (sum, item) =>
        sum + Math.max(0, Math.trunc(this.toDecimalNumber(item.quantity))),
      0
    );
    cart.subtotal = totalAmount;
    cart.total = totalAmount; // No shipping cost for cart
    await this.cartRepository.save(cart);
  }
}

  it('adds no brand or category-slug clauses when the arrays are empty', async () => {

    productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
    await service.getProducts({ brand: 'Nike' });
    expect(qb['andWhere']).toHaveBeenCalledWith('LOWER(brand.slug) = :brandSlug', {
      brandSlug: 'nike',
    });
  });
  it('getProducts productInfoFilter does not reference removed ProductInfo columns', async () => {
    const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
    productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
    await service.getProducts({
      productInfoFilter: {
        price: [100],
        costPrice: [50],
        discount: [10],
        stockQuantity: [5],
      },
    });
    const sqls = allSqlCalls(qb).map(([sql]) => sql);
    const forbidden = [
      'productInfo.price',
      'productInfo.costPrice',
      'productInfo.discount',
      'productInfo.stockQuantity',
    ];
    for (const f of forbidden) {
      expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes(f))).toBe(false);
    }
    // Should use sellerProduct alias for price/costPrice/discount/stockQuantity
    const whereCallsList = whereCalls(qb);
    expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.price IN (:...price)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['price']) === JSON.stringify([100]))).toBe(true);
    expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.costPrice IN (:...costPrice)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['costPrice']) === JSON.stringify([50]))).toBe(true);
    expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.discount IN (:...discount)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['discount']) === JSON.stringify([10]))).toBe(true);
    expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.stockQuantity IN (:...stockQuantity)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['stockQuantity']) === JSON.stringify([5]))).toBe(true);
  });
  it('getProducts sort by color uses color.hexCode not color.name', async () => {
    const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
    productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
    await service.getProducts({ sort: 'color' });
    const sqls = allSqlCalls(qb).map(([sql]) => sql);
    expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes('color.name'))).toBe(false);
    expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes('color.hexCode'))).toBe(true);
  });
  describe('getSellerProducts', () => {
    it('productInfoFilter does not reference removed ProductInfo columns', async () => {
      const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
      productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
      await service.getSellerProducts(1, {
        productInfoFilter: {
          price: [100],
          costPrice: [50],
          discount: [10],
          stockQuantity: [5],
        },
      });
      const sqls = allSqlCalls(qb).map(([sql]) => sql);
      const forbidden = [
        'productInfo.price',
        'productInfo.costPrice',
        'productInfo.discount',
        'productInfo.stockQuantity',
      ];
      for (const f of forbidden) {
        expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes(f))).toBe(false);
      }
      // Should use sellerProduct alias for price/costPrice/discount/stockQuantity
      const whereCallsList = whereCalls(qb);
      expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.price IN (:...price)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['price']) === JSON.stringify([100]))).toBe(true);
      expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.costPrice IN (:...costPrice)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['costPrice']) === JSON.stringify([50]))).toBe(true);
      expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.discount IN (:...discount)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['discount']) === JSON.stringify([10]))).toBe(true);
      expect(whereCallsList.some(([sql, params]) => sql === 'sellerProduct.stockQuantity IN (:...stockQuantity)' && JSON.stringify(params?.['stockQuantity']) === JSON.stringify([5]))).toBe(true);
    });
    it('sort by color uses color.hexCode not color.name', async () => {
      const qb = makeQueryBuilder();
      productRepo.createQueryBuilder.mockReturnValue(qb as never);
      await service.getSellerProducts(1, { sort: 'color' });
      const sqls = allSqlCalls(qb).map(([sql]) => sql);
      expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes('color.name'))).toBe(false);
      expect(sqls.some((s) => s.includes('color.hexCode'))).toBe(true);
    });
  });
});

import { ShippingCalculationService, applyShippingMethodMultiplier } from './shipping-calculation.service';
import { PlatformSettings, ShippingStrategy, ShippingPaymentMode } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
describe('ShippingCalculationService', () => {
  let service: ShippingCalculationService;

  const mockSettings: PlatformSettings = {
    id: 1,
    freeShippingEnabled: true,
    freeShippingThreshold: 100,
    shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
    additionalSellerDiscount: 0.5,
    additionalSellerFixedFee: 2.5,

        expect(item.appliedFee).toBe(0);
        expect(item.originalFee).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
      });

    it('should return originalFee as number even when shippingFee is 0', async () => {
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 0, sellerName: 'Free Ship Seller' },

      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '2')?.appliedFee).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
    it('should return 0 for seller with shippingFee: 0 (VIP customer with TIERED_DISCOUNT)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
        additionalSellerDiscount: 0.5,

        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Second Seller' },

      // First seller (index 0) pays full fee = 0

    it('should return 0 for seller with shippingFee: 0 in FULL_SUM strategy', async () => {

    it('should apply TIERED_DISCOUNT correctly for VIP customer', async () => {

        additionalSellerDiscount: 0.5,

      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      // First seller: 10 (full)
      // Second: 10 * 0.5 = 5
      // Third: 10 * 0.5 = 5

        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_FIXED,
        additionalSellerFixedFee: 2.5,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false, // Disable cap to test full calculation
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'First Seller' },

      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[1].appliedFee).toBe(2.5);

    it('should apply HIGHEST_ONLY correctly', async () => {

      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(15);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(15);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[1].appliedFee).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[2].appliedFee).toBe(0);
    });
    it('should apply AVERAGE correctly', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.AVERAGE,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,

      const sellerFees = [

      // Average = (10 + 20) / 2 = 15

      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[1].appliedFee).toBe(0);
    });

  describe('Rounding and Number Coercion', () => {
    it('should round all returned values to 2 decimal places', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
        additionalSellerDiscount: 0.33, // Creates non-round numbers
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10.123, sellerName: 'Seller 1' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 5.456, sellerName: 'Seller 2' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      // Check totalShippingCost is rounded
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(Math.round(result.totalShippingCost * 100) / 100);
      // Check each breakdown item is rounded
      result.shippingBreakdown.forEach((item) => {
        expect(item.originalFee).toBe(Math.round(item.originalFee * 100) / 100);
        expect(item.appliedFee).toBe(Math.round(item.appliedFee * 100) / 100);
      });
    });
    it('should coerce null/undefined shippingFee to 0', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: null as never, sellerName: 'Seller 1' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: undefined as never, sellerName: 'Seller 2' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(0);
      result.shippingBreakdown.forEach((item) => {
        expect(item.originalFee).toBe(0);
        expect(item.appliedFee).toBe(0);
      });
    });
  });
  describe('Max Shipping Cap', () => {
    it('should apply max shipping cap and round results', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: true,
        maxShippingCap: 10,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 20, sellerName: 'Seller 1' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 15, sellerName: 'Seller 2' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10); // Capped at 10
      // Each fee should be proportionally reduced and rounded
      result.shippingBreakdown.forEach((item) => {
        expect(item.appliedFee).toBe(Math.round(item.appliedFee * 100) / 100);
      });
    });
  });
  describe('PAY_ON_DELIVERY vs PAY_ONLINE behavior', () => {
    it('should treat explicit PAY_ON_DELIVERY seller as COD (appliedFee 0, excluded from first-seller slot)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.TIERED_DISCOUNT,
        additionalSellerDiscount: 0.5,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'COD Seller', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Online Seller 1', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE },
        { sellerId: '3', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Online Seller 2', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      // COD seller should have appliedFee 0 and originalFee 0
      const codSeller = result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '1');
      expect(codSeller?.appliedFee).toBe(0);
      expect(codSeller?.originalFee).toBe(0);
      // First ONLINE seller (sellerId: '2') should get first-seller slot (full fee = 10)
      const firstOnline = result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '2');
      expect(firstOnline?.appliedFee).toBe(10);
      // Second ONLINE seller (sellerId: '3') should get discount (10 * 0.5 = 5)
      const secondOnline = result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '3');
      expect(secondOnline?.appliedFee).toBe(5);
      // Total should only include online sellers: 10 + 5 = 15
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(15);
    });
    it('should treat PAY_ONLINE seller as online (legacy behavior)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Online Seller', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].originalFee).toBe(10);
    });
    it('should treat missing shippingPaymentMode as online (legacy behavior)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Legacy Seller' }, // No shippingPaymentMode
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].originalFee).toBe(10);
    });
    it('should treat undefined shippingPaymentMode as online (legacy behavior)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Undefined Seller', shippingPaymentMode: undefined },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].originalFee).toBe(10);
    });
    it('should treat null shippingPaymentMode as online (legacy behavior)', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Null Seller', shippingPaymentMode: null as never },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown[0].originalFee).toBe(10);
    });
    it('should be case-insensitive for PAY_ON_DELIVERY', async () => {
      mockSettingsRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValueOnce({
        ...mockSettings,
        freeShippingEnabled: false,
        shippingStrategy: ShippingStrategy.FULL_SUM,
        maxShippingCapEnabled: false,
      });
      const sellerFees = [
        { sellerId: '1', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Lowercase COD', shippingPaymentMode: 'pay_on_delivery' },
        { sellerId: '2', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Mixed Case COD', shippingPaymentMode: 'Pay_On_Delivery' },
        { sellerId: '3', shippingFee: 10, sellerName: 'Online Seller', shippingPaymentMode: 'pay_online' },
      ];
      const result = await service.calculateShippingCost(50, sellerFees);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '1')?.appliedFee).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '2')?.appliedFee).toBe(0);
      expect(result.shippingBreakdown.find((s) => s.sellerId === '3')?.appliedFee).toBe(10);
      expect(result.totalShippingCost).toBe(10);
    });
  });
  describe('applyShippingMethodMultiplier', () => {
    it('should return 0 for pickup', () => {
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'pickup')).toBe(0);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'PICKUP')).toBe(0);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'Pickup')).toBe(0);
    });
    it('should return 45% of base fee rounded to 2 decimals for express', () => {
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'express')).toBe(4.5);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'EXPRESS')).toBe(4.5);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'Express')).toBe(4.5);
      // Test rounding: 10 * 0.45 = 4.5 (already 2 decimals)
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(11.11, 'express')).toBe(5.0); // 11.11 * 0.45 = 4.9995 -> 5.00
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(7.77, 'express')).toBe(3.5); // 7.77 * 0.45 = 3.4965 -> 3.50
    });
    it('should return full base fee rounded to 2 decimals for vip (default)', () => {
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'vip')).toBe(10);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'VIP')).toBe(10);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, 'Vip')).toBe(10);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10)).toBe(10); // undefined defaults to vip
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10, null)).toBe(10); // null defaults to vip
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(10.123, 'vip')).toBe(10.12); // rounded
    });
    it('should handle zero and negative base fees', () => {
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(0, 'express')).toBe(0);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(-5, 'express')).toBe(0); // safeBase treats negative as 0
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(0, 'vip')).toBe(0);
      expect(applyShippingMethodMultiplier(0, 'pickup')).toBe(0);
    });
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  CART_LIMITS,
  cartQuantitySchema,
  addToCartSchema,
  updateCartItemSchema,
} from './cart';
describe('cart validation schemas', () => {
  describe('cartQuantitySchema', () => {
    it('accepts 1', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(1);
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toBe(1);
      }
    });
    it('accepts 99', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(99);
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toBe(99);
      }
    });
    it('rejects 0', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(0);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects -1', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(-1);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects 1.5 (non-integer)', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(1.5);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects 100', () => {
      const result = cartQuantitySchema.safeParse(100);
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
  });
  describe('addToCartSchema', () => {
    const validInput = { sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 };
    it('accepts valid input (happy path)', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse(validInput);
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.sellerProductId).toBe('sp-1');
        expect(result.data.quantity).toBe(1);
      }
    });
    it('accepts max quantity 99', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 99 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.quantity).toBe(99);
      }
    });
    it('rejects quantity 0', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 0 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects quantity -1', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: -1 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects quantity 1.5 (non-integer)', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1.5 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects quantity 100', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 100 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects empty sellerProductId', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: '', quantity: 1 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects whitespace-only sellerProductId', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: '  ', quantity: 1 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('trims sellerProductId', () => {
      const result = addToCartSchema.safeParse({ sellerProductId: '  sp-1  ', quantity: 1 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.sellerProductId).toBe('sp-1');
      }
    });
  });
  describe('updateCartItemSchema', () => {
    it('accepts empty object', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({});
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toEqual({});
      }
    });
    it('accepts all-null', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ quantity: null, color: null, size: null });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data).toEqual({ quantity: null, color: null, size: null });
      }
    });
    it('trims color', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ color: '  red  ' });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.color).toBe('red');
      }
    });
    it('trims size', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ size: '  M  ' });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.size).toBe('M');
      }
    });
    it('rejects quantity 0', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ quantity: 0 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects empty color after trim', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ color: '   ' });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('rejects 51-char color', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ color: 'a'.repeat(51) });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('accepts 50-char color', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ color: 'a'.repeat(50) });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.color).toBe('a'.repeat(50));
      }
    });
    it('rejects 21-char size', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ size: 'a'.repeat(21) });
      expect(result.success).toBe(false);
    });
    it('accepts 20-char size', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ size: 'a'.repeat(20) });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.size).toBe('a'.repeat(20));
      }
    });
    it('accepts valid color and size', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ color: 'blue', size: 'L' });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.color).toBe('blue');
        expect(result.data.size).toBe('L');
      }
    });
    it('accepts valid quantity', () => {
      const result = updateCartItemSchema.safeParse({ quantity: 5 });
      expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      if (result.success) {
        expect(result.data.quantity).toBe(5);
      }
    });
  });
  describe('CART_LIMITS constant', () => {
    it('has correct values', () => {
      expect(CART_LIMITS.quantity.min).toBe(1);
      expect(CART_LIMITS.quantity.max).toBe(99);
      expect(CART_LIMITS.color.max).toBe(50);
      expect(CART_LIMITS.size.max).toBe(20);
    });
  });
});

import { z } from 'zod';
import { idSchema, trimmedString } from './primitives';
export const CART_LIMITS = {
  quantity: { min: 1, max: 99 },
  color: { max: 50 },
  size: { max: 20 },
} as const;
export const cartQuantitySchema = z
  .number()
  .int()
  .min(CART_LIMITS.quantity.min)
  .max(CART_LIMITS.quantity.max);
export const addToCartSchema = z.object({
  sellerProductId: idSchema,
  quantity: cartQuantitySchema,
});
export const updateCartItemSchema = z.object({
  quantity: cartQuantitySchema.nullish(),
  color: trimmedString(1, CART_LIMITS.color.max).nullish(),
  size: trimmedString(1, CART_LIMITS.size.max).nullish(),
});
export type AddToCartInput = z.input<typeof addToCartSchema>;
export type AddToCartData = z.output<typeof addToCartSchema>;
export type UpdateCartItemInput = z.input<typeof updateCartItemSchema>;
export type UpdateCartItemData = z.output<typeof updateCartItemSchema>;
export type CartQuantityData = z.output<typeof cartQuantitySchema>;

import {
  createProductInfoSchema,
  createProductSchema,
  productEditorFormSchema,
  productVariantSchema,
  updateProductSchema,
} from './catalog';
const variant = { size: '42', sizeKind: 'FOOTWEAR', colorIds: [1], weight: 0.8 };
const product = { name: 'Air Max', sku: 'AM-1', categoryIds: [2], brandId: null, variants: [variant] };
describe('catalog schemas', () => {
  it('accepts valid products and variants with optional fields as null', () => {
    expect(createProductSchema.safeParse(product).success).toBe(true);
    expect(updateProductSchema.safeParse({ ...product, id: 9, descriptions: [{ languageCode: 'fa', description: 'x' }] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(productVariantSchema.safeParse({ ...variant, price: null, discount: 0, stockQuantity: 0 }).success).toBe(true);
  });
  it('rejects missing names/skus and invalid variants with the existing messages', () => {
    expect(createProductSchema.safeParse({ ...product, sku: '' }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(updateProductSchema.safeParse(product).success).toBe(false);
    const bad = productVariantSchema.safeParse({ ...variant, size: '', weight: 0, discount: 120, stockQuantity: -1 });
    expect(bad.success ? [] : bad.error.issues.map((i) => i.message)).toEqual([
      'Variant size is required',
      'Weight must be greater than 0',
      'Discount cannot exceed 100',
      'Stock quantity cannot be negative',
    ]);
  });
  it('validates product infos', () => {
    expect(createProductInfoSchema.safeParse({ productId: 1, size: 'M', sizeKind: 'APPAREL', colorIds: [], weight: 1 }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(createProductInfoSchema.safeParse({ productId: 1, size: 'M' }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});
describe('productEditorFormSchema', () => {
  const form = {
    name: 'Air Max',
    sku: 'AM-1',
    categoryIds: [2],
    variants: [{ size: '42', colorIds: [1], weight: 0.8 }],
  };
  const paths = (v: unknown) => {
    const r = productEditorFormSchema.safeParse(v);
    return r.success ? [] : r.error.issues.map((i) => i.path.join('.'));
  };
  it('accepts a complete product', () => {
    expect(paths(form)).toEqual([]);
  });
  it('requires name, a non-blank sku and a category', () => {
    expect(paths({ ...form, name: '', sku: '  ', categoryIds: [] })).toEqual(['name', 'sku', 'categoryIds']);
  });
  it('requires each variant to have a size, a color and a positive weight', () => {
    expect(paths({ ...form, variants: [{ size: '', colorIds: [], weight: 0 }] })).toEqual([
      'variants.0.size',
      'variants.0.colorIds',
      'variants.0.weight',
    ]);
  });
});

import {
  bulkTranslationSchema,
  createCurrencySchema,
  currencyCodeSchema,
  exchangeRateFormSchema,
  setExchangeRateSchema,
  translationNameFormSchema,
  translationSchema,
  updateCurrencySchema,
} from './currency';
const ok = (s: { safeParse: (v: unknown) => { success: boolean } }, v: unknown) => s.safeParse(v).success;
describe('currency and translation schemas', () => {
  it('accepts the seeded currencies and rejects malformed codes', () => {
    expect(ok(createCurrencySchema, { code: 'IRR', name: 'Iranian Rial', symbol: '﷼', decimalPlaces: 0 })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(currencyCodeSchema, 'usd')).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(currencyCodeSchema, 'U$D')).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(createCurrencySchema, { code: 'USD', name: '', symbol: '$', decimalPlaces: 2 })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(updateCurrencySchema, { decimalPlaces: 9 })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(updateCurrencySchema, { isActive: false })).toBe(true);
  });
  it('requires a positive exchange rate', () => {
    expect(ok(setExchangeRateSchema, { fromCurrencyCode: 'USD', toCurrencyCode: 'IRR', rate: 600000 })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(setExchangeRateSchema, { fromCurrencyCode: 'USD', toCurrencyCode: 'IRR', rate: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(exchangeRateFormSchema, { rate: '58000.5' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(exchangeRateFormSchema, { rate: 'abc' })).toBe(false);
  });
  it('validates translations and allows clearing a value', () => {
    const t = { entityType: 'product', entityId: 3, locale: 'fa', fieldName: 'name', value: '' };
    expect(ok(translationSchema, t)).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(translationSchema, { ...t, locale: 'x' })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(translationSchema, { ...t, entityId: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(bulkTranslationSchema, { entityType: 'brand', entityIds: [1, 2], sourceLocale: 'en', targetLocales: ['fa'] })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(bulkTranslationSchema, { entityType: 'brand', entityIds: [1], sourceLocale: 'en', targetLocales: [''] })).toBe(false);
  });
  it('limits translated names in the admin editor but allows clearing', () => {
    expect(ok(translationNameFormSchema, { value: '' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(translationNameFormSchema, { value: 'کفش ورزشی' })).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(translationNameFormSchema, { value: 'x'.repeat(101) })).toBe(false);
  });
});

<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/product.resolver.ts">
import {
  createProductInfoSchema,
  createProductSchema,
  productFilterSchema,
  updateProductSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
import {
  Category,
  Product,
  ProductConnection,
  SellerInfo,
  SellerProduct,
  User,
  UserRole,
  ProductDescription,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import { RolesGuard, CatalogGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { SizeKind } from '@kickzone-workspace/product-sizes';
import {
  CreateProductInfoInput,
  CreateProductInput,
  ProductArchivedStatus,
  ProductFilterInput,
  UpdateProductInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import { ProductService, SellerService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { createConnection } from '@kickzone-workspace/utils';
import { SetMetadata, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  Args,
  Context,
  Int,
  Mutation,
  Parent,
  Query,
  ResolveField,
  Resolver,
} from '@nestjs/graphql';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import GraphQLUpload from 'graphql-upload/GraphQLUpload.js';
import * as path from 'path';
export interface FileUpload {
  filename: string;
  mimetype: string;
  encoding: string;
  createReadStream: () => NodeJS.ReadableStream;
}
@Resolver(() => Product)
export class ProductResolver {
  constructor(
    private readonly productService: ProductService,
    private readonly sellerService: SellerService
  ) {}
  @Query(() => ProductConnection)
  async products(
    @Args('filter', { nullable: true }, new ZodValidationPipe(productFilterSchema))
    filter?: ProductFilterInput
  ): Promise<ProductConnection> {
    if (!filter) filter = { archivedStatus: ProductArchivedStatus.ACTIVE };
    if (!filter.archivedStatus)
      filter.archivedStatus = ProductArchivedStatus.ACTIVE;
    const [products, totalCount] = await this.productService.getProducts(
      filter
    );
    return createConnection(
      products,
      totalCount,
      filter?.first || 10,
      filter?.after
    );
  }
  @Query(() => [String])
  async distinctProductSizes(
    @Args('sizeKind', { type: () => SizeKind, nullable: true })
    sizeKind?: SizeKind
  ): Promise<string[]> {
    return this.productService.getDistinctProductSizes(sizeKind);
  }
  @Query(() => ProductConnection)
  async sellerProductsForMe(
    @Context() context: { req: { user: User } },
    @Args('filter', { nullable: true }, new ZodValidationPipe(productFilterSchema))
    filter?: ProductFilterInput
  ): Promise<ProductConnection> {
    const user = context.req.user;
    if (!user) throw new Error('Not authenticated');
    if (user.role !== UserRole.SELLER) throw new Error('Not a seller');
    const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(user.id);
    if (!seller) throw new Error('Seller info not found');
    const [products, totalCount] = await this.productService.getSellerProducts(
      seller.id,
      filter
    );
    return createConnection(
      products,
      totalCount,
      filter?.first || 10,
      filter?.after
    );
  }
  @Mutation(() => Product)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async createProduct(
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(createProductSchema))
    input: CreateProductInput,
    @Context() context?: { req: { user?: User } }
  ): Promise<Product> {
    const product = await this.productService.createProduct(
      input,
      context?.req?.user
    );
    if (!product.productInfos) {
      product.productInfos = [];
    }
    return product;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Product)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async createProductInfo(
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(createProductInfoSchema))
    input: CreateProductInfoInput
  ): Promise<Product> {
    return this.productService.createProductInfo(input);
  }
  @Query(() => [Category])
  async categories(): Promise<Category[]> {
    return this.productService.getCategories();
  }
  @Mutation(() => [String])
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async uploadProductInfoImages(
    @Args('productInfoId') productInfoId: number,
    @Args({ name: 'files', type: () => [GraphQLUpload] })
    files: Promise<FileUpload>[]
  ): Promise<string[]> {
    console.log('uploadProductInfoImages called');
    console.log('productInfoId:', productInfoId);
    console.log('files:', files);
    const uploadDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads', 'products');
    if (!fs.existsSync(uploadDir)) {
      console.log('Creating upload directory:', uploadDir);
      fs.mkdirSync(uploadDir, { recursive: true });
    }
    let uploadedFiles;
    try {
      uploadedFiles = await Promise.all(files);
      console.log(
        'uploadedFiles:',
        uploadedFiles.map((f) => ({
          filename: f.filename,
          mimetype: f.mimetype,
          encoding: f.encoding,
        }))
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error resolving uploaded files:', err);
      throw err;
    }
    const imageUrls: string[] = [];
    for (const file of uploadedFiles) {
      const { createReadStream, filename } = file;
      const baseName = path.basename(String(filename).replace(/\\/g, '/'));
      const sanitizedName = baseName.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_');
      const safeName = sanitizedName && !/^\.+$/.test(sanitizedName) ? sanitizedName : 'file';
      const uniqueName = `${Date.now()}-${safeName}`;
      const resolvedUploadDir = path.resolve(uploadDir);
      const filePath = path.resolve(uploadDir, uniqueName);
      if (!filePath.startsWith(resolvedUploadDir + path.sep)) {
        console.error('Path traversal attempt detected:', filename);
        throw new Error('Invalid filename');
      }
      try {
        await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
          const stream = createReadStream();
          stream
            .pipe(fs.createWriteStream(filePath))
            .on('finish', () => resolve())
            .on('error', reject);
        });
        imageUrls.push(`/uploads/products/${uniqueName}`);
        console.log('Saved file:', filePath);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Error saving file:', filename, err);
        throw err;
      }
    }
    try {
      await this.productService.addImagesToProductInfo(
        productInfoId,
        imageUrls
      );
      console.log('Added image URLs to product info:', imageUrls);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error adding images to product info:', err);
      throw err;
    }
    return imageUrls;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async removeProductInfoImage(
    @Args('productInfoId') productInfoId: number,
    @Args('imageName') imageName: string
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    const uploadDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads', 'products');
    const safeName = path.basename(String(imageName).replace(/\\/g, '/'));
    if (!safeName || safeName === '.' || safeName === '..' || safeName !== imageName) {
      return false;
    }
    const resolvedUploadDir = path.resolve(uploadDir);
    const filePath = path.resolve(uploadDir, safeName);
    if (!filePath.startsWith(resolvedUploadDir + path.sep)) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      // Remove the file from the filesystem
      if (fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
        fs.unlinkSync(filePath);
      }
      // Remove the image URL from the product info
      await this.productService.removeImageFromProductInfo(
        productInfoId,
        `/uploads/products/${safeName}`
      );
      return true;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error removing product info image:', error);
      return false;
    }
  }
  @Query(() => Product, { nullable: true })
  async product(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<Product | null> {
    return this.productService.getProductById(id);
  }
  @Query(() => [SellerProduct])
  @UseGuards(RolesGuard)
  @SetMetadata('roles', [UserRole.ADMIN])
  async sellerProductsByProduct(
    @Args('productId', { type: () => Int }) productId: number
  ): Promise<SellerProduct[]> {
    return this.productService.getSellerProductsByProduct(productId);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Product)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async archiveProduct(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<Product> {
    return this.productService.archiveProduct(id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Product)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async unarchiveProduct(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<Product> {
    return this.productService.unarchiveProduct(id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async deleteProduct(
    @Args('id', { type: () => Int }) id: number
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.productService.deleteProduct(id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Product)
  @UseGuards(CatalogGuard)
  async updateProduct(
    @Args('input', new ZodValidationPipe(updateProductSchema))
    input: UpdateProductInput,
    @Context() context?: { req: { user?: User } }
  ): Promise<Product> {
    return this.productService.updateProduct(input, context?.req?.user);
  }
  @ResolveField(() => String, { nullable: true })
  async description(
    @Parent() product: Product,
    @Context() context?: { req: { locale?: string } }
  ): Promise<string | null> {
    return this.productService.resolveProductDescription(
      product,
      context?.req?.locale || 'en'
    );
  }
  @ResolveField(() => [ProductDescription], { nullable: true })
  async descriptions(
    @Parent() product: Product
  ): Promise<ProductDescription[]> {
    if (product.descriptions) {
      return product.descriptions;
    }
    return this.productService.getProductDescriptions(product.id);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  async subscribeNewsletter(@Args('email') email: string): Promise<boolean> {
    return this.productService.subscribeNewsletter(email);
  }
}
@Resolver(() => SellerProduct)
export class SellerProductResolver {
  @ResolveField(() => Number, { nullable: true })
  async costPrice(
    @Parent() sellerProduct: SellerProduct,
    @Context() context: { req: { user?: User } }
  ): Promise<number | null> {
    const user = context.req.user;
    // Only expose costPrice to sellers and admins, not customers
    if (
      !user ||
      (user.role !== UserRole.SELLER && user.role !== UserRole.ADMIN)
    ) {
      return null;
    }
    return sellerProduct.costPrice;
  }
  @ResolveField(() => SellerInfo, { nullable: true })
  seller(@Parent() sellerProduct: SellerProduct) {
    return sellerProduct.seller;
  }
}
