<file path="libs/server/resolvers/src/lib/payment.resolver.ts">
import { Resolver, Mutation, Args } from '@nestjs/graphql';
import { UseGuards, BadRequestException, ForbiddenException, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { OrderStatus, type OrderItem } from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
/** OrderItem with the sellerProduct relation loaded (not declared on the entity class). */
type OrderItemWithSellerProduct = OrderItem & {
  sellerProduct?: { id?: string; stockQuantity?: number } | null;
};
import { PaymentService, OrderService, CurrencyService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { GraphqlAuthGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import { CurrentUser, type OptionalAuthenticatedUser } from '@kickzone-workspace/decorators';
import { ObjectType, Field, Int, InputType } from '@nestjs/graphql';
@ObjectType()
export class ZarinPalPaymentResponse {
  @Field(() => Int)
  code: number;
  @Field()
  message: string;
  @Field()
  authority: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  fee_type?: string;
  @Field(() => Int, { nullable: true })
  fee?: number;
}
@ObjectType()
export class ZarinPalVerificationResponse {
  @Field(() => Int)
  code: number;
  @Field()
  message: string;
  @Field(() => Int, { nullable: true })
  ref_id?: number;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  card_pan?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  card_hash?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  fee_type?: string;
  @Field(() => Int, { nullable: true })
  fee?: number;
  @Field(() => [String], { nullable: true })
  orderIds?: string[];
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  orderId?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  orderNumber?: string;
  @Field(() => Boolean, { nullable: true })
  success?: boolean;
}
@InputType()
export class ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput {
  @Field(() => Int)
  amount: number;
  @Field()
  callback_url: string;
  @Field()
  description: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  currency?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  mobile?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  email?: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  order_id?: string;
  @Field(() => [String], { nullable: true })
  orderIds?: string[];
}
@InputType()
export class ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput {
  @Field(() => Int)
  amount: number;
  @Field()
  authority: string;
  @Field({ nullable: true })
  order_id?: string; // Optional: if provided, order status will be updated
}
@ObjectType()
export class GatewayUrlResponse {
  @Field()
  url: string;
}
@Resolver()
export class PaymentResolver {
  constructor(
    private readonly paymentService: PaymentService,
    private readonly orderService: OrderService,
    private readonly currencyService: CurrencyService
  ) {}
  private readonly inFlightVerifications = new Map<
    string,
    Promise<ZarinPalVerificationResponse>
  >();
  private extractGuestToken(notes?: string | null): string | null {
    const match = /\[GuestToken:\s*([^\]]+)\]/.exec(notes ?? '');
    return match ? match[1].trim() : null;
  }
  @Mutation(() => ZarinPalPaymentResponse)
  async requestZarinPalPayment(
    @Args('input') input: ZarinPalPaymentRequestInput
  ) {
    // Normalize the list of order IDs from both orderId (singular) and orderIds (array)
    const targetOrderIds = Array.from(
      new Set([
        ...(input.orderIds ?? []),
        ...(input.order_id ? [input.order_id] : []),
      ].filter((id): id is string => typeof id === 'string' && id.trim().length > 0))
    );
    if (targetOrderIds.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('At least one orderId is required');
    }
    // Validate callback_url early - before any database lookups
    let parsedCallbackUrl: URL;
    try {
      parsedCallbackUrl = new URL(input.callback_url);
    } catch {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid callback_url');
    }
    if (
      parsedCallbackUrl.protocol !== 'http:' &&
      parsedCallbackUrl.protocol !== 'https:'
    ) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid callback_url protocol');
    }
    const isSingleOrder = targetOrderIds.length === 1 && !input.orderIds;
    // Load all orders in targetOrderIds
    const orders = await Promise.all(
      targetOrderIds.map((id) => this.orderService.findOne(id))
    );
    // Verify all orders exist
    const missingOrders = targetOrderIds.filter(
      (_, index) => !orders[index]
    );
    if (missingOrders.length > 0) {
      if (isSingleOrder) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Order not found');
      }
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Order(s) not found: ${missingOrders.join(', ')}`
      );
    }
    // Verify all orders are PENDING
    const nonPendingOrders = orders.filter(
      (order) => order.status !== OrderStatus.PENDING
    );
    if (nonPendingOrders.length > 0) {
      if (isSingleOrder) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Order ${targetOrderIds[0]} is not in PENDING status and cannot be paid`
        );
      }
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Order(s) ${nonPendingOrders
          .map((o) => o.id)
          .join(', ')} are not in PENDING status and cannot be paid`
      );
    }
    // Verify all orders belong to the same checkout customer/guest (by email)
    // Only for multi-order batches
    if (!isSingleOrder) {
      const firstOrder = orders[0];
      const firstCustomerEmail = String(firstOrder.customerEmail ?? '')
        .toLowerCase();
      const firstGuestToken = this.extractGuestToken(firstOrder.notes);
      for (const order of orders) {
        const customerEmail = String(order.customerEmail ?? '').toLowerCase();
        if (customerEmail !== firstCustomerEmail) {
          throw new BadRequestException(
            'All orders in a batch must belong to the same customer'
          );
        }
        const orderGuestToken = this.extractGuestToken(order.notes);
        if (firstGuestToken !== orderGuestToken) {
          throw new BadRequestException(
            'All orders in a batch must share the same guest checkout token'
          );
        }
      }
    }
    // Recompute server-authoritative shipping across the entire batch before summing totals
    if (typeof this.orderService.recalculateBatchOrdersShipping === 'function') {
      await this.orderService.recalculateBatchOrdersShipping(orders);
    }
    // Sum the USD totals across all orders in the batch
    const batchTotalUsd = orders.reduce(
      (sum, o) => sum + Number(o.total),
      0
    );
    // For single order, also validate the individual order total
    if (isSingleOrder) {
      const orderTotalUsd = Number(orders[0].total);
      if (!Number.isFinite(orderTotalUsd) || orderTotalUsd <= 0) {
        throw new BadRequestException('Order total is invalid or missing');
      }
    }
    // Fetch current USD -> IRR exchange rate (IRR represents Toman for ZarinPal)
    const rateRecord = await this.currencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate(
      'USD',
      'IRR'
    );
    const fxRate = Number(rateRecord?.rate ?? rateRecord);
    // Fail-closed FX guard: reject if rate is missing, not finite, or <= 1
    if (!Number.isFinite(fxRate) || fxRate <= 1) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Exchange rate is not configured or invalid. Cannot process ZarinPal payment.'
      );
    }
    // Compute server-authoritative amount in Tomans
    const expectedBatchAmount = Math.round(batchTotalUsd * fxRate);
    // Client tampering check: if client sends amount, it must match expectedAmount within rounding tolerance
    if (input.amount != null) {
      const clientAmount = Number(input.amount);
      const tolerance = isSingleOrder
        ? Math.max(1, Math.round(expectedBatchAmount * 0.001)) // 0.1% or at least 1 Toman for single order
        : Math.max(
            10,
            targetOrderIds.length * 2
          ); // At least 10 Tomans or 2 per order for batch
      if (Math.abs(clientAmount - expectedBatchAmount) > tolerance) {
        if (isSingleOrder) {
          throw new BadRequestException('Payment amount does not match order total');
        }
        throw new BadRequestException(
          'Payment amount does not match batch order total'
        );
      }
    }
    // Always use server-computed expectedAmount for ZarinPal request
    const response = await this.paymentService.requestPayment({
      amount: expectedBatchAmount,
      callback_url: input.callback_url,
      description: input.description,
      currency: (input.currency as 'IRR' | 'IRT') || 'IRT',
      metadata: {
        mobile: input.mobile,
        email: input.email,
        order_id: targetOrderIds[0], // Primary order for metadata
      },
    });
    // Bind authority and server-computed expected amount to EVERY order in the batch
    for (const order of orders) {
      await this.orderService.setPaymentIntent({
        orderId: order.id,
        authority: response.data.authority,
        amount: expectedBatchAmount,
        currency: input.currency || 'IRT',
      });
    }
    return {
      code: response.data.code,
      message: response.data.message,
      authority: response.data.authority,
      fee_type: response.data.fee_type,
      fee: response.data.fee,
    };
  }
  @Mutation(() => ZarinPalVerificationResponse)
  async verifyZarinPalPayment(
    @Args('input') input: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput
  ) {
    const existingInFlight = this.inFlightVerifications.get(input.authority);
    if (existingInFlight) {
      return existingInFlight;
    }
    const verificationPromise = this.executeVerifyZarinPalPayment(input).finally(
      () => {
        this.inFlightVerifications.delete(input.authority);
      }
    );
    this.inFlightVerifications.set(input.authority, verificationPromise);
    return verificationPromise;
  }
  private async executeVerifyZarinPalPayment(
    input: ZarinPalVerificationRequestInput
  ): Promise<ZarinPalVerificationResponse> {
    const orders = this.orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority
      ? await this.orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority(input.authority)
      : input.order_id
        ? [await this.orderService.findOne(input.order_id)].filter(
            (o): o is NonNullable<typeof o> => Boolean(o)
          )
        : [];
    if (orders.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'No orders found for this payment authority'
      );
    }
    // Verify all orders have the matching authority
    for (const order of orders) {
      if (order.paymentAuthority !== input.authority) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          'Payment authority does not match the order payment intent'
        );
      }
    }
    // Reject before calling the gateway if any order bound to this authority is already CANCELLED or REFUNDED
    const cancelledOrRefunded = orders.filter(
      (o) =>
        o.status === OrderStatus.CANCELLED || o.status === OrderStatus.REFUNDED
    );
    if (cancelledOrRefunded.length > 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Cannot verify payment for cancelled or refunded order(s): ${cancelledOrRefunded
          .map((o) => o.id)
          .join(', ')}`
      );
    }
    // Pre-verify: ensure every PENDING order has sufficient stock on all items
    // This prevents one sibling order from confirming if another is out of stock
    const pendingOrders = orders.filter((o) => o.status === OrderStatus.PENDING);
    const stockRequirements = new Map<string, number>(); // sellerProductId -> requiredQty
    for (const order of pendingOrders) {
      for (const item of order.items ?? []) {
        const sp = (item as OrderItemWithSellerProduct).sellerProduct;
        if (sp?.id != null && typeof sp.stockQuantity === 'number') {
          const current = stockRequirements.get(sp.id) ?? 0;
          stockRequirements.set(sp.id, current + (item.quantity ?? 0));
        }
      }
    }
    for (const [sellerProductId, requiredQty] of stockRequirements.entries()) {
      // Find the sellerProduct to check current stock
      const sampleItem = pendingOrders
        .flatMap((o): OrderItemWithSellerProduct[] => o.items ?? [])
        .find((i) => i.sellerProduct?.id === sellerProductId);
      const available = sampleItem?.sellerProduct?.stockQuantity ?? 0;
      if (available < requiredQty) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Insufficient stock for product ${sellerProductId}: required ${requiredQty}, available ${available}`
        );
      }
    }
    // Use the payment amount from the first order (they all share the same batch amount)
    const firstOrder = orders[0];
    if (
      firstOrder.paymentAmount === null ||
      firstOrder.paymentAmount === undefined
    ) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Payment amount not recorded for this order. Please initiate payment again.'
      );
    }
    const amountToVerify = firstOrder.paymentAmount;
    const response = await this.paymentService.verifyPayment({
      amount: amountToVerify,
      authority: input.authority,
    });
    // If payment verification was successful (code 100 or 101)
    if (response.data.code === 100 || response.data.code === 101) {
      // Handle code 101 idempotently: if every order for this authority is already in a paid status
      // and has stock reserved, return success without re-decrementing stock.
      const paidStatuses = new Set<OrderStatus>([
        OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
        OrderStatus.PROCESSING,
        OrderStatus.SHIPPED,
        OrderStatus.DELIVERED,
      ]);
      const allOrdersConfirmedAndStockReserved = orders.every(
        (o) => paidStatuses.has(o.status) && o.stockReserved === true
      );
      if (response.data.code === 101 && allOrdersConfirmedAndStockReserved) {
        // Idempotent success: already verified, stock already reserved
        return {
          code: response.data.code,
          message: response.data.message,
          ref_id: response.data.ref_id,
          card_pan: response.data.card_pan,
          card_hash: response.data.card_hash,
          fee_type: response.data.fee_type,
          fee: response.data.fee,
          orderIds: orders.map((o) => o.id),
          orderId: orders[0]?.id,
          orderNumber: orders.map((o) => o.orderNumber).join(', '),
          success: true,
        };
      }
      // Confirm ALL PENDING orders in deterministic order (id ASC)
      const pendingOrders = orders
        .filter((o) => o.status === OrderStatus.PENDING)
        .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
      const confirmedOrderIds: string[] = [];
      for (const order of pendingOrders) {
        try {
          // Persist authority/amount before confirming to prevent tampering/replay
          await this.orderService.setPaymentIntent({
            orderId: order.id,
            authority: input.authority,
            amount: amountToVerify,
            currency: order.paymentCurrency || 'IRT',
          });
          await this.orderService.confirmOrderPayment(order.id);
          confirmedOrderIds.push(order.id);
        } catch (confirmError) {
          console.error(
            `Failed to finalize order ${order.id} after successful payment (authority: ${input.authority}, refId: ${response.data.ref_id}):`,
            confirmError
          );
          // Rollback any orders confirmed earlier in this batch
          for (const confirmedId of confirmedOrderIds) {
            try {
              if (this.orderService.updateOrderStatus) {
                await this.orderService.updateOrderStatus(confirmedId, OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
              }
            } catch (rollbackError) {
              console.error(
                `Rollback failed for order ${confirmedId}:`,
                rollbackError
              );
            }
          }
          // CRITICAL FIX: Return success: false when confirmOrderPayment throws.
          // The payment was captured by gateway (refId exists) but order confirmation/stock reservation failed.
          // Frontend must NOT clear cart and must show error with refId for support/refund.
          const errorMessage = confirmError instanceof Error
            ? `Payment was captured by gateway (Ref: ${response.data.ref_id}), but order confirmation failed: ${confirmError.message}`
            : `Payment was captured by gateway (Ref: ${response.data.ref_id}), but stock reservation failed.`;
          return {
            code: response.data.code,
            message: errorMessage,
            ref_id: response.data.ref_id,
            card_pan: response.data.card_pan,
            card_hash: response.data.card_hash,
            fee_type: response.data.fee_type,
            fee: response.data.fee,
            orderIds: orders.map((o) => o.id),
            orderId: orders[0]?.id,
            orderNumber: orders.map((o) => o.orderNumber).join(', '),
            success: false,
          };
        }
      }
    }
    // If payment verification failed (non-100/101), cancel ALL PENDING orders
    if (response.data.code !== 100 && response.data.code !== 101) {
      const pendingOrders = orders.filter(
        (o) => o.status === OrderStatus.PENDING
      );
      for (const order of pendingOrders) {
        try {
          await this.orderService.cancelPendingOrder(order.id);
        } catch (error) {
          // Log error but don't fail - payment verification response is what matters
          console.error(
            `Failed to cancel order ${order.id} after payment failure:`,
            error
          );
        }
      }
    }
    return {
      code: response.data.code,
      message: response.data.message,
      ref_id: response.data.ref_id,
      card_pan: response.data.card_pan,
      card_hash: response.data.card_hash,
      fee_type: response.data.fee_type,
      fee: response.data.fee,
      orderIds: orders.map((o) => o.id),
      orderId: orders[0]?.id,
      orderNumber: orders.map((o) => o.orderNumber).join(', '),
      success: response.data.code === 100 || response.data.code === 101,
    };
  }
  @Mutation(() => GatewayUrlResponse)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async getZarinPalGatewayUrl(
    @CurrentUser() _user: { id: string },
    @Args('authority') authority: string
  ) {
    return {
      url: this.paymentService.getGatewayUrl(authority),
    };
  }
  /**
   * Cancel a pending order when the buyer aborts on ZarinPal (Status=NOK).
   * Per ZarinPal docs, verify must not be called when Status is NOK.
   *
   * Two authorization paths:
   * 1. With non-empty `authority`: any caller (guest or authenticated) may cancel
   *    all PENDING orders bound to that authority. This preserves the existing
   *    guest-compatible behavior where the authority token proves possession.
   * 2. Without `authority` (empty/undefined): caller MUST provide `orderId` and be
   *    authorized as the order owner. Authorization succeeds if:
   *    - `user?.email` is non-empty and equals `order.customerEmail` (authenticated customer), OR
   *    - `guestToken` (trimmed, length >= 16) is found in `order.notes` as the literal
   *      substring `[GuestToken: <token>]` (guest who placed the order).
   *
   * @param orderId - Order ID (required when authority is not provided)
   * @param authority - ZarinPal authority token; if non-empty, authorizes via authority match
   * @param user - Current authenticated user (optional, from @CurrentUser decorator)
   * @param guestToken - Guest token for unauthenticated callers (optional)
   * @returns true if cancellation succeeded (idempotent for already-cancelled orders)
   * @throws BadRequestException if orderId missing without authority, or order not PENDING/already paid
   * @throws ForbiddenException if caller is not the order owner (without authority)
   */
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  async cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(
    @Args('orderId', { type: () => String, nullable: true }) orderId?: string,
    @Args('authority', { type: () => String, nullable: true }) authority?: string,
    @CurrentUser() user?: OptionalAuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('guestToken', { type: () => String, nullable: true }) guestToken?: string
  ) {
    // Path 1: Non-empty authority provided -> keep EXACT existing logic
    if (authority && authority.trim() !== '') {
      // Look up orders matching the authority
      const ordersByAuthority = await this.orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority(authority);
      // If orderId was also passed, verify it matches the authority
      let matchedOrders = ordersByAuthority;
      if (orderId) {
        const orderById = await this.orderService.findOne(orderId);
        if (orderById.paymentAuthority !== authority) {
          throw new BadRequestException('Order does not match the provided payment authority');
        }
        // Ensure the orderById is in the matched list (in case findOrdersByPaymentAuthority missed it)
        if (!matchedOrders.some((o) => o.id === orderId)) {
          matchedOrders = [orderById, ...matchedOrders];
        }
      }
      if (matchedOrders.length === 0) {
        throw new BadRequestException('No matching order found for payment authority');
      }
      // Cancel each matched order that is PENDING
      for (const order of matchedOrders) {
        if (order.status === OrderStatus.CANCELLED) {
          // Idempotent: already cancelled, treat as success
          continue;
        }
        if (order.status !== OrderStatus.PENDING) {
          throw new BadRequestException(
            `Cannot cancel order ${order.id} with status ${order.status}. Only PENDING orders can be cancelled.`
          );
        }
        await this.orderService.cancelPendingOrder(order.id);
      }
      return true;
    }
    // Path 2: No authority (or empty) -> require orderId and ownership authorization
    if (!orderId || orderId.trim() === '') {
      throw new BadRequestException('Order ID is required when payment authority is not provided');
    }
    let order;
    try {
      order = await this.orderService.findOne(orderId);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof NotFoundException) {
        throw new ForbiddenException('Not allowed to cancel this order');
      }
      throw error;
    }
    // Authorization check
    const userEmail = user?.email?.trim();
    const providedGuestToken = guestToken?.trim();
    // Validate guestToken format: no ']' or newlines to prevent injection
    if (providedGuestToken && /[\]\r\n]/.test(providedGuestToken)) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid guest token format');
    }
    const isOwnerByEmail = Boolean(userEmail && userEmail.length > 0 && order.customerEmail?.toLowerCase() === userEmail.toLowerCase());
    const isOwnerByGuestToken = Boolean(
      providedGuestToken &&
      providedGuestToken.length >= 16 &&
      (order.notes ?? '').includes(`[GuestToken: ${providedGuestToken}]`)
    );
    if (!isOwnerByEmail && !isOwnerByGuestToken) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Not allowed to cancel this order');
    }
    // Status checks
    if (order.status === OrderStatus.CANCELLED) {
      // Idempotent: already cancelled, treat as success
      return true;
    }
    if (order.status !== OrderStatus.PENDING || order.paymentVerifiedAt) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        `Cannot cancel order ${order.id} with status ${order.status}. Only unpaid PENDING orders can be cancelled.`
      );
    }
    await this.orderService.cancelPendingOrder(order.id);
    return true;
  }
}

        ...orderWithoutItems,
        shippingCost: 0,
        total: 100,
        shippingMethod: 'vip',
        shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
      });
      orderItemRepository.save.mockResolvedValue([mockOrderItem] as never);
      const result = await service.createOrder(inputWithoutShipping);
      expect(result.shippingCost).toBe(0);
      expect(result.total).toBe(100);
    });
    it('should preserve seller snapshot information', async () => {

      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockSellerProduct);

    it('should NOT decrease stock when creating order', async () => {

    it('should preserve product pricing snapshot in order items', async () => {

    it('should insert each order item only once (no cascade + manual save duplication)', async () => {
      const inputWithTwoItems: CreateOrderInput = {
        ...createOrderInput,
        items: [
          {
            productId: 'product-1',
            sellerProductId: 'seller-product-1',
            productName: 'Test Product 1',
            quantity: 1,
            unitPrice: 50,
            totalPrice: 50,
          },
          {
            productId: 'product-2',
            sellerProductId: 'seller-product-2',
            productName: 'Test Product 2',
            quantity: 2,
            unitPrice: 30,
            totalPrice: 60,
          },
        ],
      };
      const sellerProduct2 = { ...mockSellerProduct, id: 'seller-product-2', seller: { id: 1 } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'] } as SellerProduct;
      const orderWithoutItems = {
        ...mockSavedOrder,
        items: undefined,
        subtotal: 110,
        total: 120,
      } as unknown as Order;
      orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue(orderWithoutItems);
      sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockSeller);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(mockSellerProduct)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(sellerProduct2);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({ ...orderWithoutItems } as unknown as typeof orderWithoutItems);
      orderItemRepository.save.mockImplementation(((items: object[]) =>
        Promise.resolve(items.map((i: object, idx: number) => ({ ...i, id: `item-${idx + 1}` })))) as never);
      const result = await service.createOrder(inputWithTwoItems);
      const savedOrderArg = orderRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0] as Order;
      expect(savedOrderArg.items).toBeUndefined();
      expect(orderItemRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
      expect(result.items).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(result.items[0].quantity).toBe(1);
      expect(result.items[1].quantity).toBe(2);
    });
    it('should override client prices with catalog prices (price tampering protection)', async () => {
      // Client sends unitPrice: 10, totalPrice: 20 but catalog price is 50
      const inputWithTamperedPrices = {
        ...createOrderInput,
        items: [
          {
            ...createOrderInput.items[0],
            unitPrice: 10,
            totalPrice: 20,
          },
        ],
      };
      const sellerProductWithHigherPrice = {
        ...mockSellerProduct,
        price: 50,
        discount: 0,
      } as SellerProduct;
      const orderWithoutItems = { ...mockSavedOrder, items: undefined } as unknown as typeof mockSavedOrder;
      orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue(orderWithoutItems);
      sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockSeller);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProductWithHigherPrice);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...orderWithoutItems,
        subtotal: 100, // 50 * 2 = 100 (catalog price)
        total: 110,
      });
      orderItemRepository.save.mockImplementation(((items: unknown[]) =>
        Promise.resolve(items)) as never);
      const result = await service.createOrder(inputWithTamperedPrices);
      expect(result.subtotal).toBe(100); // Catalog price, not client's 20
      expect(result.total).toBe(110);
      const savedItems = orderItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0] as OrderItem[];
      expect(savedItems[0].unitPrice).toBe(50); // Catalog unit price
      expect(savedItems[0].totalPrice).toBe(100); // Catalog total price
    });
    it('should apply discount when computing catalog price', async () => {
      const sellerProductWithDiscount = {
        ...mockSellerProduct,
        price: 100,
        discount: 20, // 20% off
        seller: { id: 1 } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'],
      } as SellerProduct;
      const orderWithoutItems = { ...mockSavedOrder, items: undefined } as unknown as typeof mockSavedOrder;
      orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue(orderWithoutItems);
      sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockSeller);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProductWithDiscount);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...orderWithoutItems,
        subtotal: 160, // 80 * 2 = 160 (after 20% discount)
        total: 170,
      });
      orderItemRepository.save.mockImplementation(((items: unknown[]) =>
        Promise.resolve(items)) as never);
      const result = await service.createOrder(createOrderInput);
      expect(result.subtotal).toBe(160);
      expect(result.total).toBe(170);
      const savedItems = orderItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0] as OrderItem[];
      expect(savedItems[0].unitPrice).toBe(80); // 100 * 0.8 = 80
      expect(savedItems[0].totalPrice).toBe(160); // 80 * 2 = 160
      expect(savedItems[0].originalPrice).toBe(100);
      expect(savedItems[0].discountPercentage).toBe(20);
    });

    it('should reject insufficient stock at create', async () => {

    it('should reject when aggregated quantity across items exceeds stock', async () => {
      // Two line items for the same sellerProductId, each quantity <= stock individually,
      // but combined quantity > stock
      const sellerProductLimitedStock = {
        ...mockSellerProduct,

        seller: { id: 1 } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'],
      } as SellerProduct;
      const inputTwoItemsSameProduct = {

          {
            ...createOrderInput.items[0],

          },
        ],
      };
      orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue({ ...mockSavedOrder, items: undefined } as unknown as typeof mockSavedOrder);
      sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(mockSeller);
      // findOne will be called twice per service call (once per item in Promise.all),
      // and the test calls the service twice (two expect statements), so 4 total calls
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProductLimitedStock);
      await expect(service.createOrder(inputTwoItemsSameProduct)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      await expect(service.createOrder(inputTwoItemsSameProduct)).rejects.toThrow(
        /Insufficient stock for product seller-product-1. Available: 3, Requested: 4/,
      );
    });
    // Heavy 6: Locked Tests 1-9
    describe('Heavy 6: createOrder catalog pricing, aggregated stock, and input validation', () => {
      const heavy6Seller: SellerInfo = {
        id: 1,
        storeName: 'Heavy 6 Store',
        phone: '1112223333',
        address: 'Heavy 6 Address',
        shippingFee: 15,
      } as SellerInfo;
      const baseItem = {
        productId: 'prod-1',
        sellerProductId: 'sp-1',
        productName: 'Heavy 6 Product',
        productImage: 'img.jpg',
        color: 'Red',
        size: '42',
        unitPrice: 100,
        totalPrice: 100,
      };
      const makeSellerProduct = (overrides: Partial<SellerProduct> = {}): SellerProduct => ({
        id: 'sp-1',
        price: 100,
        discount: 0,
        stockQuantity: 5,
        seller: { id: 1 } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'],
        productInfoId: 1,
        product: undefined as never,
        productInfo: undefined as never,
        costPrice: undefined as never,
        ...overrides,
      } as SellerProduct);
      const baseInput = (overrides: Partial<CreateOrderInput> = {}): CreateOrderInput => ({
        customerEmail: 'c@e.com',
        customerPhone: '123',
        customerName: 'Customer',
        shippingAddress: 'Addr',
        city: 'City',
        state: 'ST',
        zipCode: '12345',
        country: 'US',
        sellerId: 1,
        items: [],
        ...overrides,
      });
      const setupSuccessMocks = (sellerProduct: SellerProduct, savedOrderOverrides: Partial<Order> = {}) => {
        const orderWithoutItems = {
          id: 'order-1',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-123',
          trackingNumber: 'KZ-123',
          customerEmail: 'c@e.com',
          customerPhone: '123',
          customerName: 'Customer',
          shippingAddress: 'Addr',
          city: 'City',
          state: 'ST',
          zipCode: '12345',
          country: 'US',
          sellerId: 1,
          status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
          stockReserved: false,
          subtotal: 0,
          shippingCost: 0,
          total: 0,
          sellerStoreName: heavy6Seller.storeName,
          sellerPhone: heavy6Seller.phone,
          sellerAddress: heavy6Seller.address,
          items: undefined,
          seller: heavy6Seller,
          createdAt: new Date(),
          updatedAt: new Date(),
          ...savedOrderOverrides,
        } as never;
        orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue(orderWithoutItems);
        sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(heavy6Seller);
        sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
        orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(orderWithoutItems);
        orderItemRepository.save.mockImplementation(((items: unknown) => Promise.resolve(Array.isArray(items) ? items.map((i: object, idx: number) => ({ ...i, id: `item-${idx + 1}` })) : items)) as never);
      };
      // Locked Test 1: items: [], null, undefined each reject with 'Order must contain at least one item'
      it('Locked Test 1: rejects empty items array, null, and undefined', async () => {
        const emptyInput = baseInput({ items: [] });
        await expect(service.createOrder(emptyInput)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
        await expect(service.createOrder(emptyInput)).rejects.toThrow('Order must contain at least one item');
        const nullInput = baseInput({ items: null as never });
        await expect(service.createOrder(nullInput)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
        await expect(service.createOrder(nullInput)).rejects.toThrow('Order must contain at least one item');
        const undefinedInput = baseInput({ items: undefined as never });
        await expect(service.createOrder(undefinedInput)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
        await expect(service.createOrder(undefinedInput)).rejects.toThrow('Order must contain at least one item');
      });
      // Locked Test 2: 3 items on 'sp-1' (stock 5) qty 2,2,2 -> rejects 'Insufficient stock for product sp-1. Available: 5, Requested: 6'
      it('Locked Test 2: aggregated quantity across 3 items exceeds stock', async () => {
        const sellerProduct = makeSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 5 });
        const input = baseInput({
          items: [
            { ...baseItem, quantity: 2, size: '42' },
            { ...baseItem, quantity: 2, size: '43' },
            { ...baseItem, quantity: 2, size: '44' },
          ],
        });
        orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue({ id: 'o', items: undefined } as never);
        sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(heavy6Seller);
        sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
        await expect(service.createOrder(input)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
        await expect(service.createOrder(input)).rejects.toThrow('Insufficient stock for product sp-1. Available: 5, Requested: 6');
        expect(orderRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(orderItemRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      // Locked Test 3: 2 items on 'sp-1' (stock 5) qty 2 (size 42) and 3 (size 43) -> resolves; order.save subtotal 500; orderItem.save 2 items unitPrice 100/totalPrice 200 and 100/300
      it('Locked Test 3: two items same sellerProductId different sizes within stock resolves with correct pricing', async () => {
        const sellerProduct = makeSellerProduct({ stockQuantity: 5, price: 100, discount: 0 });
        const input = baseInput({
          items: [
            { ...baseItem, quantity: 2, size: '42' },
            { ...baseItem, quantity: 3, size: '43' },
          ],
        });
        setupSuccessMocks(sellerProduct, { subtotal: 500, shippingCost: 15, total: 515 });
        const result = await service.createOrder(input);
        expect(orderRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ subtotal: 500 }));
        const savedItems = orderItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0] as OrderItem[];
        expect(savedItems).toHaveLength(2);
        expect(savedItems[0]).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ unitPrice: 100, totalPrice: 200 }));
        expect(savedItems[1]).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ unitPrice: 100, totalPrice: 300 }));
        expect(result.subtotal).toBe(500);
      });
      // Locked Test 4: sp-1 (stock 5) qty 1 and 1; sp-2 (stock 3) qty 2 and 2 -> rejects 'Insufficient stock for product sp-2. Available: 3, Requested: 4'
      it('Locked Test 4: aggregated quantity across multiple sellerProductIds exceeds stock on sp-2', async () => {
        const sellerProduct1 = makeSellerProduct({ id: 'sp-1', stockQuantity: 5 });
        const sellerProduct2 = makeSellerProduct({ id: 'sp-2', stockQuantity: 3 });
        const input = baseInput({
          items: [
            { ...baseItem, sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 },
            { ...baseItem, sellerProductId: 'sp-1', quantity: 1 },
            { ...baseItem, sellerProductId: 'sp-2', quantity: 2 },
            { ...baseItem, sellerProductId: 'sp-2', quantity: 2 },
          ],
        });
        orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue({ id: 'o', items: undefined } as never);
        sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(heavy6Seller);
        sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockImplementation(({ where }: FindOneOptions<SellerProduct>) => {
          const id = (where as FindOptionsWhere<SellerProduct> | undefined)?.id;
          if (id === 'sp-1') return Promise.resolve(sellerProduct1);
          if (id === 'sp-2') return Promise.resolve(sellerProduct2);
          return Promise.resolve(null);
        });
        await expect(service.createOrder(input)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
        await expect(service.createOrder(input)).rejects.toThrow('Insufficient stock for product sp-2. Available: 3, Requested: 4');
        expect(orderRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      // Locked Test 5: quantity 0, -3, 1.5, NaN each reject /Quantity must be a positive integer for product/; sellerProductId '' rejects /sellerProductId is required for product/
      it('Locked Test 5: invalid quantities and missing sellerProductId reject with correct messages', async () => {
        const sellerProduct = makeSellerProduct();
        orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue({ id: 'o', items: undefined } as never);
        sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(heavy6Seller);
        sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
        const invalidQuantities = [0, -3, 1.5, NaN];
        for (const qty of invalidQuantities) {
          const input = baseInput({ items: [{ ...baseItem, quantity: qty }] });
          await expect(service.createOrder(input)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
          await expect(service.createOrder(input)).rejects.toThrow(/Quantity must be a positive integer for product/);
        }
        const missingSellerProductIdInput = baseInput({ items: [{ ...baseItem, sellerProductId: '', quantity: 1 }] });
        await expect(service.createOrder(missingSellerProductIdInput)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
        await expect(service.createOrder(missingSellerProductIdInput)).rejects.toThrow(/sellerProductId is required for product/);
      });
      // Locked Test 6: sellerId 1 with seller.id '1' as any succeeds; seller.id '99' as any rejects 'Product sp-1 does not belong to seller 1'
      it('Locked Test 6: seller ownership check - string "1" succeeds, string "99" rejects', async () => {
        const sellerProductSeller1 = makeSellerProduct({ seller: { id: '1' } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'] });
        const input = baseInput({ items: [{ ...baseItem, quantity: 1 }] });
        setupSuccessMocks(sellerProductSeller1);
        await expect(service.createOrder(input)).resolves.toBeDefined();
        const sellerProductSeller99 = makeSellerProduct({ seller: { id: '99' } as unknown as SellerProduct['seller'] });
        orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue({ id: 'o', items: undefined } as never);
        sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(heavy6Seller);
        sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProductSeller99);
        await expect(service.createOrder(input)).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
        await expect(service.createOrder(input)).rejects.toThrow('Product sp-1 does not belong to seller 1');
      });
      // Locked Test 7: tampered client fields (unitPrice 0.01, totalPrice 0.01, subtotal 0.01, total 0.01 as any), qty 2, price 200, discount 25, stock 10, seller.shippingFee 10, shippingCost undefined -> order.save objectContaining({ subtotal: 300, shippingCost: 10, total: 310 }); orderItem.save [objectContaining({ unitPrice: 150, totalPrice: 300, originalPrice: 200, discountPercentage: 25 })]
      it('Locked Test 7: tampered client prices are ignored; catalog pricing and shippingFee fallback used', async () => {
        const sellerProduct = makeSellerProduct({ price: 200, discount: 25, stockQuantity: 10 });
        const heavy6SellerWithFee = { ...heavy6Seller, shippingFee: 10, shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE };
        const input = baseInput({
          shippingCost: undefined,
          shippingMethod: 'vip',
          items: [{
            ...baseItem,
            quantity: 2,
            unitPrice: 0.01,
            totalPrice: 0.01,
          }],
        });
        setupSuccessMocks(sellerProduct, { subtotal: 300, shippingCost: 10, total: 310, shippingMethod: 'vip', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE });
        sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(heavy6SellerWithFee);
        const result = await service.createOrder(input);
        expect(orderRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ subtotal: 300, shippingCost: 10, total: 310 }));
        const savedItems = orderItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0] as OrderItem[];
        expect(savedItems[0]).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({
          unitPrice: 150, // 200 * (1 - 25/100) = 150
          totalPrice: 300, // 150 * 2
          originalPrice: 200,
          discountPercentage: 25,
        }));
        expect(result.subtotal).toBe(300);
        expect(result.shippingCost).toBe(10);
        expect(result.total).toBe(310);
      });
      // Locked Test 8: price 99.99, discount 15, stock 10, qty 3, shippingCost 0 -> orderItem.save [objectContaining({ unitPrice: 84.99, totalPrice: 254.97 })]; order.save objectContaining({ subtotal: 254.97, shippingCost: 0, total: 254.97 })
      it('Locked Test 8: precision pricing with discount and zero shippingCost', async () => {
        const sellerProduct = makeSellerProduct({ price: 99.99, discount: 15, stockQuantity: 10 });
        const codSeller = { ...heavy6Seller, shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY };
        const input = baseInput({
          shippingCost: 0,
          shippingMethod: 'vip',
          items: [{ ...baseItem, quantity: 3 }],
        });
        setupSuccessMocks(sellerProduct, { subtotal: 254.97, shippingCost: 0, total: 254.97, shippingMethod: 'vip', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY });
        const result = await service.createOrder(input);
        const savedItems = orderItemRepository.save.mock.calls[0][0] as OrderItem[];
        expect(savedItems[0]).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({
          unitPrice: 84.99, // 99.99 * 0.85 = 84.9915 -> 84.99
          totalPrice: 254.97, // 84.99 * 3 = 254.97
        }));
        expect(orderRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ subtotal: 254.97, shippingCost: 0, total: 254.97 }));
        expect(result.subtotal).toBe(254.97);
        expect(result.shippingCost).toBe(0);
        expect(result.total).toBe(254.97);
      });
      // Locked Test 9: seller.shippingFee 15, item subtotal 100: client shippingCost is ignored; server computes based on seller shippingPaymentMode
      it('Locked Test 9: client shippingCost ignored; server computes based on seller shippingPaymentMode', async () => {
        const sellerProduct = makeSellerProduct({ price: 100, discount: 0, stockQuantity: 10 });
        // (a) PAY_ON_DELIVERY seller: any client shippingCost -> shippingCost = 0
        const codSeller = { ...heavy6Seller, shippingFee: 15, shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY };
        const inputZero = baseInput({ shippingCost: 0, shippingMethod: 'vip', items: [{ ...baseItem, quantity: 1 }] });
        setupSuccessMocks(sellerProduct, { subtotal: 100, shippingCost: 0, total: 100, shippingMethod: 'vip', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY });
        sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(codSeller);
        let result = await service.createOrder(inputZero);
        expect(result).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ subtotal: 100, shippingCost: 0, total: 100 }));
        // (b) PAY_ONLINE seller with vip: client shippingCost null -> server computes full fee (15)
        const onlineSeller = { ...heavy6Seller, shippingFee: 15, shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE };
        const inputNull = baseInput({ shippingCost: null as never, shippingMethod: 'vip', items: [{ ...baseItem, quantity: 1 }] });
        setupSuccessMocks(sellerProduct, { subtotal: 100, shippingCost: 15, total: 115, shippingMethod: 'vip', shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE });
        sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(onlineSeller);
        result = await service.createOrder(inputNull);
        expect(result).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ subtotal: 100, shippingCost: 15, total: 115 }));
        // (c) PAY_ONLINE seller: client shippingCost NaN -> ignored, server computes
        const inputNaN = baseInput({ shippingCost: NaN, shippingMethod: 'vip', items: [{ ...baseItem, quantity: 1 }] });
        orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue({ id: 'o', items: undefined } as never);
        sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(onlineSeller);
        sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
        result = await service.createOrder(inputNaN);
        expect(result).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ subtotal: 100, shippingCost: 15, total: 115 }));
        // (d) PAY_ONLINE seller: client shippingCost -5 -> ignored, server computes
        const inputNegative = baseInput({ shippingCost: -5, shippingMethod: 'vip', items: [{ ...baseItem, quantity: 1 }] });
        orderRepository.create.mockReturnValue({ id: 'o', items: undefined } as never);
        sellerInfoRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(onlineSeller);
        sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
        result = await service.createOrder(inputNegative);
        expect(result).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ subtotal: 100, shippingCost: 15, total: 115 }));
      });
    });
  });

      );

  describe('findAll', () => {
    const mockOrders: Order[] = [
      {
        id: 'order-1',
        orderNumber: 'ORD-1',
        createdAt: new Date('2024-01-01'),
      } as Order,
      {
        id: 'order-2',
        orderNumber: 'ORD-2',
        createdAt: new Date('2024-01-02'),
      } as Order,
    ];
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockQueryBuilder.getMany.mockResolvedValue(mockOrders);
      mockQueryBuilder.getCount.mockResolvedValue(2);
    });
    it('should return paginated orders', async () => {
      const result = await service.findAll(10);
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.leftJoinAndSelect).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.orderBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.createdAt',
        'DESC',
      );
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.take).toHaveBeenCalledWith(11);
      expect(result.edges).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(result.totalCount).toBe(2);
    });
    it('should filter by sellerId', async () => {
      await service.findAll(10, undefined, '1');
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.andWhere).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.sellerId = :sellerId',
        { sellerId: 1 },
      );
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException for invalid sellerId', async () => {
      await expect(service.findAll(10, undefined, 'invalid')).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      await expect(service.findAll(10, undefined, 'invalid')).rejects.toThrow(
        'Invalid sellerId',
      );
    });
    it('should filter by status', async () => {
      await service.findAll(10, undefined, undefined, OrderStatus.PENDING);
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.andWhere).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.status = :status',
        { status: OrderStatus.PENDING },
      );
    });
    it('should handle pagination cursor', async () => {
      const cursor = Buffer.from(new Date().toISOString()).toString('base64');
      await service.findAll(10, cursor);
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.andWhere).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should indicate hasNextPage when more items exist', async () => {
      const manyOrders = Array.from({ length: 11 }, (_, i) => ({
        id: `order-${i}`,
        createdAt: new Date(),
      })) as Order[];
      mockQueryBuilder.getMany.mockResolvedValue(manyOrders);
      const result = await service.findAll(10);
      expect(result.pageInfo.hasNextPage).toBe(true);
    });
    it('should apply id DESC tie-breaker ordering for deterministic pagination', async () => {
      await service.findAll(10);
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.orderBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.createdAt',
        'DESC',
      );
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.addOrderBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.id',
        'DESC',
      );
    });
    it('should filter by both sellerId and status', async () => {
      await service.findAll(10, undefined, '1', OrderStatus.DELIVERED);
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.andWhere).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.sellerId = :sellerId',
        { sellerId: 1 },
      );
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.andWhere).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.status = :status',
        { status: OrderStatus.DELIVERED },
      );
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException for invalid cursor', async () => {
      const invalidCursor = 'not-valid-base64-date';
      await expect(service.findAll(10, invalidCursor)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      await expect(service.findAll(10, invalidCursor)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Invalid cursor',
      );
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException for empty string cursor', async () => {
      await expect(service.findAll(10, '')).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(service.findAll(10, '')).rejects.toThrow('Invalid cursor');
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException for whitespace-only cursor', async () => {
      await expect(service.findAll(10, '   ')).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      await expect(service.findAll(10, '   ')).rejects.toThrow('Invalid cursor');
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException for base64-encoded non-date string', async () => {
      const nonDateCursor = Buffer.from('not-a-date').toString('base64');
      await expect(service.findAll(10, nonDateCursor)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      await expect(service.findAll(10, nonDateCursor)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Invalid cursor',
      );
    });
    it('should handle valid cursor and set hasPreviousPage to true', async () => {
      const validDate = new Date('2026-01-15T10:00:00.000Z');
      const validCursor = Buffer.from(validDate.toISOString()).toString('base64');
      await service.findAll(10, validCursor);
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.andWhere).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.createdAt < :cursor',
        { cursor: validDate },
      );
    });
    it('should return hasPreviousPage: false when after is undefined', async () => {
      const result = await service.findAll(10, undefined);
      expect(result.pageInfo.hasPreviousPage).toBe(false);
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.andWhere).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.createdAt < :cursor',
        expect.any(Object),
      );
    });
    it('should return hasPreviousPage: false when after is null', async () => {
      const result = await service.findAll(10, null as never);
      expect(result.pageInfo.hasPreviousPage).toBe(false);
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.andWhere).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.createdAt < :cursor',
        expect.any(Object),
      );
    });
    it('should return hasPreviousPage: false when after is empty string', async () => {
      await expect(service.findAll(10, '')).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
    });
    it('should apply orderBy createdAt DESC and addOrderBy id DESC', async () => {
      await service.findAll(10);
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.orderBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'order.createdAt',
        'DESC',
      );
      expect(mockQueryBuilder.addOrderBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order.id', 'DESC');
    });
  });
  describe('updateOrder', () => {
    const orderId = 'order-1';
    const existingOrder: Order = {
      id: orderId,
      orderNumber: 'ORD-123',
      subtotal: 100,
      shippingCost: 10,
      total: 110,
      stockReserved: false,
      items: [],
      status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
      seller: {} as SellerInfo,
      customerEmail: 'test@example.com',
      customerPhone: '1234567890',
      customerName: 'Test User',
      shippingAddress: '123 Test St',
      city: 'Test City',
      state: 'Test State',
      zipCode: '12345',
      country: 'Test Country',
      sellerId: 1,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    } as Order;
    const updateInput: UpdateOrderInput = {
      customerName: 'Updated Name',
    };
    it('should update order successfully', async () => {
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(existingOrder);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...existingOrder,
        ...updateInput,
      } as Order);
      const result = await service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInput);
      expect(orderRepository.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { id: orderId },
        relations: ['items', 'seller'],
      });
      expect(result).toEqual({ ...existingOrder, ...updateInput });
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when items are provided', async () => {
      const updateInputWithItems: UpdateOrderInput = {
        items: [
          {
            productId: 'product-1',
            productName: 'Product 1',
            quantity: 3,
            unitPrice: 50,
            totalPrice: 150,
          },
        ],
      };
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(existingOrder);
      await expect(service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInputWithItems)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      await expect(service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInputWithItems)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Order items and financial totals cannot be rewritten after order creation',
      );
      expect(orderRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when subtotal is provided', async () => {
      const updateInputWithSubtotal = { ...updateInput, subtotal: 200 as unknown };
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(existingOrder);
      await expect(service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInputWithSubtotal)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      await expect(service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInputWithSubtotal)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Order items and financial totals cannot be rewritten after order creation',
      );
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when total is provided', async () => {
      const updateInputWithTotal = { ...updateInput, total: 200 as unknown };
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(existingOrder);
      await expect(service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInputWithTotal)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      await expect(service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInputWithTotal)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Order items and financial totals cannot be rewritten after order creation',
      );
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when shippingCost is provided', async () => {
      const updateInputWithShippingCost = { ...updateInput, shippingCost: 20 as unknown };
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(existingOrder);
      await expect(service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInputWithShippingCost)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      await expect(service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInputWithShippingCost)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Order items and financial totals cannot be rewritten after order creation',
      );
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException when order status is not PENDING', async () => {
      const confirmedOrder = { ...existingOrder, status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED };
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(confirmedOrder);
      await expect(service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInput)).rejects.toThrow(
        BadRequestException,
      );
      await expect(service.updateOrder(orderId, updateInput)).rejects.toThrow(
        'Order items and financial totals cannot be rewritten after order creation',
      );
      expect(orderRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });
  describe('updateOrderStatus', () => {
    const orderId = 'order-1';
    const mockOrderItems: OrderItem[] = [
      {
        id: 'item-1',
        productId: 'product-1',
        sellerProductId: 'seller-product-1',
        quantity: 2,
      } as OrderItem,
    ];
    it('should update order status successfully PENDING -> CONFIRMED with stock decrease', async () => {
      const sellerProduct: SellerProduct = {
        id: 'seller-product-1',
        stockQuantity: 10,
      } as SellerProduct;
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        stockReserved: false,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      sellerProductRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...sellerProduct,
        stockQuantity: 8,
      } as SellerProduct);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...order,
        status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
        stockReserved: true,
      });
      const result = await service.updateOrderStatus(
        orderId,
        OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
      );
      expect(sellerProductRepository.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { id: 'seller-product-1' },
        lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' },
      });
      expect(sellerProductRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          stockQuantity: 8,
        }),
      );
      expect(result.status).toBe(OrderStatus.CONFIRMED);
      expect(result.stockReserved).toBe(true);
    });
    it('should restore stock when cancelling a CONFIRMED order (stockReserved = true)', async () => {
      const sellerProduct: SellerProduct = {
        id: 'seller-product-1',
        stockQuantity: 8,
      } as SellerProduct;
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
        stockReserved: true,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      sellerProductRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...sellerProduct,
        stockQuantity: 10,
      } as SellerProduct);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...order,
        status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
        stockReserved: false,
      });
      const result = await service.updateOrderStatus(
        orderId,
        OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
      );
      expect(sellerProductRepository.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        where: { id: 'seller-product-1' },
        lock: { mode: 'pessimistic_write' },
      });
      expect(sellerProductRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        expect.objectContaining({
          stockQuantity: 10,
        }),
      );
      expect(result.status).toBe(OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
      expect(result.stockReserved).toBe(false);
    });
    it('should NOT restore stock when cancelling a PENDING order (stockReserved = false)', async () => {
      const sellerProduct: SellerProduct = {
        id: 'seller-product-1',
        stockQuantity: 10,
      } as SellerProduct;
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        stockReserved: false,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...order,
        status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
        stockReserved: false,
      });
      const result = await service.updateOrderStatus(
        orderId,
        OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
      );
      expect(sellerProductRepository.findOne).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(sellerProductRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result.status).toBe(OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
      expect(result.stockReserved).toBe(false);
    });
    it('should restore stock when refunding a CONFIRMED order (stockReserved = true)', async () => {
      const sellerProduct: SellerProduct = {
        id: 'seller-product-1',
        stockQuantity: 8,
      } as SellerProduct;
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
        stockReserved: true,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      sellerProductRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...sellerProduct,
        stockQuantity: 10,
      } as SellerProduct);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...order,
        status: OrderStatus.REFUNDED,
        stockReserved: false,
      });
      const result = await service.updateOrderStatus(
        orderId,
        OrderStatus.REFUNDED,
      );
      expect(sellerProductRepository.save).toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result.status).toBe(OrderStatus.REFUNDED);
      expect(result.stockReserved).toBe(false);
    });
    it('should not restore stock when order was already cancelled', async () => {
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
        stockReserved: false,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await service.updateOrderStatus(orderId, OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
      expect(sellerProductRepository.save).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException for invalid transition CANCELLED -> DELIVERED', async () => {
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
        stockReserved: false,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        service.updateOrderStatus(orderId, OrderStatus.DELIVERED),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        service.updateOrderStatus(orderId, OrderStatus.DELIVERED),
      ).rejects.toThrow('Invalid status transition from CANCELLED to DELIVERED');
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException for invalid transition REFUNDED -> CANCELLED', async () => {
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.REFUNDED,
        stockReserved: false,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        service.updateOrderStatus(orderId, OrderStatus.CANCELLED),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        service.updateOrderStatus(orderId, OrderStatus.CANCELLED),
      ).rejects.toThrow('Invalid status transition from REFUNDED to CANCELLED');
    });
    it('should throw BadRequestException for invalid transition PENDING -> PROCESSING', async () => {
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        stockReserved: false,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      await expect(
        service.updateOrderStatus(orderId, OrderStatus.PROCESSING),
      ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
      await expect(
        service.updateOrderStatus(orderId, OrderStatus.PROCESSING),
      ).rejects.toThrow('Invalid status transition from PENDING to PROCESSING');
    });
    it('should allow PENDING -> CONFIRMED transition', async () => {
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        stockReserved: false,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...order,
        status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
      });
      const result = await service.updateOrderStatus(
        orderId,
        OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
      );
      expect(result.status).toBe(OrderStatus.CONFIRMED);
    });
    it('should allow PENDING -> CANCELLED transition', async () => {
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        stockReserved: false,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...order,
        status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
      });
      const result = await service.updateOrderStatus(
        orderId,
        OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
      );
      expect(result.status).toBe(OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
    });
    it('should allow CONFIRMED -> PROCESSING transition', async () => {
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
        stockReserved: true,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      orderRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...order,
        status: OrderStatus.PROCESSING,
      });
      const result = await service.updateOrderStatus(
        orderId,
        OrderStatus.PROCESSING,
      );
      expect(result.status).toBe(OrderStatus.PROCESSING);
    });
    it('should allow CONFIRMED -> CANCELLED transition with stock restore', async () => {
      const sellerProduct: SellerProduct = {
        id: 'seller-product-1',
        stockQuantity: 8,
      } as SellerProduct;
      const order: Order = {
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
        stockReserved: true,
        items: mockOrderItems,
      } as Order;
      orderRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order);
      sellerProductRepository.findOne.mockResolvedValue(sellerProduct);
      sellerProductRepository.save.mockResolvedValue({
        ...sellerProduct,

    });
