  });
  describe('cancelPendingZarinPalOrder', () => {
    const authority = 'A00000123';
    const orderId = 'order-123';
    const createPendingOrder = (overrides: Partial<{
      id: string;
      status: OrderStatus;
      paymentAuthority: string | null;
    }> = {}) => ({
      id: orderId,
      status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
      paymentAuthority: authority,
      ...overrides,
    });
    const createCancelledOrder = (overrides: Partial<{
      id: string;
      status: OrderStatus;
      paymentAuthority: string | null;
    }> = {}) => ({
      id: orderId,
      status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
      paymentAuthority: authority,
      ...overrides,
    });
    const createConfirmedOrder = (overrides: Partial<{
      id: string;
      status: OrderStatus;
      paymentAuthority: string | null;
    }> = {}) => ({
      id: orderId,
      status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
      paymentAuthority: authority,
      ...overrides,
    });
    beforeEach(() => {
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([]);
      orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(createPendingOrder() as never);
      orderService.cancelPendingOrder.mockResolvedValue(createCancelledOrder() as never);
    });
    describe('Guest Cancel with Valid authority Test', () => {
      it('should succeed when unauthenticated guest calls with valid authority and orderId', async () => {
        const pendingOrder = createPendingOrder();
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([pendingOrder] as never);
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(pendingOrder as never);
        orderService.cancelPendingOrder.mockResolvedValue(createCancelledOrder() as never);
        const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, authority);
        expect(orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority).toHaveBeenCalledWith(authority);
        expect(orderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(result).toBe(true);
      });
      it('should succeed when unauthenticated guest calls with authority only (no orderId in sessionStorage)', async () => {
        const pendingOrder = createPendingOrder();
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([pendingOrder] as never);
        orderService.cancelPendingOrder.mockResolvedValue(createCancelledOrder() as never);
        const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, authority);
        expect(orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority).toHaveBeenCalledWith(authority);
        expect(orderService.findOne).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(result).toBe(true);
      });
    });
    describe('Unauthenticated Caller With Mismatched / Missing authority Test', () => {
      it('should reject when caller passes orderId with wrong authority', async () => {
        const pendingOrder = createPendingOrder({ paymentAuthority: authority });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([pendingOrder] as never);
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(pendingOrder as never);
        await expect(resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, 'WRONG_AUTHORITY')).rejects.toThrow(
          'Order does not match the provided payment authority'
        );
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject when caller passes orderId without authority (no ownership proof)', async () => {
        const pendingOrder = createPendingOrder();
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(pendingOrder as never);
        await expect(resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined)).rejects.toThrow(
          ForbiddenException
        );
        expect(orderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject when caller passes empty authority string (no ownership proof)', async () => {
        const pendingOrder = createPendingOrder();
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(pendingOrder as never);
        await expect(resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, '')).rejects.toThrow(
          ForbiddenException
        );
        expect(orderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject when caller passes authority with no matching order', async () => {
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([]);
        await expect(resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, 'NONEXISTENT_AUTHORITY')).rejects.toThrow(
          'No matching order found for payment authority'
        );
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
    });
    describe('Already CONFIRMED Order Test', () => {
      it('should reject when authority belongs to a CONFIRMED order', async () => {
        const confirmedOrder = createConfirmedOrder();
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([confirmedOrder] as never);
        await expect(resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, authority)).rejects.toThrow(
          `Cannot cancel order ${orderId} with status ${OrderStatus.CONFIRMED}. Only PENDING orders can be cancelled.`
        );
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject when orderId + authority belongs to a CONFIRMED order', async () => {
        const confirmedOrder = createConfirmedOrder();
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([confirmedOrder] as never);
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(confirmedOrder as never);
        await expect(resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, authority)).rejects.toThrow(
          `Cannot cancel order ${orderId} with status ${OrderStatus.CONFIRMED}. Only PENDING orders can be cancelled.`
        );
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
    });
    describe('Idempotent Repeat CANCELLED Test', () => {
      it('should succeed idempotently when order is already CANCELLED (authority only)', async () => {
        const cancelledOrder = createCancelledOrder();
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([cancelledOrder] as never);
        const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, authority);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(result).toBe(true);
      });
      it('should succeed idempotently when order is already CANCELLED (orderId + authority)', async () => {
        const cancelledOrder = createCancelledOrder();
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([cancelledOrder] as never);
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(cancelledOrder as never);
        const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, authority);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(result).toBe(true);
      });
    });
    describe('Multiple Orders with Same Authority', () => {
      it('should cancel all PENDING orders sharing the same authority', async () => {
        const order1 = createPendingOrder({ id: 'order-1' });
        const order2 = createPendingOrder({ id: 'order-2', paymentAuthority: authority });
        const order3 = createCancelledOrder({ id: 'order-3', paymentAuthority: authority });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2, order3] as never);
        orderService.cancelPendingOrder
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(createCancelledOrder({ id: 'order-1' }) as never)
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(createCancelledOrder({ id: 'order-2' }) as never);
        const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, authority);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-2');
        expect(result).toBe(true);
      });
    });
    // --- New authorization path: no authority, require orderId + ownership ---
    describe('Owner Authorization Without Authority', () => {
      const orderId = 'order-123';
      const customerEmail = 'customer@example.com';
      const guestToken = 'abcdefghijklmnop'; // 16 chars
      const createPendingOrderWithEmail = (overrides: Partial<{
        id: string;
        status: OrderStatus;
        customerEmail: string | null;
        notes: string | null;
        paymentVerifiedAt: Date | null;
      }> = {}) => ({
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        customerEmail,
        notes: `[GuestToken: ${guestToken}]`,
        paymentVerifiedAt: null,
        ...overrides,
      });
      const createCancelledOrderWithEmail = (overrides: Partial<{
        id: string;
        status: OrderStatus;
        customerEmail: string | null;
        notes: string | null;
      }> = {}) => ({
        id: orderId,
        status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
        customerEmail,
        notes: `[GuestToken: ${guestToken}]`,
        ...overrides,
      });
      beforeEach(() => {
        jest.clearAllMocks();
        orderService.cancelPendingOrder.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      });
      it('should succeed when owner email matches and no authority provided', async () => {
        const order = createPendingOrderWithEmail({ customerEmail });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order as never);
        const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, { id: 'user-1', email: customerEmail }, undefined);
        expect(orderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(result).toBe(true);
      });
      it('should reject with ForbiddenException when logged-in user email differs and no guestToken', async () => {
        const order = createPendingOrderWithEmail({ customerEmail });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order as never);
        await expect(
          resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, { id: 'user-2', email: 'other@example.com' }, undefined)
        ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject with ForbiddenException when anonymous (no user) and no guestToken', async () => {
        const order = createPendingOrderWithEmail({ customerEmail });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order as never);
        await expect(
          resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, undefined, undefined)
        ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject with ForbiddenException when anonymous with wrong guestToken', async () => {
        const order = createPendingOrderWithEmail({ customerEmail, notes: '[GuestToken: wrongtoken12345]' });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order as never);
        await expect(
          resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, undefined, 'wrongtoken12345')
        ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should succeed when anonymous with correct guestToken in notes', async () => {
        const order = createPendingOrderWithEmail({ customerEmail, notes: `[GuestToken: ${guestToken}]` });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order as never);
        const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, undefined, guestToken);
        expect(orderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(orderId);
        expect(result).toBe(true);
      });
      it('should reject prefix trick: notes has longer token, caller provides prefix (< full token)', async () => {
        const longToken = 'abcdefghijklmnopXYZ'; // 19 chars
        const prefixToken = 'abcdefghijklmnop'; // 16 chars, prefix of longToken
        const order = createPendingOrderWithEmail({ customerEmail, notes: `[GuestToken: ${longToken}]` });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order as never);
        await expect(
          resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, undefined, prefixToken)
        ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject short token (< 16 chars) even if present in notes', async () => {
        const shortToken = 'abc123'; // 6 chars
        const order = createPendingOrderWithEmail({ customerEmail, notes: `[GuestToken: ${shortToken}]` });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order as never);
        await expect(
          resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, undefined, shortToken)
        ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject when no orderId and no authority provided', async () => {
        await expect(
          resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined)
        ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
        expect(orderService.findOne).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject with BadRequestException when owner but order is CONFIRMED', async () => {
        const order = createPendingOrderWithEmail({ customerEmail, status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order as never);
        await expect(
          resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, { id: 'user-1', email: customerEmail }, undefined)
        ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should succeed idempotently when owner and order is already CANCELLED', async () => {
        const order = createCancelledOrderWithEmail({ customerEmail });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order as never);
        const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, { id: 'user-1', email: customerEmail }, undefined);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(result).toBe(true);
      });
      it('should reject with BadRequestException when owner but order has paymentVerifiedAt set', async () => {
        const order = createPendingOrderWithEmail({ customerEmail, paymentVerifiedAt: new Date() });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order as never);
        await expect(
          resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, { id: 'user-1', email: customerEmail }, undefined)
        ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should convert NotFoundException from findOne to ForbiddenException', async () => {
        orderService.findOne.mockRejectedValue(new NotFoundException('Order not found'));
        await expect(
          resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(orderId, undefined, { id: 'user-1', email: customerEmail }, undefined)
        ).rejects.toThrow(ForbiddenException);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
    });
  });
  describe('Multi-Seller Batch orderIds Tests', () => {
    const createMockOrder = (overrides: Partial<{
      id: string;
      status: OrderStatus;
      total: number;
      customerId: string | null;
      customerEmail: string | null;
      paymentAuthority: string | null;
      paymentAmount: number | null;
      paymentCurrency: string | null;
      orderNumber: string;
      notes: string | null;
    }> = {}) => ({
      id: 'order-123',
      status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
      total: 80,
      customerId: 'cust-A',
      customerEmail: 'test@example.com',
      paymentAuthority: null,
      paymentAmount: null,
      paymentCurrency: null,
      orderNumber: 'ORD-123',
      notes: null,
      ...overrides,
    });
    const authority = 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000000';
    const refId = 123456;
    beforeEach(() => {
      jest.clearAllMocks();
      orderService.findOne.mockReset();
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockReset();
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockReset();
      orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mockReset();
      orderService.cancelPendingOrder.mockReset();
      orderService.updateOrderStatus?.mockReset();
      paymentService.requestPayment.mockReset();
      paymentService.verifyPayment.mockReset();
      currencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockReset();
      orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([]);
      orderService.setPaymentIntent.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
      orderService.cancelPendingOrder.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
    });
    describe('requestZarinPalPayment - Multi-Seller Batch', () => {
      it('should request payment once for batch total and bind authority to all orders', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', total: 40, orderNumber: 'ORD-001' });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-2', total: 60, orderNumber: 'ORD-002' });
        orderService.findOne
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
        currencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 60000 } as never);
        paymentService.requestPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', authority, fee_type: 'Merchant', fee: 0 },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000, // (40 + 60) * 60000 = 6,000,000
          callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
          description: 'Test',
          currency: 'IRT',
          orderIds: ['order-1', 'order-2'],
        } as never;
        const result = await resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input);
        expect(paymentService.requestPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(paymentService.requestPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
          expect.objectContaining({ amount: 6000000 })
        );
        // setPaymentIntent should be called for BOTH orders with the shared authority
        expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
        expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
          expect.objectContaining({
            orderId: 'order-1',
            authority,
            amount: 6000000,
          })
        );
        expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
          expect.objectContaining({
            orderId: 'order-2',
            authority,
            amount: 6000000,
          })
        );
        expect(result.authority).toBe(authority);
        expect(result.code).toBe(100);
      });
      it('should reject when orders belong to different customers (cross-customer spoofing)', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', customerId: 'cust-A', customerEmail: 'a@test.com' });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-2', customerId: 'cust-B', customerEmail: 'b@test.com' });
        orderService.findOne
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
        currencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 60000 } as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
          description: 'Test',
          currency: 'IRT',
          orderIds: ['order-1', 'order-2'],
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
          'All orders in a batch must belong to the same customer'
        );
        expect(paymentService.requestPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject when any order is not PENDING', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', status: OrderStatus.PENDING });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-2', status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED });
        orderService.findOne
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
          description: 'Test',
          currency: 'IRT',
          orderIds: ['order-1', 'order-2'],
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
          'Order(s) order-2 are not in PENDING status and cannot be paid'
        );
        expect(paymentService.requestPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject javascript: or malformed callback_url', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', total: 40 });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-2', total: 60 });
        orderService.findOne
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
        currencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 60000 } as never);
        // Test javascript: protocol
        const inputJs = {
          amount: 6000000,
          callback_url: 'javascript:alert(1)',
          description: 'Test',
          currency: 'IRT',
          orderIds: ['order-1', 'order-2'],
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(inputJs)).rejects.toThrow(
          'Invalid callback_url protocol'
        );
        // Test malformed URL
        const inputMalformed = {
          amount: 6000000,
          callback_url: 'not-a-url',
          description: 'Test',
          currency: 'IRT',
          orderIds: ['order-1', 'order-2'],
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(inputMalformed)).rejects.toThrow(
          'Invalid callback_url'
        );
        expect(paymentService.requestPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject when guest orders in batch have different GuestToken tags', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          total: 40,
          customerEmail: '',
          notes: '[GuestToken: token-A]',
        });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-2',
          total: 60,
          customerEmail: '',
          notes: '[GuestToken: token-B]',
        });
        orderService.findOne
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
        currencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 60000 } as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
          description: 'Test',
          currency: 'IRT',
          orderIds: ['order-1', 'order-2'],
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
          'All orders in a batch must share the same guest checkout token'
        );
        expect(paymentService.requestPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject when any order does not exist', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1' });
        orderService.findOne
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(null as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
          description: 'Test',
          currency: 'IRT',
          orderIds: ['order-1', 'order-nonexistent'],
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
          'Order(s) not found: order-nonexistent'
        );
      });
      it('should work with single orderId (backward compatibility)', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', total: 100 });
        orderService.findOne.mockResolvedValue(order1 as never);
        currencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 55000 } as never);
        paymentService.requestPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', authority, fee_type: 'Merchant', fee: 0 },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 5500000,
          callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
          description: 'Test',
          currency: 'IRT',
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        const result = await resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input);
        expect(orderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(result.authority).toBe(authority);
      });
      it('should deduplicate orderIds and order_id', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', total: 50 });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-2', total: 50 });
        orderService.findOne
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order1 as never)
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(order2 as never);
        currencyService.getCurrentExchangeRate.mockResolvedValue({ rate: 60000 } as never);
        paymentService.requestPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', authority, fee_type: 'Merchant', fee: 0 },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
          description: 'Test',
          currency: 'IRT',
          order_id: 'order-1',
          orderIds: ['order-1', 'order-2', 'order-1'], // duplicates
        } as never;
        await resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input);
        // Should only call findOne twice (deduplicated)
        expect(orderService.findOne).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
        expect(orderService.setPaymentIntent).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      });
      it('should reject when no orderIds provided', async () => {
        const input = {
          amount: 100000,
          callback_url: 'https://example.com/callback',
          description: 'Test',
          currency: 'IRT',
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.requestZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
          'At least one orderId is required'
        );
      });
    });
    describe('verifyZarinPalPayment - Multi-Seller Batch', () => {
      it('should reject when any order for the authority is already CANCELLED', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED,
        });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-2',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-2',
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
          'Cannot verify payment for cancelled or refunded order(s): order-1'
        );
        expect(paymentService.verifyPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should reject when any order for the authority is already REFUNDED', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          status: OrderStatus.REFUNDED,
        });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-2',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-2',
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
          'Cannot verify payment for cancelled or refunded order(s): order-1'
        );
        expect(paymentService.verifyPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      });
      it('should serialize concurrent verifyZarinPalPayment calls for the same authority and call confirmOrderPayment only once', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
          status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-2',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-002',
          status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', ref_id: refId },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        // Fire two concurrent verify calls with the same authority
        const [result1, result2] = await Promise.all([
          resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input),
          resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input),
        ]);
        // Both should return the same successful result
        expect(result1.success).toBe(true);
        expect(result2.success).toBe(true);
        expect(result1.ref_id).toBe(refId);
        expect(result2.ref_id).toBe(refId);
        // verifyPayment should only be called ONCE (the second call awaits the first)
        expect(paymentService.verifyPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        // confirmOrderPayment should be called for each order exactly once (total 2)
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-2');
      });
      it('should confirm ALL sibling orders when payment succeeds', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
        });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-2',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-002',
        });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', ref_id: refId },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        const result = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
        expect(orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority).toHaveBeenCalledWith(authority);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-2');
        // Verify response includes all order IDs
        expect(result.orderIds).toEqual(['order-1', 'order-2']);
        expect(result.orderId).toBe('order-1');
        expect(result.orderNumber).toBe('ORD-001, ORD-002');
        expect(result.ref_id).toBe(refId);
        expect(result.success).toBe(true);
      });
      it('should return success: false with refId when gateway returns 100 but confirmOrderPayment throws (insufficient stock)', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
        });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', ref_id: refId },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const stockError = new BadRequestException('Insufficient stock');
        orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mockRejectedValue(stockError);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        const result = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
        expect(orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority).toHaveBeenCalledWith(authority);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
        // CRITICAL: Must return success: false when confirmOrderPayment throws
        expect(result.success).toBe(false);
        expect(result.code).toBe(100);
        expect(result.ref_id).toBe(refId);
        expect(result.orderId).toBe('order-1');
        expect(result.orderNumber).toBe('ORD-001');
        expect(result.message).toContain('Insufficient stock');
        expect(result.message).toContain(String(refId));
      });
      it('should return success: true idempotently when gateway returns 101 and all orders are already CONFIRMED with stock reserved', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
        });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-2',
          status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-002',
        });
        // Simulate stockReserved flag being true (or not false)
        (order1 as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['stockReserved'] = true;
        (order2 as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['stockReserved'] = true;
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 101, message: 'Already verified', ref_id: refId },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        const result = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
        expect(orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority).toHaveBeenCalledWith(authority);
        // Should NOT call confirmOrderPayment for already-confirmed orders with stock reserved
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(result.success).toBe(true);
        expect(result.code).toBe(101);
        expect(result.ref_id).toBe(refId);
        expect(result.orderIds).toEqual(['order-1', 'order-2']);
      });
it('does NOT treat CONFIRMED orders with stockReserved=undefined as idempotently reserved (matches entity default false)', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
        });
        (order1 as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)['stockReserved'] = undefined;
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 101, message: 'Already verified', ref_id: refId },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const result = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment({ amount: 6000000, authority, order_id: 'order-1' } as never);
        // Already-CONFIRMED orders are never re-confirmed; result is still a gateway success
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(result.success).toBe(true);
        expect(result.code).toBe(101);
      });
      it('should retry confirmOrderPayment when gateway returns 101 but order is still PENDING (previous attempt failed)', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          status: OrderStatus.PENDING, // Still PENDING because previous confirmOrderPayment failed
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
        });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 101, message: 'Already verified', ref_id: refId },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        // First call succeeds (simulating retry success)
        orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        const result = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
        expect(orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority).toHaveBeenCalledWith(authority);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
        expect(result.success).toBe(true);
        expect(result.code).toBe(101);
        expect(result.ref_id).toBe(refId);
      });
      it('should return success: false when gateway returns 101, order is PENDING, and confirmOrderPayment still throws', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
        });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 101, message: 'Already verified', ref_id: refId },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const stockError = new BadRequestException('Insufficient stock on retry');
        orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mockRejectedValue(stockError);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        const result = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
        expect(orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority).toHaveBeenCalledWith(authority);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        // Should return success: false with refId
        expect(result.success).toBe(false);
        expect(result.code).toBe(101);
        expect(result.ref_id).toBe(refId);
        expect(result.message).toContain('Insufficient stock on retry');
        expect(result.message).toContain(String(refId));
      });
      it('should confirm orders in deterministic order (id ASC)', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-b', paymentAuthority: authority, paymentAmount: 3000000 });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-a', paymentAuthority: authority, paymentAmount: 3000000 });
        // Return in non-sorted order to test sorting
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', ref_id: refId },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-b',
        } as never;
        await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
        // Should confirm in ASC order: order-a, then order-b
        const confirmCalls = orderService.confirmOrderPayment.mock.calls;
        expect(confirmCalls[0][0]).toBe('order-a');
        expect(confirmCalls[1][0]).toBe('order-b');
      });
      it('should cancel ALL sibling orders when payment fails (non-100/101)', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', paymentAuthority: authority, paymentAmount: 6000000 });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-2', paymentAuthority: authority, paymentAmount: 6000000 });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: -51, message: 'Payment failed' },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        const result = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-2');
        expect(result.code).toBe(-51);
      });
      it('should only confirm PENDING orders, skip already confirmed ones', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', status: OrderStatus.PENDING, paymentAuthority: authority, paymentAmount: 6000000 });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-2', status: OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, paymentAuthority: authority, paymentAmount: 6000000 });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', ref_id: refId },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
        // Should only confirm order-1 (PENDING), not order-2 (CONFIRMED)
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
      });
      it('should rollback earlier confirmed orders when a later order fails in multi-order batch', async () => {
        // order-1 succeeds, order-2 fails with insufficient stock
        const order1 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-1',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
        });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({
          id: 'order-2',
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-002',
        });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
        paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
          data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', ref_id: refId },
          errors: [],
        } as never);
        // First call (order-1) succeeds, second call (order-2) throws
        orderService.confirmOrderPayment
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined as never)
          .mockRejectedValueOnce(new BadRequestException('Insufficient stock for order-2'));
        // Add updateOrderStatus mock for rollback verification
        orderService.updateOrderStatus = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        const result = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
        expect(orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority).toHaveBeenCalledWith(authority);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
        expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-2');
        // CRITICAL: Must return success: false with refId
        expect(result.success).toBe(false);
        expect(result.code).toBe(100);
        expect(result.ref_id).toBe(refId);
        expect(result.message).toContain('Insufficient stock for order-2');
        expect(result.message).toContain(String(refId));
        // Verify rollback was called for order-1
        expect(orderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(orderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
      });
      it('should reject when no orders found for authority', async () => {
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([]);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority: 'NONEXISTENT',
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
          'No orders found for this payment authority'
        );
      });
      it('should reject when authority does not match order', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', paymentAuthority: 'DIFFERENT_AUTHORITY' });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1] as never);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
          'Payment authority does not match the order payment intent'
        );
      });
      it('should throw when findOrdersByPaymentAuthority returns empty array', async () => {
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([]);
        const input = {
          amount: 6000000,
          authority,
          order_id: 'order-1',
        } as never;
        await expect(resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
          'No orders found for this payment authority'
        );
      });
      describe('Pre-verify Stock Check - Fail Closed Before Gateway', () => {
        const createMockOrderWithItems = (overrides: Partial<{
          id: string;
          status: OrderStatus;
          paymentAuthority: string | null;
          paymentAmount: number | null;
          paymentCurrency: string | null;
          orderNumber: string;
          items: Array<{
            quantity: number;
            sellerProduct: { id: string; stockQuantity: number };
          }>;
        }> = {}) => ({
          id: 'order-123',
          status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
          paymentAuthority: authority,
          paymentAmount: 6000000,
          paymentCurrency: 'IRT',
          orderNumber: 'ORD-123',
          items: [],
          ...overrides,
        });
        it('should return success:false with ref_id when pre-verify stock check fails across batch (order-2 insufficient stock), confirmOrderPayment called 0 times', async () => {
          // order-1 has sufficient stock (sp-1 qty 1, stock 5)
          // order-2 has insufficient stock (sp-2 qty 3, stock 1)
          const order1 = createMockOrderWithItems({
            id: 'order-1',
            orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
            items: [
              { quantity: 1, sellerProduct: { id: 'sp-1', stockQuantity: 5 } },
            ],
          });
          const order2 = createMockOrderWithItems({
            id: 'order-2',
            orderNumber: 'ORD-002',
            items: [
              { quantity: 3, sellerProduct: { id: 'sp-2', stockQuantity: 1 } },
            ],
          });
          orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
          paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
            data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', ref_id: 111222 },
            errors: [],
          } as never);
          const input = {
            amount: 6000000,
            authority,
            order_id: 'order-1',
          } as never;
          await expect(resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
            'Insufficient stock for product sp-2: required 3, available 1'
          );
          expect(paymentService.verifyPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
          expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        });
        it('should return success:false with ref_id when aggregated stock check fails (two orders share same sellerProductId, combined qty > stock)', async () => {
          // order-1 requests qty 2 of sp-1 (stock 3)
          // order-2 requests qty 2 of sp-1 (stock 3) -> combined 4 > 3
          const order1 = createMockOrderWithItems({
            id: 'order-1',
            orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
            items: [
              { quantity: 2, sellerProduct: { id: 'sp-1', stockQuantity: 3 } },
            ],
          });
          const order2 = createMockOrderWithItems({
            id: 'order-2',
            orderNumber: 'ORD-002',
            items: [
              { quantity: 2, sellerProduct: { id: 'sp-1', stockQuantity: 3 } },
            ],
          });
          orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
          paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
            data: { code: 100, message: 'Success', ref_id: 222333 },
            errors: [],
          } as never);
          const input = {
            amount: 6000000,
            authority,
            order_id: 'order-1',
          } as never;
          await expect(resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input)).rejects.toThrow(
            'Insufficient stock for product sp-1: required 4, available 3'
          );
          expect(paymentService.verifyPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
          expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        });
        it('should rollback confirmed siblings when later order fails confirmOrderPayment (3-order batch, id ASC sort)', async () => {
          // Input orders: order-3, order-1, order-2 (unsorted)
          // After sort: order-1, order-2, order-3
          // order-1 confirms, order-2 confirms, order-3 throws
          const order1 = createMockOrderWithItems({
            id: 'order-1',
            orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
            paymentAmount: 150000,
            items: [{ quantity: 1, sellerProduct: { id: 'sp-x', stockQuantity: 10 } }],
          });
          const order2 = createMockOrderWithItems({
            id: 'order-2',
            orderNumber: 'ORD-002',
            paymentAmount: 150000,
            items: [{ quantity: 1, sellerProduct: { id: 'sp-x', stockQuantity: 10 } }],
          });
          const order3 = createMockOrderWithItems({
            id: 'order-3',
            orderNumber: 'ORD-003',
            paymentAmount: 150000,
            items: [{ quantity: 1, sellerProduct: { id: 'sp-3', stockQuantity: 10 } }],
          });
          // Return in unsorted order to test id ASC sorting
          orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order3, order1, order2] as never);
          paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
            data: { code: 100, message: 'Verified', ref_id: 777888 },
            errors: [],
          } as never);
          // order-1 succeeds, order-2 succeeds, order-3 throws
          orderService.confirmOrderPayment
            .mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined as never) // order-1
            .mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined as never) // order-2
            .mockRejectedValueOnce(new BadRequestException('Insufficient stock for product sp-3 during lock'));
          // Mock updateOrderStatus for rollback verification
          orderService.updateOrderStatus = jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined as never);
          const input = {
            amount: 150000,
            authority,
            order_id: 'order-1',
          } as never;
          const result = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
          // Confirm calls should be in id ASC order: order-1, order-2, order-3
          expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, 'order-1');
          expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, 'order-2');
          expect(orderService.confirmOrderPayment).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(3, 'order-3');
          // Rollback should be called for BOTH order-1 and order-2
          expect(orderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
          expect(orderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(1, 'order-1', OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
          expect(orderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenNthCalledWith(2, 'order-2', OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
          // Must return success: false with ref_id
          expect(result.success).toBe(false);
          expect(result.code).toBe(100);
          expect(result.ref_id).toBe(777888);
          expect(result.message).toContain('777888');
        });
        it('should survive rollback failure (updateOrderStatus rejects) and still return success:false with ref_id', async () => {
          const order1 = createMockOrderWithItems({
            id: 'order-1',
            orderNumber: 'ORD-001',
            paymentAmount: 100000,
            items: [{ quantity: 1, sellerProduct: { id: 'sp-1', stockQuantity: 10 } }],
          });
          const order2 = createMockOrderWithItems({
            id: 'order-2',
            orderNumber: 'ORD-002',
            paymentAmount: 100000,
            items: [{ quantity: 1, sellerProduct: { id: 'sp-2', stockQuantity: 10 } }],
          });
          orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2] as never);
          paymentService.verifyPayment.mockResolvedValue({
            data: { code: 100, message: 'Verified', ref_id: 444555 },
            errors: [],
          } as never);
          // order-1 confirms, order-2 throws
          orderService.confirmOrderPayment
            .mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined as never) // order-1
            .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('Confirmation DB failure'));
          // updateOrderStatus for rollback ALSO rejects (DB connection lost)
          orderService.updateOrderStatus = jest.fn().mockRejectedValue(new Error('Rollback DB connection lost'));
          const input = {
            amount: 100000,
            authority,
            order_id: 'order-1',
          } as never;
          const result = await resolver.verifyZarinPalPayment(input);
          // Should NOT throw unhandled error
          // Should have attempted rollback for order-1
          expect(orderService.updateOrderStatus).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1', OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
          // Must return success: false with ref_id and original error message
          expect(result.success).toBe(false);
          expect(result.code).toBe(100);
          expect(result.ref_id).toBe(444555);
          expect(result.message).toContain('Confirmation DB failure');
        });
      });
    });
    describe('cancelPendingZarinPalOrder - Multi-Seller Batch', () => {
      it('should cancel all PENDING sibling orders sharing the same authority', async () => {
        const order1 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', paymentAuthority: authority });
        const order2 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-2', paymentAuthority: authority });
        const order3 = createMockOrder({ id: 'order-3', status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED, paymentAuthority: authority });
        orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority.mockResolvedValue([order1, order2, order3] as never);
        orderService.cancelPendingOrder
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(createMockOrder({ id: 'order-1', status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED }) as never)
          .mockResolvedValueOnce(createMockOrder({ id: 'order-2', status: OrderStatus.CANCELLED }) as never);
        const result = await resolver.cancelPendingZarinPalOrder(undefined, authority);
        expect(orderService.findOrdersByPaymentAuthority).toHaveBeenCalledWith(authority);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-1');
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-2');
        // Should NOT cancel order-3 (already CANCELLED)
        expect(orderService.cancelPendingOrder).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith('order-3');
        expect(result).toBe(true);
      });
    });
  });
});
describe('PaymentResolver - Batch Shipping Recomputation & Amount Guard', () => {
  function setupResolver() {
    const ordersDb: Record<string, Partial<Order>> = {
      'ord-cod': {
        id: 'ord-cod',
        orderNumber: 'ORD-1',
        customerEmail: 'buyer@example.com',
        status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        sellerId: 1,
        subtotal: 100,
        shippingCost: 15, // stale/poisoned value before recalculation
        total: 115,
        shippingMethod: 'vip',
        shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ON_DELIVERY,
      },
      'ord-online': {
        id: 'ord-online',
        orderNumber: 'ORD-2',
        customerEmail: 'buyer@example.com',
        status: OrderStatus.PENDING,
        sellerId: 2,
        subtotal: 50,
        shippingCost: 0, // client tried to send 0
        total: 50,
        shippingMethod: 'express', // 45% of $10 = $4.50
        shippingPaymentMode: ShippingPaymentMode.PAY_ONLINE,
      },
    };
    const paymentService = {
      requestPayment: jest.fn(async () => ({
        data: {
          code: 100,
          message: 'Success',
          authority: 'A00000000000000000000000000000000000',
        },
        errors: [],
      })),
    };
    const orderService = {
      findOne: jest.fn(async (id: string) => ordersDb[id] ?? null),
      recalculateBatchOrdersShipping: jest.fn(async (orders: Partial<Order>[]) => {
        for (const o of orders) {
          if (o.id === 'ord-cod') {
            o.shippingCost = 0;
            o.total = 100;
          } else if (o.id === 'ord-online') {
            o.shippingCost = 4.5;
            o.total = 54.5;
          }
        }
        return orders as Order[];
      }),
      setPaymentIntent: jest.fn(async () => ({})),
    };
    const currencyService = {
      getCurrentExchangeRate: jest.fn(async () => ({ rate: 60000 })),
    };
    const resolver = new PaymentResolver(
      paymentService as unknown as PaymentService,
      orderService as unknown as OrderService,
      currencyService as unknown as CurrencyService,
    );
    return { resolver, paymentService, orderService };
  }
  it('recomputes batch totals (COD = 0, Online Express = 4.50) and requests exact server Toman amount', async () => {
    const { resolver, paymentService, orderService } = setupResolver();
    // Server total = $100 (COD) + $54.50 (Online) = $154.50 * 60,000 = 9,270,000 Tomans
    const expectedTomans = Math.round(154.5 * 60000);
    const res = await resolver.requestZarinPalPayment({
      amount: expectedTomans,
      callback_url: 'https://saintbala.com/payment-callback',
      description: 'Batch Order Payment',
      currency: 'IRT',
      orderIds: ['ord-cod', 'ord-online'],
    });
    expect(orderService.recalculateBatchOrdersShipping).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(paymentService.requestPayment).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({
        amount: 9270000,
      }),
    );
    expect(res.authority).toBeDefined();
  });
  it('rejects payment request when client amount omits PAY_ONLINE shipping cost', async () => {
    const { resolver } = setupResolver();
    // Client tries to pay only item subtotals ($150 * 60,000 = 9,000,000) without the $4.50 online shipping
    const tamperedClientAmount = Math.round(150 * 60000);
    await expect(
      resolver.requestZarinPalPayment({
        amount: tamperedClientAmount,
        callback_url: 'https://saintbala.com/payment-callback',
        description: 'Tampered Payment',
        currency: 'IRT',
        orderIds: ['ord-cod', 'ord-online'],
      }),
    ).rejects.toThrow(BadRequestException);
  });
});

import {
  Resolver,
  Query,
  Mutation,
  Args,
  ResolveField,
  Parent,
} from '@nestjs/graphql';
import {
  UseGuards,
  NotFoundException,
  ForbiddenException,
  BadRequestException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  Order,
  OrderItem,
  OrderStatus,
  User,
  toSellerOrder,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/entities';
import {
  CreateOrderInput,
  OrdersConnection,
  SellerOrdersConnection,
  UpdateOrderInput,
  UpdateOrderStatusInput,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/inputs';
import {
  createOrderSchema,
  cursorSchema,
  idSchema,
  optionalIdSchema,
  paginationFirstSchema,
  trackingNumberSchema,
  updateOrderSchema,
  updateOrderStatusSchema,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/validation';
import { ZodValidationPipe } from './zod-validation.pipe';
const SELLER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS: Partial<Record<OrderStatus, OrderStatus>> = {
  [OrderStatus.CONFIRMED]: OrderStatus.PROCESSING,
  [OrderStatus.PROCESSING]: OrderStatus.SHIPPED,
  [OrderStatus.SHIPPED]: OrderStatus.DELIVERED,
};
import { OrderService, SellerService } from '@kickzone-workspace/services';
import { GraphqlAuthGuard } from '@kickzone-workspace/guards';
import {
  CurrentUser,
  type AuthenticatedUser,
  type OptionalAuthenticatedUser,
} from '@kickzone-workspace/decorators';
@Resolver(() => Order)
export class OrderResolver {
  constructor(
    private readonly orderService: OrderService,
    private readonly sellerService: SellerService
  ) {}
  /**
   * Extract user ID from various possible fields in the user object.
   */
  private getUserId(user: OptionalAuthenticatedUser): string {
    return String(user?.id ?? user?.sub ?? '');
  }
  /**
   * Check if the customer user owns the order by comparing emails.
   * Returns false if either email is empty/undefined to prevent empty-email matches.
   */
  private isCustomerOrderOwner(
    user: OptionalAuthenticatedUser,
    order: Order
  ): boolean {
    const userEmail = String(user?.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const orderEmail = String(order?.customerEmail ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return userEmail.length > 0 && orderEmail.length > 0 && userEmail === orderEmail;
  }
  /**
   * Normalize user role to uppercase standard values.
   */
  private getUserRole(user: OptionalAuthenticatedUser): 'ADMIN' | 'SELLER' | 'CUSTOMER' | 'UNKNOWN' {
    const rawRole = user?.role ?? user?.userType;
    if (!rawRole) return 'UNKNOWN';
    const normalized = String(rawRole).toUpperCase();
    if (normalized === 'ADMIN') return 'ADMIN';
    if (normalized === 'SELLER') return 'SELLER';
    if (normalized === 'CUSTOMER') return 'CUSTOMER';
    return 'UNKNOWN';
  }
  /**
   * Assert that the caller is an admin.
   */
  private assertAdmin(user: OptionalAuthenticatedUser): void {
    if (this.getUserRole(user) !== 'ADMIN') {
      throw new ForbiddenException('Admin access required');
    }
  }
  @Query(() => OrdersConnection)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async orders(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args(
      'first',
      { type: () => Number, defaultValue: 10 },
      new ZodValidationPipe(paginationFirstSchema)
    )
    first: number,
    @Args(
      'after',
      { type: () => String, nullable: true },
      new ZodValidationPipe(cursorSchema)
    )
    after?: string,
    @Args(
      'sellerId',
      { type: () => String, nullable: true },
      new ZodValidationPipe(optionalIdSchema)
    )
    sellerId?: string,
    @Args('status', { type: () => OrderStatus, nullable: true })
    status?: OrderStatus
  ) {
    this.assertAdmin(user);
    return this.orderService.findAll(first, after, sellerId, status);
  }
  @Query(() => Order)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async order(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('id', { type: () => String }, new ZodValidationPipe(idSchema)) id: string
  ) {
    const order = await this.orderService.findOne(id);
    const role = this.getUserRole(user);
    switch (role) {
      case 'ADMIN':
        return order;
      case 'SELLER': {
        // Get seller info for this user to check ownership
        const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(this.getUserId(user));
        if (!seller || order.sellerId !== seller.id) {
          throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have permission to view this order');
        }
        return toSellerOrder(order);
      }
      case 'CUSTOMER': {
        // Customer ownership is determined by email
        if (!this.isCustomerOrderOwner(user, order)) {
          throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have permission to view this order');
        }
        return order;
      }
      default:
        throw new ForbiddenException('Access denied');
    }
  }
  @Query(() => [Order])
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async myOrders(
    @CurrentUser() user: User,
    @Args(
      'first',
      { type: () => Number, defaultValue: 10 },
      new ZodValidationPipe(paginationFirstSchema)
    )
    first: number,
    @Args(
      'after',
      { type: () => String, nullable: true },
      new ZodValidationPipe(cursorSchema)
    )
    after?: string
  ) {
    // For CUSTOMER: Get orders by customer email
    if (this.getUserRole(user) === 'CUSTOMER') {
      if (!user?.email || String(user.email).trim() === '') {
        return [];
      }
      const result = await this.orderService.getOrdersByCustomerEmail(
        user.email,
        first,
        after
      );
      return result.edges.map((edge) => edge.node);
    }
    // For SELLER: Use mySellerOrders query instead (returns SellerOrder without customer PII)
    throw new NotFoundException(
      'Sellers should use mySellerOrders query instead'
    );
  }
  /**
   * Seller orders query - returns SellerOrder type WITHOUT customer PII
   * Sellers should NOT see customer name, email, phone, or address
   */
  @Query(() => SellerOrdersConnection)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async mySellerOrders(
    @CurrentUser() user: User,
    @Args(
      'first',
      { type: () => Number, defaultValue: 10 },
      new ZodValidationPipe(paginationFirstSchema)
    )
    first: number,
    @Args(
      'after',
      { type: () => String, nullable: true },
      new ZodValidationPipe(cursorSchema)
    )
    after?: string,
    @Args('status', { type: () => OrderStatus, nullable: true })
    status?: OrderStatus
  ) {
    // Only sellers can access this
    if (this.getUserRole(user) !== 'SELLER') {
      throw new NotFoundException('Only sellers can access seller orders');
    }
    // Get seller info from user
    const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(this.getUserId(user));
    if (!seller) {
      throw new NotFoundException('Seller not found for this user');
    }
    // Get orders for this seller
    const result = await this.orderService.getOrdersBySeller(
      seller.id.toString(),
      first,
      after,
      status
    );
    // Convert to SellerOrder connection (removes customer PII)
    return {
      edges: result.edges.map((edge) => ({
        cursor: edge.cursor,
        node: toSellerOrder(edge.node),
      })),
      pageInfo: result.pageInfo,
      totalCount: result.totalCount,
    };
  }
  @Query(() => OrdersConnection)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async adminSellerOrders(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('sellerId', { type: () => String }, new ZodValidationPipe(idSchema))
    sellerId: string,
    @Args(
      'first',
      { type: () => Number, defaultValue: 10 },
      new ZodValidationPipe(paginationFirstSchema)
    )
    first: number,
    @Args(
      'after',
      { type: () => String, nullable: true },
      new ZodValidationPipe(cursorSchema)
    )
    after?: string,
    @Args('status', { type: () => OrderStatus, nullable: true })
    status?: OrderStatus
  ) {
    this.assertAdmin(user);
    return this.orderService.findAll(first, after, sellerId, status);
  }
  @Query(() => OrdersConnection)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async allSellerOrders(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args(
      'first',
      { type: () => Number, defaultValue: 10 },
      new ZodValidationPipe(paginationFirstSchema)
    )
    first: number,
    @Args(
      'after',
      { type: () => String, nullable: true },
      new ZodValidationPipe(cursorSchema)
    )
    after?: string,
    @Args('status', { type: () => OrderStatus, nullable: true })
    status?: OrderStatus
  ) {
    this.assertAdmin(user);
    return this.orderService.findAll(first, after, undefined, status);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Order)
  async createOrder(
    @Args('createOrderInput', new ZodValidationPipe(createOrderSchema))
    createOrderInput: CreateOrderInput
  ) {
    return this.orderService.createOrder(createOrderInput);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Order)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async updateOrder(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('id', { type: () => String }, new ZodValidationPipe(idSchema)) id: string,
    @Args('updateOrderInput', new ZodValidationPipe(updateOrderSchema))
    updateOrderInput: UpdateOrderInput
  ) {
    this.assertAdmin(user);
    const order = await this.orderService.findOne(id);
    // Forbid modifying items or financial totals after order creation
    // items is not part of UpdateOrderInput; guard against it arriving anyway
    const input: UpdateOrderInput & { items?: unknown } = updateOrderInput;
    if (
      input.items != null ||
      order.status !== OrderStatus.PENDING
    ) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Order items and financial totals cannot be rewritten after order creation'
      );
    }
    return this.orderService.updateOrder(id, updateOrderInput);
  }
  @Mutation(() => Order)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async updateOrderStatus(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('updateOrderStatusInput', new ZodValidationPipe(updateOrderStatusSchema))
    updateOrderStatusInput: UpdateOrderStatusInput
  ) {
    const { id, status } = updateOrderStatusInput;
    const order = await this.orderService.findOne(id);
    const role = this.getUserRole(user);
    switch (role) {
      case 'ADMIN':
        // Admin can update any order status
        break;
      case 'SELLER': {
        // Get seller info for this user to check ownership
        const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(this.getUserId(user));
        if (!seller || order.sellerId !== seller.id) {
          throw new ForbiddenException('You can only update status for your own seller orders');
        }
        // Sellers can only move orders through fulfilment steps
        if (SELLER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS[order.status] !== status) {
          throw new BadRequestException(
            `Sellers can only move orders through fulfilment steps (CONFIRMED->PROCESSING->SHIPPED->DELIVERED); ${order.status} -> ${status} is not allowed`
          );
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'CUSTOMER':
      default:
        throw new ForbiddenException('Customers are not allowed to update order status');
    }
    const updated = await this.orderService.updateOrderStatus(id, status);
    // If caller is SELLER, return redacted SellerOrder
    if (role === 'SELLER') {
      return toSellerOrder(updated);
    }
    return updated;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async cancelPendingOrder(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('orderId', { type: () => String }, new ZodValidationPipe(idSchema)) orderId: string
  ) {
    const order = await this.orderService.findOne(orderId);
    const role = this.getUserRole(user);
    // Ownership check
    let isOwner = false;
    if (role === 'ADMIN') {
      isOwner = true;
    } else if (role === 'CUSTOMER') {
      // Customer ownership by email (prevents empty-email matches)
      isOwner = this.isCustomerOrderOwner(user, order);
    } else if (role === 'SELLER') {
      // Seller ownership via SellerInfo
      const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(this.getUserId(user));
      isOwner = seller != null && order.sellerId === seller.id;
    }
    if (!isOwner) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('You do not have permission to cancel this order');
    }
    // Status check: only PENDING orders can be cancelled
    if (order.status !== OrderStatus.PENDING) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Only pending orders can be cancelled');
    }
    await this.orderService.cancelPendingOrder(orderId);
    return true;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Boolean)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async deleteOrder(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('id', { type: () => String }, new ZodValidationPipe(idSchema)) id: string
  ) {
    this.assertAdmin(user);
    const order = await this.orderService.findOne(id);
    // If order is in an active paid status, cancel it first to restore stock
    const activePaidStatuses = [
      OrderStatus.CONFIRMED,
      OrderStatus.PROCESSING,
      OrderStatus.SHIPPED,
    ];
    if (activePaidStatuses.includes(order.status) || order.stockReserved === true) {
      await this.orderService.updateOrderStatus(id, OrderStatus.CANCELLED);
    }
    await this.orderService.deleteOrder(id);
    return true;
  }
  @Mutation(() => Order)
  @UseGuards(GraphqlAuthGuard)
  async updateOrderTracking(
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('id', { type: () => String }, new ZodValidationPipe(idSchema)) id: string,
    @Args(
      'trackingNumber',
      { type: () => String },
      new ZodValidationPipe(trackingNumberSchema)
    )
    trackingNumber: string
  ) {
    const trimmed = String(trackingNumber ?? '').trim();
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.length > 100) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Tracking number must be 1-100 characters');
    }
    const order = await this.orderService.findOne(id);
    const role = this.getUserRole(user);
    switch (role) {
      case 'ADMIN':
        break;
      case 'SELLER': {
        const seller = await this.sellerService.findOneByUserId(this.getUserId(user));
        if (!seller || order.sellerId !== seller.id) {
          throw new ForbiddenException('You can only update tracking for your own seller orders');
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'CUSTOMER':
      default:
        throw new ForbiddenException('Customers are not allowed to update tracking');
    }
    const allowedStatuses = [OrderStatus.CONFIRMED, OrderStatus.PROCESSING, OrderStatus.SHIPPED];
    if (!allowedStatuses.includes(order.status)) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Tracking can only be set on confirmed, processing or shipped orders');
    }
    const updated = await this.orderService.updateTrackingNumber(id, trimmed);
    return role === 'SELLER' ? toSellerOrder(updated) : updated;
  }
  @Mutation(() => [Order])
  async recalculateBatchOrdersShipping(
    @Args('orderIds', { type: () => [String] }) orderIds: string[],
    @CurrentUser() user?: OptionalAuthenticatedUser,
    @Args('guestToken', { type: () => String, nullable: true }) guestToken?: string
  ): Promise<Order[]> {
    const uniqueOrderIds = Array.from(
      new Set(
        (orderIds ?? []).filter(
          (id): id is string => typeof id === 'string' && id.trim().length > 0
        )
      )
    );
    if (uniqueOrderIds.length === 0) {
      throw new BadRequestException('At least one orderId is required');
    }
    const orders = await Promise.all(
      uniqueOrderIds.map((id) => this.orderService.findOne(id))
    );
    const firstEmail = String(orders[0].customerEmail ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const extractToken = (notes?: string | null) => {
      const m = /\[GuestToken:\s*([^\]]+)\]/.exec(notes ?? '');
      return m ? m[1].trim() : null;
    };
    const firstToken = extractToken(orders[0].notes);
    for (const order of orders) {
      if (order.status !== OrderStatus.PENDING) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Order ${order.id} is not in PENDING status`
        );
      }
      if (String(order.customerEmail ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() !== firstEmail) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          'All orders in a batch must belong to the same customer'
        );
      }
      if (extractToken(order.notes) !== firstToken) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          'All orders in a batch must share the same guest checkout token'
        );
      }
      if (firstToken) {
        const provided = guestToken?.trim();
        if (!provided || provided !== firstToken) {
          throw new ForbiddenException('Invalid guest token for batch shipping recalculation');
        }
      } else {
        const userEmail = String(user?.email ?? '').trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!userEmail || !firstEmail || firstEmail !== userEmail) {
          throw new ForbiddenException('Not allowed to recalculate shipping for this order batch');
        }
      }
    }
    return this.orderService.recalculateBatchOrdersShipping(orders);
  }
  @ResolveField(() => [OrderItem])
  async items(@Parent() order: Order) {
    return order.items;
  }
}
